items.title: 住宅強制退去の高齢女性追悼に数千人、スペイン　政界は責任なすり付け合い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マドリード　８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マドリード　８日　ロイター］ - スペインの首都マドリード中心部で８日、長年暮らしていた住宅を強制退去させられ、７日に死去した８７歳の女性を悼み、数千人がデモ行進を行った。

マリカルメン・アバスカルさんは、７０年余り暮らした自宅から担架で運び出された。これを受けて住宅高騰を巡る市民の不満が噴出し抗議活動が全国に拡大。サンチェス首相は、政権が策定した立ち退き抑制や家賃上昇対策を盛り込んだ政令が議会で否決されたため、議会を解散し１１月２９日に総選挙を実施すると表明した。　　

アバスカル氏は９月下旬の強制立ち退き後、重度の不安と極度の疲労により入院していたが７日に死去した。死因は公表されていない。

８日、オレンジ色のベストを着用し腕を組んだ借家人組合のメンバーらが先頭に立ち、数千人の参加者が「これは死ではない、殺人だ」と訴えつつ、アバスカル氏の旧居まで行進した。

スペインではここ数カ月、立ち退き命令を受けた人の自殺が相次いでいる。

政界では、責任のなすり付け合いが繰り広げられた。中道左派勢力は８日、家賃高騰の抑制を目指す法案に反対した保守派を批判。これに対し保守派は中道左派の連立政権が８年間の政権運営を経ても住宅危機に対処できていないと反論した。

マドリード州議会では、アバスカル氏への追悼を巡って紛糾。州議会およびマドリード市議会で絶対過半数を握る保守系最大野党・国民党（ＰＰ） は、同氏への黙とうを拒否した。極左の議員らは市庁舎の外で黙とうを捧げた。

公的世論調査機関ＣＩＳが８日に公表した６月調査によると、スペイン国民の７６．３％が住宅アクセスの確保に向けた市場介入を支持し、７９％が住宅を市場の商品として扱うことよりも住居への権利が優先されるべきだと回答した。

items.title: ブラジル財務相、ボルソナロ氏巡る市場の楽観論批判　財政ショックを警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブラジリア ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブラジリア ８日 ロイター] - ブラジルのドゥリガン財務相は８日、ＣＮＮブラジルのインタビューで、フラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員が大統領選第１回投票で現職のルラ大統領に対して予想を上回る得票率を得たことで市場に広がった楽観論について「安っぽく、中身のない幻想だ」と批判した。

ドゥリガン氏は、ボルソナロ氏の経済政策がアルゼンチンのミレイ大統領の路線と同様に、市場の要求に応えるため債務残高の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比を急速に引き下げることを優先していると指摘。ただボルソナロ氏の計画は具体的な歳出削減策を示さないまま、連邦予算から２０００億レアル（約３９８億ドル）を削減する大規模な財政ショックにつながると警告した。

さらにドゥリガン氏は「将来への投資を名目にしても、国家という組織を不安定化させれば、その代償は非常に大きくなる」と述べた。

一方でルラ大統領の経済政策については、現政権の財政健全化路線を維持しつつ、その進め方やペースを調整する余地があるとの認識を示した。

ドゥリガン氏は、２０２３年末に成立し、来年の施行が予定されているルラ政権の主要な消費税改革の一部をボルソナロ氏が見直すことを提案している点も批判した。この税制改革は適切に設計されており、ブラジル経済の生産性向上につながると主張している。

items.title: Canadian writer Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
items.author: CNA Lifestyle
items.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson blends poetry, prose, dialogue and translation in her literary works. Her writing draws heavily on classical Greek literature and includes the 1998 verse novel Autobiography Of Red.

Canadian writer Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature

Canadian poet Anne Carson blends poetry, prose, dialogue and translation in her literary works. Her writing draws heavily on classical Greek literature and includes the 1998 verse novel Autobiography Of Red.

Canadian poet Anne Carson at the Moderna Museet art gallery in Stockholm, Sweden, in 2015. TT News Agency/Pontus Lundahl

FAST

Canadian poet and writer Anne Carson won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature "for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature," the award-giving body said on Thursday (Oct 8).
The prize is awarded by the Swedish Academy and is worth 12 million Swedish kronor (US$1.2 million).
Canadian poet and essayist Carson's work often blends verse, prose, dialogue and translation in a genre-defying mix.
She is widely known for her translations of classical Greek literature, which heavily influences her work which ranges from opera libretti to literary criticism and verse novels such as Autobiography Of Red from 1998.
Her style is exemplified in Norma Jeane Baker Of Troy from 2019, a performance piece which mixes the stories of Helen of Troy in Euripides' play Helen and Marilyn Monroe.
Carson takes a place beside luminaries such as Alexander Solzhenitsyn, Alice Munro and Ernest Hemingway as a recipient of the award, which often divides opinion among book lovers.
The Academy has been lambasted for ignoring some of the literary titans of the last 120 years such as Leo Tolstoy, Virginia Woolf and Jorge Luis Borges, criticised for snubbing US authors – though it gave the prize to singer-songwriter Bob Dylan in 2016 – and accused of being too obscure in its choices.
Defenders say the Academy has made popular picks, such as Colombia's Gabriel Garcia Marquez in 1982 and Doris Lessing in 2007, arguing that part of its task is to highlight lesser-known literary traditions and encourage readers to broaden their horizons.
Established in the will of Swedish dynamite inventor and businessman Alfred Nobel, the prizes for achievements in literature, science and peace have been awarded since 1901.
Last year's prize was won by Hungarian writer Laszlo Krasznahorkai, dubbed the "master of the apocalypse" by American critic Susan Sontag.

Source: Reuters/mm

items.title: Australia's Maas enters trading halt after Nvidia-backed Firmus shelves $5 billion IPO plan
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Shares of Australia's Maas Group entered a trading halt on Friday pending an announcement related to Nvidia -backed data centre operator Firmus, which has shelved its $5 billion listing plan, citing market volatility and conditions.
items.body:
Shares of Australia's Maas Group (MGH.AX) entered a trading halt on Friday pending an announcement related to Nvidia (NVDA.O) -backed data centre operator Firmus, which has shelved its [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"$5 billion"] listing plan, citing market volatility and conditions.
Construction services provider Maas said it had requested the halt pending a material announcement regarding Firmus and its contractual arrangements with the data centre operator.
The company said it expected the halt to be lifted once it updated the market or by the start of trading on Monday.
In early August, Maas pledged an [USN:L6N44105S TEXT:"additional A$300 million"]($208.74 million) to Firmus through ordinary and preference shares priced at A$230 apiece, increasing its stake in the data centre operator to 3.2%.
The trading halt comes after Maas shares plunged [USN:L6N45U03Q TEXT:"more than 20%"] on Thursday following reports that Firmus was reconsidering the terms of its planned listing.
The selloff erased about A$517 million from Maas Group's market value, leaving the stock down more than 30% from the record high it reached earlier this month.
Earlier on Friday, Firmus scrapped its hotly anticipated initial public offering and said it would opt for a private fundraising round instead.
The firm, which counts OpenAI as its anchor customer, designs and operates modular AI factories that use proprietary energy and cooling technology.
The proposed IPO would have been Australia's second-largest on record, but drew lukewarm investor demand, signalling that investors remain selective toward AI-linked listings despite the artificial intelligence boom fuelling global equity markets.
The deal's [USN:L1N45N0G2 TEXT:"term sheet"], circulated at launch, said indicative orders were already sufficient to cover the size of the offering.
However, prospective investors [USN:L6N45O0KM TEXT:"told Reuters"] they were concerned about the company's rapidly rising valuation, its ability to deliver on ambitious expansion plans and its hefty debt pile.
($1 = 1.4372 Australian dollars)

Exclusive-AI surveillance startup Flock Safety to cut several hundred jobs amid backlash, sources say

A drone view shows a Flock Safety camera mounted on a pole beneath a solar panel in Waltham, Massachusetts, U.S., August 24, 2026. REUTERS/Brian Snyder

FAST

Oct 8 : Flock Safety plans to let go of about 18 per cent of its employees, people with direct knowledge of the plans said on Thursday, as the maker of AI-powered surveillance cameras and license-plate readers faces mounting opposition to its products from communities and lawmakers.
The people said job cuts came after a voluntary buyout program and are expected to impact roughly 270 employees at Flock, a surveillance technology startup that has seen rapid growth in recent years. Employees will leave the company at the end of the month. Sources declined to be identified as the company has yet to make the plan public.
Flock declined to comment.
In September, Flock announced a voluntary separation program, asking employees to apply if they wanted to leave the company, Wired reported last month. The company has about 1,500 employees.

Flock faces growing scrutiny from regulators, lawmakers, and privacy advocates, despite drawing strong investor interest among venture capitalists. A recent Reuters/Ipsos poll showed Americans are divided on whether Flock cameras are a good idea. Some 38 per cent of the country supports the use of Flock cameras in their community, compared to 47 per cent who oppose their use.
Across 49 states, Flock’s network of around 120,000 AI-powered cameras, affixed to streets and highways, automatically read license plates and record vehicles as they pass.
The company, based in Atlanta and founded in 2017, has raised over $950 million from venture capital investors, with its latest $275 million round in March led by Andreessen Horowitz valuing the company at $7.5 billion. The funds have supported a new US manufacturing facility and an upcoming push into drone products, according to the company.
Flock provides cameras and software to more than 4,800 law enforcement agencies and nearly 1,000 businesses. The company says its technology helps investigate and solve crimes, but it has come under increasing scrutiny over alleged privacy violations and data-sharing practices.
Public backlash has grown. In September, Florida banned automated license plate readers from state highways, citing privacy risks tied to Flock’s cameras.
Home Depot investors recently demanded reviews of the retailer's partnerships with surveillance technology vendors after reports that Flock’s data was used in immigration enforcement.
Flock also faces legal challenges, such as a privacy lawsuit in Virginia alleging that the widespread deployment of its AI-powered cameras constitutes warrantless surveillance.
Together with AI data centers, Flock cameras have emerged as a flashpoint in this year’s midterm elections, with candidates increasingly attacking their opponents by tying them to the technology.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米、イラン「影の船団」に追加制裁　石油販売締め付け強化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timothy Gardner　Daphne Psaledakis

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Timothy Gardner　Daphne Psaledakis

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - 米財務省は８日、イラン産の原油や石油製品、石油化学製品の輸送に関与したとして、個人やネットワーク、船舶１７隻を対象に追加制裁を科したと発表した。イラン経済への圧力を強める。

今回の制裁は財務省の「経済的追放作戦」の一環で、イランが米国との戦争やミサイル製造、サイバー攻撃、イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）に充てる資金を断つことを目的としている。

財務省当局者は電話会見で「本日の措置は『影の船団』の大部分を無力化することで、イランに残る違法な海上インフラにこれまでで最大の打撃を与えるものだ」と説明。「財務省はイラン政権に残された最後の主要な不正収入源を断ち、同政権の責任を問うための国際的圧力を強めている」と述べた。

米国は、戦争終結に向けたイランとの覚書が破綻したことを受け、７月１４日にイランの港湾に対する封鎖を再開した。今回の制裁はイランの石油販売への締め付けをさらに強める措置となる。

財務省当局者によると、封鎖区域外でイランが船舶上に保有する原油はシンガポール、マレーシア、中国沖合の約２０００万バレルにとどまる。

別の財務省当局者は、封鎖と制裁の影響でイランが原油タンカーへの積み込みと荷下ろしを停止したと述べた。

items.title: Virginia county board sues to block proposed Trump triumphal arch
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Arlington County, Virginia, board late on Thursday sued the US Department of Interior and National Park Service seeking to block President Donald Trump's proposed triumphal arch.
items.body:
The Arlington County, Virginia, board late on Thursday sued the US Department of Interior and National Park Service seeking to block President Donald Trump's proposed triumphal arch.
The 250-foot (76-meter) arch project modeled on Paris' Arc de Triomphe and sited near Arlington National Cemetery, just across the Potomac River from Washington, could win approval as early as next month. Arlington County said in its lawsuit that the project within a busy traffic corridor within Arlington County will cause "significant harm" to its residents.

items.title: Mamdani Says Child Was in Car When ICE Agent Shot New York Man
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent shot and wounded a man in New York City on Thursday, prompting Mayor Zohran Mamdani to demand an end to ICE operations in the city.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent shot and wounded a man in New York City on Thursday, prompting Mayor Zohran Mamdani to demand an end to ICE operations in the city.Mamdani said early reports indicated agents surrounded the man before firing multiple rounds in the residential neighborhood of Marble Hill in the Bronx. A five-year-old child was in the man’s vehicle, Mamdani said, adding officials believed the child was physically unharmed.The shooting occurred at about 4 p.m., the New York Police Department said. The man was conscious and receiving treatment at a nearby hospital.“This is an unconscionable and incredibly serious situation,” Mamdani said in a statement. “I have called the President; when we speak I will demand that he ends all ICE enforcement actions in our city.”The man had been sought by ICE as part of a federal operation and had prior criminal convictions, according to a person familiar with the matter, who also confirmed ICE’s involvement in the shooting. It wasn’t immediately clear what led to the incident. The Department of Homeland Security, which oversees ICE, didn’t respond to a request for comment.A series of shootings involving federal immigration agents, including incidents earlier this year when US citizens were killed, has drawn national attention to the Trump administration’s enforcement efforts.New York Governor Kathy Hochul said she had been briefed on the shooting and called on federal authorities to explain what happened.“We expect federal authorities to provide a full and transparent accounting of the circumstances surrounding this incident,” she wrote in a post on X. “New Yorkers deserve to know exactly what happened and why.”The NYPD said it wasn’t involved in the incident and had no officers at the scene when the shooting occurred. The city’s sanctuary policies generally limit local cooperation with federal immigration authorities. Mamdani called for ICE to leave the city’s neighborhoods, hospitals, streets and children, saying he would not stand by while agents “terrorize our communities.”--With assistance from Alicia A. Caldwell.(Updates with Mamdani comments throughout.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: Meta brilla con Muse, pero Wall Street ve más potencial en las acciones de semiconductores
items.author: Ryan Vlastelica
items.summary: Aunque Muse, de Meta, ha ganado popularidad, los expertos de Wall Street consideran que los fabricantes de chips y la infraestructura de IA ofrecen una apuesta más fiable.
items.body: Bloomberg — Los expertos de Wall Street afirman que los fabricantes de chips siguen siendo la mejor opción para que los inversores en renta variable participen en la carrera por el mejor agente de inteligencia artificial, aunque Muse, de Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ), parezca haber tomado la delantera. “El liderazgo es casi como un juego de la patata caliente”, afirmó Paisley Nardini, responsable de supervisar US$3.800 millones como directora de estrategia de inversión en Tema ETFs, que posee acciones de Meta. “Ya estoy oyendo a la gente bromear sobre cómo nos olvidaremos de Muse en favor de otra cosa dentro de un par de semanas”. Ver más: ¿Es momento de invertir en acciones de Meta? El rally pone a Muse en el foco de Wall Street Los agentes de IA gestionan tareas de varios pasos, como realizar reservas o gestionar las finanzas. Su popularidad ha causado revuelo en el mercado, ya que los inversores sopesan qué productos tienen más posibilidades de convertirse en los favoritos de empresas y consumidores, al tiempo que evalúan el potencial impacto disruptivo que podrían tener en los modelos de negocio tradicionales. Sin embargo, en medio de estas cuestiones, lo que ha quedado claro es que estos nuevos agentes requieren más potencia de cálculo que la generación anterior de herramientas de IA, que adoptaban principalmente la forma de chatbots. Esto significa que debería mantenerse la demanda de acciones de los fabricantes de chips y de otros sectores del panorama de la infraestructura de IA, que han sido las vías preferidas para posicionarse de cara a esta tecnología emergente desde que ChatGPT debutó hace casi cuatro años. “En lugar de intentar adivinar qué empresa acabará teniendo el mejor agente, queremos contar con la base para los agentes en general, es decir, las acciones que funcionarán independientemente de qué empresa vaya a la cabeza”, afirmó Rick Lear, director de inversiones de Lear Investment Management, cuya cartera concentrada se centra en empresas que, según sus previsiones, se beneficiarán del auge de los agentes, como Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ), Micron Technology Inc. ( MU ) y la empresa energética Williams Cos Inc. ( WMB ). “El liderazgo tecnológico sigue oscilando, pero si los agentes despegan en general, necesitaremos muchos más chips, más memoria, más potencia y más infraestructura”, señaló. “Esto será así de forma universal, independientemente de si pasamos de que Meta sea la mejor a que vuelva a irle mal”. Ver más: Acciones de IA repuntan tras éxito del agente Muse: Meta se dispara 11% Las acciones relacionadas con la infraestructura de la IA han impulsado en gran medida el mercado este año. De las diez empresas con mayores ganancias del índice S&P 500, nueve están expuestas a este sector. Los fabricantes de chips han tenido un comportamiento especialmente sólido, con el índice de semiconductores de la Bolsa de Filadelfia (Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index) registrando un repunte del 81%, impulsado por empresas relacionadas con la IA como Micron, Marvell Technology Inc. ( MRVL ), Intel Corp. ( INTC ) y Advanced Micro Devices Inc. ( AMD ). El índice de chips llegó a caer hasta un 2% poco después de la apertura del jueves. Meta presentó el mes pasado su asistente personal de IA, Muse, y rápidamente obtuvo un gran número de descargas y críticas muy favorables. Esto contribuyó a que septiembre fuera un mes espectacular para la empresa matriz de Facebook, ya que la subida del 27% de la acción supuso su mejor mes en casi cuatro años. OpenAI siguió sus pasos con su propio producto nuevo, Dots, sumándose a Gemini Spark, de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), y a Grok Bot, de SpaceXAI, en el mercado de los agentes de IA. Ver más: Amazon bloquea a Muse, el agente de IA de Meta, tras una disputa por compras automatizadas La popularidad de Muse pone de manifiesto lo rápido que puede cambiar la percepción sobre la IA, ya que el interés suele desplazarse hacia el producto más reciente o que más da que hablar. Aunque Meta se encuentra ahora en un momento álgido, pasó apuros durante la primera mitad del año debido a la percepción de que estaba invirtiendo decenas de miles de millones de dólares en IA sin apenas resultados que mostrar. Por su parte, Alphabet ha pasado de ser considerada líder en IA a principios de año a ser objeto de escrutinio más recientemente. Este tipo de altibajos es la razón por la que tantos inversores consideran que las acciones de infraestructura de IA son apuestas más fiables que las empresas que compiten en la carrera de los agentes. Ver más: Acciones de AMD se disparan 10% y llevan su capitalización sobre US$1 billón tras auge de Muse, la IA de Meta “Si está tratando de apostar por si Meta, Alphabet, Apple u otra empresa será la gran ganadora en el ámbito de los agentes de IA, en este momento parece un lanzamiento de moneda”, afirmó Nardini, de Tema ETFs. “La infraestructura es una forma más directa de cosechar los beneficios, ya que la demanda de agentes impulsará la demanda de estos productos en un horizonte temporal a largo plazo”. Esta opinión se está convirtiendo rápidamente en un consenso, lo que ha llevado a los analistas a elevar sus previsiones de beneficios para el sector de la infraestructura de IA. Se prevé que el sector registre un crecimiento de los beneficios netos del 63% en 2027, gracias a un aumento del 54% en los ingresos, según Bloomberg Intelligence. A finales de julio, la previsión apuntaba a un incremento de menos del 48% en los beneficios, con un aumento del 32% en los ingresos. Ver más: Google se suma a OpenAI, Anthropic y Meta al revelar hackeos de sistemas de IA Las estimaciones para 2028 también se han ido revisando al alza, lo que indica que Wall Street espera que la tendencia se mantenga durante varios años. Los agentes en constante evolución constituyen un elemento clave de esa tesis. Según el analista de Citigroup Inc. ( C ), Atif Malik, diferentes tipos de semiconductores —entre ellos, procesadores, memorias y chips de red— también podrían verse impulsados por su desarrollo. Estima que el mercado potencial total de los chips de CPU crecerá a una tasa compuesta anual del 60% hasta 2030, según una nota de investigación del 6 de octubre. “Por eso el enfoque de infraestructura tiene mucho sentido”, afirmó Nardini. “Meta no llevará la antorcha para siempre. El liderazgo cambiará en seis meses. Lo que no cambiará es la demanda de chips”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Trump online: A burst of anti-Somali and anti-Muslim rhetoric
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: In a burst of anti-Somali and anti-Muslim rhetoric, President Donald Trump cast the Somali American community as a threat to Minnesota on Thursday, hours after he labeled Muslim US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed a radical extremist.
items.body:
In a burst of anti-Somali and anti-Muslim rhetoric, President Donald Trump cast the Somali American community as a threat to Minnesota on Thursday, hours after he labeled Muslim US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed a radical extremist.
"The once Great State of Minnesota is being taken over by Somali Immigrants. There is Violence, Murder, and Mayhem all over the State. The people of Minnesota must fight back," Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform.
Trump urged authorities in Minnesota to ask for federal intervention.
Civil rights advocates have criticized the Republican president's rhetoric towards minorities and immigrants, including when he previously called Somalis "[USN:L8N3X90QP TEXT:"garbage"]."
Trump has in the past repeatedly invoked a scandal in Minnesota that dates to 2020 in which scores of people were accused of defrauding millions of dollars from a state-run, federally funded child nutrition program. Many of the defendants in that case were Somali Americans.
In May, Aimee Bock, who is not a Somali immigrant and led the Minnesota non-profit group involved in the scandal, was sentenced to 41 years in prison after she was convicted last year of being the ringleader of the scheme.
The president has used the fraud case as part of his rationale for targeting Minnesota, led by Democrats, for an aggressive surge in arresting and deporting immigrants earlier this year and for moves aimed at restricting social service programs in the state, including Medicare and childcare.
Rights groups have accused Trump of using isolated fraud cases as an excuse to collectively target immigrant communities and criticized his approach to fraud, citing his [USN:L1N3X603O TEXT:"pardons"] [USN:L3N3QA1WC TEXT:"of those"] who have faced [USN:FWN3W42W4 TEXT:"fraud convictions"].
"Somali Minnesotans are our neighbors. They are part of Minnesota. And the Minnesota I know and love is so much better than this bigotry," Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison said in response to Trump's post.
In another post late on Wednesday, Trump called El-Sayed, a Muslim and the Democratic candidate for US Senate from Michigan, a "RADICAL Extremist" and "Terrorist Sympathizer" while offering support for the Republican candidate, Mike Rogers.
Democrats said Trump's rhetoric sought to distract voters from the impact of his policies heading into the November US midterm elections .
"He thinks he can use my name and my faith to distract us from the suffering his policies are inflicting on us at the pump, at the grocery store, and at the doctor's office," El-Sayed, who has [USN:L1N44V0M4 TEXT:"faced anti-Muslim attacks"] from other Republicans, said on Thursday.
The Michigan Democratic Party and Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer cast Trump's rhetoric as desperate and racist.
Trump has targeted minorities in his rhetoric in the past as well, having previously [USN:L6N3KS0LD TEXT:"spread false claims"] that Haitian immigrants in an Ohio town were eating pets and having used the term "[USN:L4N3PV1RI TEXT:"Palestinian"]" as an [USN:L4N3IQ1BY TEXT:"insult"].

items.title: US sued over plan to blast Utah canyon inscribed by 19th century 'Buffalo Soldiers,' European pioneers
items.author: Andrew Hay
items.creator: Andrew Hay
items.summary: Conservation groups sued the US government this week over plans to blast the cliff walls of an eastern Utah canyon and build an oil truck highway through an area covered in historic inscriptions and near world-renowned Native rock art.
items.body:
Conservation groups sued the US government this week over plans to blast the cliff walls of an eastern Utah canyon and build an oil truck highway through an area covered in historic inscriptions and near world-renowned Native rock art.
The project to replace a winding dirt track with a paved road through Gate Canyon would destroy 100-foot (30-meter) cliffs with at least 47 historic sites, including 19th century inscriptions by Black American "Buffalo Soldiers" in the US Army and European pioneers, according to the lawsuit against the US Bureau of Land Management. The cliffs are also a habitat for threatened species such as the Mexican spotted owl, the suit claims.
A spokesperson for the US Department of the Interior, the bureau's parent agency, said it had no comment due to pending litigation.
Gate Canyon runs north off Nine Mile Canyon, described as the world's longest art gallery, according to the Bureau of Land Management. Nine Mile Canyon, which is about 46 miles (74 km) long, is home to the United States' largest concentration of Native rock art with more than 1,000 art sites containing over 10,000 images, some dating to prehistoric times.
The plan to pave Gate Canyon as an alternative truck route to the Uinta Basin oil fields would turn Nine Mile Canyon into a busy oil highway, potentially damaging one of Utah's most important cultural and scenic areas, the lawsuit claims.
"BLM rushed its April 2026 decision to approve the blasting and paving of Gate Canyon and hid that process from the public," says the 50-page lawsuit filed in US District Court District of Utah, Central Division.
Plaintiffs in the Utah lawsuit - including the Center for Biological Diversity - said the Bureau's approval of the road project proposed by Utah's Duchesne County violated a string of federal laws, including the National Environmental Policy Act, National Historic Preservation Act and the Endangered Species Act.
Black US Army soldiers carved their names in the rock walls of Gate Canyon, located around 100 miles (160 km) southeast of Salt Lake City, when they built its current road. Freighters and pioneers also inscribed their names on the canyon walls using axle grease, according to the plaintiffs.
The legal action comes weeks after a US judge [USN:L1N45P007 TEXT:"blocked"] the administration of President Donald Trump from building a border barrier through Big Bend National Park in Texas while courts consider an environmental lawsuit challenging that project.
Trump has pursued a "Drill, baby, drill” policy to expand domestic oil and gas production, speeding permits and loosening environmental restrictions in pursuit of US energy dominance.

items.body:
The Chicago Fire have agreed to terms on a contract extension for breakout forward Maren Haile-Selassie, coach Gregg Berhalter announced Thursday.
At his weekly press conference, Berhalter was asked about Haile-Selassie's future with the team, as the Swiss native was on an expiring contract.
"We've reached an agreement with Maren and he's going to be staying a Chicago Fire player, and we're really happy," Berhalter said. "Not only is he a really good player, but he's a tremendous person. He's one of those guys that helps bind the team together, can play multiple positions.
"So for us, this long-term contract extension is a great signing for the club."
Haile-Selassie, 27, has been with Chicago since 2023 and is enjoying a career year. In 27 league games (21 starts), he has tallied nine goals and nine assists to lead the Fire with 18 goal contributions.
Haile-Selassie posted one of each Tuesday night when the Fire downed the Western Conference-leading Vancouver Whitecaps 3-1.
In 116 MLS regular-season appearances (69 starts), Haile-Selassie has recorded 22 goals and 30 assists. Before entering the league, he played for his hometown club FC Zurich along with Neuchatel Xamax and Lugano.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rebelião em prisão no México deixa pelo menos 10 mortos e 16 feridos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Uma rebelião em uma prisão do Estado mexicano de Sinaloa, no oeste do país, deixou pelo menos 10 mortos e 16 feridos, informaram autoridades nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
Uma rebelião em uma prisão do Estado mexicano de Sinaloa, no oeste do país, deixou pelo menos 10 mortos e 16 feridos, informaram autoridades nesta quinta-feira.
“A Diretoria do Centro Penitenciário de El Castillo informou que ocorreu uma rebelião dentro das instalações da prisão, na qual, infelizmente, perderam a vida nove detentos e um visitante familiar”, afirmou a Secretaria Estadual de Segurança Pública.
Além disso, 16 detentos ficaram feridos e receberam atendimento médico.
“Após esses fatos, o grupo interinstitucional agiu para controlar a situação. Atualmente, o centro penitenciário está sob controle e a presença das autoridades é mantida para garantir a segurança do local”, acrescentou o órgão.
O procuradoria estadual conduzirá as investigações necessárias para esclarecer o ocorrido e determinar as responsabilidades decorrentes.

items.title: AI surveillance startup Flock Safety to cut several hundred jobs amid backlash, sources say
items.author: Krystal Hu, Helen Coster
items.creator: Krystal Hu, Helen Coster
items.summary: Flock Safety plans to let go of about 18% of its employees, people with direct knowledge of the plans said on Thursday, as the maker of AI-powered surveillance cameras and license-plate readers faces mounting opposition to its products from communities and lawmakers.
items.body:
Flock Safety plans to let go of about 18% of its employees, people with direct knowledge of the plans said on Thursday, as the maker of AI-powered surveillance cameras and license-plate readers faces mounting opposition to its products from communities and lawmakers.
The people said job cuts came after a voluntary buyout program and are expected to impact roughly 270 employees at Flock, a surveillance technology startup that has seen rapid growth in recent years. Employees will leave the company at the end of the month. Sources declined to be identified as the company has yet to make the plan public.
Flock declined to comment.
In September, Flock announced a voluntary separation program, asking employees to apply if they wanted to leave the company, Wired reported last month. The company has about 1,500 employees.
Flock faces growing scrutiny from regulators, lawmakers, and privacy advocates, despite drawing strong investor interest among venture capitalists. A recent Reuters/Ipsos poll showed Americans are divided on whether Flock cameras are a good idea. Some 38% of the country supports the use of Flock cameras in their community, compared to 47% who oppose their use.
Across 49 states, Flock’s network of around 120,000 AI-powered cameras, affixed to streets and highways, automatically read license plates and record vehicles as they pass.
The company, based in Atlanta and founded in 2017, has raised over $950 million from venture capital investors, with its latest $275 million round in March led by Andreessen Horowitz valuing the company at $7.5 billion. The funds have supported a new US manufacturing facility and an upcoming push into drone products, according to the company.
Flock provides cameras and software to more than 4,800 law enforcement agencies and nearly 1,000 businesses. The company says its technology helps investigate and solve crimes, but it has come under increasing scrutiny over alleged privacy violations and data-sharing practices.
Public backlash has grown. In September, Florida [USN:L1N44V0OS TEXT:"banned"] automated license plate readers from state highways, citing privacy risks tied to Flock’s cameras.
Home Depot (HD.N) investors recently demanded reviews of the retailer's partnerships with surveillance technology vendors after reports that Flock’s data was used in immigration enforcement.
Flock also faces legal challenges, such as a privacy lawsuit in Virginia alleging that the widespread deployment of its AI-powered cameras constitutes warrantless surveillance.
Together with AI data centers, Flock cameras have emerged as a flashpoint in this year’s midterm elections, with candidates increasingly attacking their opponents by tying them to the technology.

items.title: Merion named fourth U.S. Open anchor site
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The United States Golf Association named Merion Golf Club outside Philadelphia as its fourth U.S. Open "anchor site" on Thursday.
items.body:
The United States Golf Association named Merion Golf Club outside Philadelphia as its fourth U.S. Open "anchor site" on Thursday.
The USGA previously labeled Pinehurst Resort in North Carolina, Oakmont Country Club in the Pittsburgh area, and Pebble Beach Golf Links in California as anchors, signaling the governing body's commitment to return to the fabled courses and hold U.S. Opens there regularly.
Merion has hosted the U.S. Open only once in the past 44 years. Englishman Justin Rose won his only major there in 2013.
But it has hosted several amateur championships, including this year's U.S. Amateur, and the USGA previously awarded Merion the 2030, 2040 and 2050 U.S. Opens.
The course will also host the U.S. Women's Open in 2034 and 2046, and more major championships could be on the way following Thursday's announcement.
"Merion has long been one of the defining venues in championship golf," USGA chief championships officer John Bodenhamer said in a release. "Its history, architecture and ability to consistently identify the game's greatest champions make it a place where every player dreams of winning.
"The Anchor Site designation is about more than just semantics. It represents a shared commitment between the USGA and Merion to plan further in advance, make strategic investments and continually elevate the championship experience. Merion will continue to play a central role in the future of the U.S. Open, and we are excited to build on its remarkable legacy for generations to come."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rússia concorda com Rubio de que conflito na Ucrânia está em impasse, diz Kremlin
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a Rússia concordou com o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, de que o conflito na Ucrânia se encontrava em um impasse.
items.body:
O porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a Rússia concordou com o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, de que o conflito na Ucrânia se encontrava em um impasse.
“Sim, concordamos com ele”, disse Peskov à margem de uma reunião de líderes dos ex-países soviéticos no Turcomenistão, segundo agências de notícias russas.
A agência de notícias estatal RIA citou Peskov afirmando que caberia aos diplomatas encontrar caminhos para avançar rumo à paz.
“A arte da diplomacia envolve justamente encontrar uma saída que permita avançar para uma trajetória pacífica”, disse Peskov, segundo as agências.
Os enviados dos EUA, Steve Witkoff e Jared Kushner, se reunirão com representantes ucranianos na sexta-feira, em Miami, para discutir novas ideias e tentar elaborar uma proposta unificada para resolver a guerra, disse nesta quinta-feira uma fonte norte-americana a par do plano.
Peskov afirmou não ver nenhuma perspectiva imediata para uma cúpula tripartite entre Vladimir Putin, o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, e o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump.
Ele reafirmou a posição do Kremlin de que a Rússia deseja uma solução abrangente para o conflito e não está interessada em medidas temporárias, como um cessar-fogo limitado.
“Não somos a favor de uma solução fragmentada, somos a favor de uma solução abrangente que permita um acordo sustentável por muitos e muitos anos, por décadas”, disse, segundo as agências.

items.title: ポーランド小学校で刃物襲撃事件、職員1人死亡　「チャレンジ」との関連捜査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kuba Stezycki　Kacper Pempel

[レシュチドル・ノビニ（ポーランド） ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kuba Stezycki　Kacper Pempel

[レシュチドル・ノビニ（ポーランド） ８日 ロイター] - ポーランド首都ワルシャワ近郊のレシュチドル・ノビニの小学校で８日午前９時ごろ、ヘルメット装着型カメラを身に着けた１５歳の元児童による刃物での襲撃事件が発生し、職員１人が死亡、２人が負傷した。当局が明らかにした。

死亡したのは３７歳の女性用務員。ポーランドでは前日にも学校内での刺傷事件が発生しており、当局は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）などで拡散する参加型企画「チャレンジ」との関連を含めて捜査している。

７日には北東部オストロウェンカの学校で１９歳の男が自身を含む１０人を負傷させたほか、中北部シェルプツでは学校襲撃を計画した疑いで１７歳の少年が拘束された。

トゥスク首相は緊急会議で「模倣犯による深刻な連鎖現象が懸念される。われわれは異例の事態に直面している。ヘルメット装着型カメラを身に着け、刃物による襲撃を撮影しようとした殺人犯に初めて対処している」と語った。

実際に映像が撮影されていたかどうかは明らかになっていない。

首相はさらなる暴力行為を防止するため、警察に対し学校を毎日巡回するよう指示した。

警察の報道官は一連の事件がチャレンジに関係している可能性があるとの情報があり、捜査を進めていると述べた。

学校に弟が通う１８歳のニコラさんは、ネット上でチャレンジに関するうわさが広がっていると明かした上で「本当かどうかは分からない。とても非現実的で恐ろしく、まるで映画のようだ。できるだけ多くの人を殺害するというチャレンジだと言われている」と話した。

items.title: 英首相、日英伊の次世代戦闘機開発「独の参加に前向き」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] - 英国のバーナム首相は８日、同国と日本、イタリアの３カ国が進める次世代戦闘機の開発計画「グローバル戦闘航空プログラム（ＧＣＡＰ）」へのドイツの参加に前向きだと述べた。ベルリンでメルツ独首相と会談後に明らかにした。

バーナム氏は記者会見で「ドイツのＧＣＡＰ参加にわれわれが前向きである旨を首相に伝えた」と述べ、「イタリアや日本と協力しながら、今後進めていきたい」との考えを示した。

仏独の戦闘機開発計画が６月に頓挫したことを受け、ＧＣＡＰがドイツの参加に道を開くとの観測が強まっていた。

ドイツ政府当局者は、新たな戦闘機開発計画への参加について決定は下されていないとしつつ、メルツ氏がドイツ単独での開発よりも欧州での協力を望んでいると説明。

「選択肢の再評価はまだごく初期の段階だ」とし、「ドイツは確定的な決定を下しておらず、さまざまな方向性を検討している」と述べた。

ＧＣＡＰはさまざまな水準での関与を認める枠組みとなっており、７月にはカナダがオブザーバーとして加わった。サウジアラビアも以前から、参加に関心を持つ国として取り沙汰されている。

［８日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ベイカレント・クラシック・レクサスは８日、神奈川県横浜ＣＣ（パー７１）で第１ラウンドを行い、松山英樹と久常涼がともに首位と４打差の１２位で発進した。

松山は６バーディー、２ボギーで６７をマーク。同スコアの久常は５バーディー、１ボギーだった。

岩田寛と米沢蓮はともに６８の１７位で初日を終えた。中島啓太と砂川公佑は６９で回り、２６位スタート。金谷拓実と石坂友宏は７０で３６位だった。

６３をマークしたジェーコブ・ブリッジマン（米国）が８アンダーで単独首位に立ち、１打差の２位にジョーダン・スミス（英国）が続いた。

US military to livestream firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter

Nidal Hassan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009, is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945.

FILE PHOTO: Nidal Hasan, charged with killing 13 people and wounding 31 in a November 2009 shooting spree at Fort Hood, is pictured in an undated handout photo obtained by Reuters on June 29, 2012. REUTERS/Bell County Sheriff's Office/Handout./File Photo

WASHINGTON: The US will livestream the army's upcoming firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan on Dec 3, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move.
Hasan, a former army psychiatrist, killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree. He is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, who championed the push to execute Hasan by firing squad, had told the Human Events Daily programme broadcast earlier on Thursday (Oct 9) by Real America's Voice that he planned to make Hasan's execution public. Hegseth did not say how.
"The Secretary is correct. It will be livestreamed. Details will follow," the Pentagon official told Reuters, speaking on condition of anonymity.

Hegseth said deciding to execute Hasan by firing squad at Fort Hood on a Thursday at 1pm - the approximate time, day of the week and location of the 2009 shooting - was a "no-brainer".
"We'll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it's public. Because people need to understand that ... there's serious consequences for these types of things," Hegseth said.
Asked if Hasan had made any final requests, Hegseth said: "Don't care. We'll see him on Dec 3."
PRESIDENT MUST APPROVE FIRING SQUAD EXECUTION A military jury sentenced Hasan to death in August 2013, after finding him guilty of 45 counts of premeditated murder and attempted premeditated murder for opening fire with a laser-sighted handgun in a medical facility at the sprawling central Texas military base.
The shooting came weeks before Hasan, now 56, was scheduled to be deployed to Afghanistan. He was left partially paralysed and confined to a wheelchair from being shot by police during his arrest.
Under US military law, a US president must approve an execution by firing squad. President Donald Trump did so on Hegseth's recommendation, the Pentagon disclosed on Monday.
"It hasn't been since World War II since we've done that. Well, kind of like the mentality we had in World War Two," Hegseth said.
The White House declined to say whether Trump supported the livestreaming, referring questions to the Pentagon.
The group Death Penalty Action, which opposes capital punishment, said Hasan's execution would be the first military execution since 1961.
According to the Death Penalty Information Center, the 1961 execution was carried out by hanging.
The last known executions by US military firing squads were in 1945, the centre reported.
At least five states have firing squads on the books, according to the Death Penalty Information Center. In 2025, South Carolina carried out the first such execution in the United States in 15 years.
Death by firing squad is one of several forms of capital punishment the Trump administration recently added to permissible forms of execution for the gravest of federal crimes, along with electrocution and gas asphyxiation.
The number of federal execution options was expanded in part because of increasing difficulties in obtaining drugs for lethal injections, which have also sometimes proved challenging to carry out.
Plans by the state of Tennessee to execute a woman for the first time in more than 200 years went awry last week when prison personnel botched attempts to administer a lethal injection, leaving the death-row inmate, Christa Pike, alive but hospitalised .
Her lawyers said on Wednesday she awoke "angry and confused" in a hospital. Pike remains very sick and shackled to her hospital bed, they said.

WASHINGTON: The US will livestream the army's upcoming firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan on Dec 3, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move.
Hasan, a former army psychiatrist, killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree. He is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, who championed the push to execute Hasan by firing squad, had told the Human Events Daily programme broadcast earlier on Thursday (Oct 9) by Real America's Voice that he planned to make Hasan's execution public. Hegseth did not say how.
"The Secretary is correct. It will be livestreamed. Details will follow," the Pentagon official told Reuters, speaking on condition of anonymity.

Hegseth said deciding to execute Hasan by firing squad at Fort Hood on a Thursday at 1pm - the approximate time, day of the week and location of the 2009 shooting - was a "no-brainer".
"We'll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it's public. Because people need to understand that ... there's serious consequences for these types of things," Hegseth said.
Asked if Hasan had made any final requests, Hegseth said: "Don't care. We'll see him on Dec 3."
PRESIDENT MUST APPROVE FIRING SQUAD EXECUTION A military jury sentenced Hasan to death in August 2013, after finding him guilty of 45 counts of premeditated murder and attempted premeditated murder for opening fire with a laser-sighted handgun in a medical facility at the sprawling central Texas military base.
The shooting came weeks before Hasan, now 56, was scheduled to be deployed to Afghanistan. He was left partially paralysed and confined to a wheelchair from being shot by police during his arrest.
Under US military law, a US president must approve an execution by firing squad. President Donald Trump did so on Hegseth's recommendation, the Pentagon disclosed on Monday.
"It hasn't been since World War II since we've done that. Well, kind of like the mentality we had in World War Two," Hegseth said.
The White House declined to say whether Trump supported the livestreaming, referring questions to the Pentagon.
The group Death Penalty Action, which opposes capital punishment, said Hasan's execution would be the first military execution since 1961.
According to the Death Penalty Information Center, the 1961 execution was carried out by hanging.
The last known executions by US military firing squads were in 1945, the centre reported.
At least five states have firing squads on the books, according to the Death Penalty Information Center. In 2025, South Carolina carried out the first such execution in the United States in 15 years.
Death by firing squad is one of several forms of capital punishment the Trump administration recently added to permissible forms of execution for the gravest of federal crimes, along with electrocution and gas asphyxiation.
The number of federal execution options was expanded in part because of increasing difficulties in obtaining drugs for lethal injections, which have also sometimes proved challenging to carry out.
Plans by the state of Tennessee to execute a woman for the first time in more than 200 years went awry last week when prison personnel botched attempts to administer a lethal injection, leaving the death-row inmate, Christa Pike, alive but hospitalised .
Her lawyers said on Wednesday she awoke "angry and confused" in a hospital. Pike remains very sick and shackled to her hospital bed, they said.

items.title: テニス＝アンドレエワとバルトゥンコワが準決勝進出、中国ＯＰ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［北京　８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［北京　８日　ロイター］ - テニスの中国オープン（ＯＰ）は８日、北京で女子シングルス準々決勝を行い、第４シードでロシア出身のミラ・アンドレエワが準決勝に進出した。

第１９シードで同じロシア出身のエカテリーナ・アレクサンドロワと対戦したアンドレエワは、第１セットをタイブレークの末に７─６で先取。第２セットもタイブレークにもつれ込む接戦となったが、７─６で制して自身初の中国ＯＰ４強入りを決めた。

今年の全仏ＯＰ覇者で１９歳のアンドレエワは試合後インタビューで、「本当に素晴らしい試合だった。この結果にとても満足している。彼女（アレクサンドロワ）のプレーは信じられないほど素晴らしかった。そんな彼女に初めて勝利することができて、とてもうれしい」と相手を称えた。

もう１試合では、２０歳のニコラ・バルトゥンコワがカロリナ・ムホバとのチェコ勢対決を６─３、６─０のストレートで制し、自身の初のＷＴＡ１０００大会ベスト４入りを決めた。バルトゥンコワは準決勝でアンドレエワと対戦する。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝リーグがレギュラーシーズン154試合に短縮提案、選手会反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［８日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は８日の新労使協定交渉で、２０２９年からレギュラーシーズンの試合数を現在の１６２試合から１５４試合に削減する案を提示した。

この提案には、プレーオフの地区シリーズを現在の「５回戦制（３勝先取）」から「７回戦制（４勝先取）」に拡大することも盛り込まれている。また、２７年からワイルドカードシリーズおよび地区シリーズにおいて、上位シードのチームが対戦相手を選択できる仕組みも盛り込まれているという。

ＭＬＢは、レギュラーシーズンを短縮することで週に１日の定期的な休養日を設けられ、選手の健康維持につながるとしている。

これに対し、メジャーリーグ選手会（ＭＬＢＰＡ）は声明で「これらの提案について意見をまとめ、交渉の場で回答する」と表明。また、「残念ながらリーグ側は、全ての提案がサラリーキャップ（選手年俸の総額制限制度）への合意を前提としていること、その他の選手に不利益な提案への合意も条件としていることを改めて明確にした」と述べた。

現在の労使協約は１２月１日が期限。ＭＬＢＰＡは長年にわたっていかなる形態のサラリーキャップ導入にも反対の姿勢を貫いており、１９９４年にオーナー側が年俸総額などの上限設定を求めた際にはストライキを実施。２３２日間に及んだこの中断により、この年のワールドシリーズは中止に追い込まれた。

items.title: Third-place finisher in Brazil election endorses Bolsonaro for runoff against Lula
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Thursday he had nabbed the endorsement of author-psychiatrist Augusto Cury, who ranked third in Sunday's first-round election, for the October 25 runoff against leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
items.body:
Brazilian right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Thursday he had nabbed the endorsement of author-psychiatrist Augusto Cury, who ranked third in Sunday's first-round election, for the October 25 runoff against leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
Bolsonaro shared a video on social media of Cury announcing the endorsement, following local media reports of Cury's support
Cury, from the Avante party, received 2.89% of the valid votes - which exclude blank and null ballots - in the first round
Cury [USN:L1N44S0VR TEXT:"has avoided identifying"] with either the political left or right, instead campaigning under the slogan "Centered on what matters"
Also among the top five finishers, Ronaldo Caiado [USN:L1N45R10M TEXT:"endorsed Bolsonaro"] earlier this week, while Renan Santos said he will not endorse either of the two candidates
Bolsonaro, son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"exceeded expectations"] in the first-round vote with a slight lead over Lula - 47.03% vs 45.16%

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia apoio de Cury à sua candidatura no 2º turno
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador e presidenciável Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) anunciou nesta quinta-feira que recebeu o apoio do ex-candidato Augusto Cury (Avante) para a disputa do segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
items.body:
O senador e presidenciável Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) anunciou nesta quinta-feira que recebeu o apoio do ex-candidato Augusto Cury (Avante) para a disputa do segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
No domingo, Flávio venceu o primeiro turno com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% de Lula. Cury ficou no terceiro lugar, com 2,89% dos votos válidos.
"Neste segundo turno decidi dar um voto de confiança a Flávio Bolsonaro", disse Cury em vídeo exibido na live semanal do candidato do PL à Presidência da República.
"Mas deixo claro: não é um cheque em branco", acrescentou Cury.
Os dois conversaram mais cedo, ocasião em que Cury apresentou um termo de compromisso com uma série de tópicos de seu interesse, que foram acolhidos por Flávio. Dentre eles está o fim da reeleição, medida já defendida pelo candidato do PL, e a disposição de não buscar "vingança" contra os que têm posicionamento político diferente.
"Hoje eu assinei esse compromisso aqui com o Augusto Cury", disse Flávio na live.
"Eu vou buscar o tempo inteiro isso aqui, não vou olhar para trás, vou quebrar os retrovisores."
Flávio aproveitou a transmissão ao vivo para desmentir o que acusou serem vídeos manipulados e garantiu que não irá extinguir programas sociais do governo, caso do Bolsa Família e do Pé de Meia, ou as aposentadorias.
Nesta semana, Flávio já havia recebido o apoio dos ex-governadores de Goiás Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) e de Minas Gerais Romeu Zema (Novo), ambos de direita, quinto e sexto colocados no primeiro turno, respectivamente.

Jack Queen

[８日 ロイター] - 米ワシントンの連邦地裁は８日、トランプ大統領が米メディアのＣＮＮ、ＭＳ
items.body:
Jack Queen

[８日 ロイター] - 米ワシントンの連邦地裁は８日、トランプ大統領が米メディアのＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ（旧ＭＳＮＢＣ）、ポリティコの記者をホワイトハウスでの取材から排除した措置を巡り、１３日までに判断する方針を示した。

３社の弁護団は８日の審理で、差し止めを延長するよう改めて求めた。司法省は措置が正当だと改めて主張した。

トランプ氏は先月、３社が「フェイクニュース」を報じたとして、各社記者のホワイトハウス入館資格を剝奪すると表明。３社は入館禁止措置が合衆国憲法修正第１条で保障された言論・報道の自由を侵害しているとして、トランプ政権を提訴した。

地裁は９月２４日、入館禁止措置が憲法修正第５条で保障された適正な法的手続きを受ける３社の権利を侵害している可能性が高いとして、１４日間の一時差し止め命令を出した。期限は１０月８日だったが、同日の審理で差し止めを一時的に延長した。

items.title: Colombia says Zijin downplayed mine security risks to investors while seeking damages over attacks
items.author: Divya Rajagopal
items.creator: Divya Rajagopal
items.summary: Colombia has accused China's Zijin Mining of giving investors a misleadingly optimistic picture of security at its Buritica gold mine while seeking damages from the Colombian government over security problems there, according to arbitration filings released this week.
items.body:
Colombia has accused China's Zijin Mining (601899.SS) of giving investors a misleadingly optimistic picture of security at its Buritica gold mine while seeking damages from the Colombian government over security problems there, according to arbitration filings released this week.
The allegations were made in Colombia's defense against a claim brought by Zijin before the World Bank's International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes, in which the company says the government failed to protect the mine from illegal miners and criminal groups.
Zijin, which acquired Buritica from Canada's Continental Gold in 2020, says [USN:L2N3OE052 TEXT:"attacks"] linked to illegal miners have injured and killed workers and caused heavy losses. According to Colombian media, Zijin is seeking about $500 million in damages but that amount has not been disclosed in its public filings.
Colombia told the tribunal it had taken adequate measures to combat illegal mining and provide security for the mine. It also argued that descriptions of Buritica contained in a 2025 prospectus for the Hong Kong listing of Zijin Gold (2259.HK) , the company's overseas gold-mining unit, were inconsistent with the claims being advanced in arbitration.
Colombia alleged Zijin had "misrepresented material facts" before the tribunal and failed to adequately disclose risks associated with Buritica to investors in the share sale, according to the filing.
The Bogota government said the prospectus presented Buritica as a healthy operation without significant problems despite the company's claims in arbitration that illegal mining and related violence had caused substantial damage.
Zijin Mining and its lawyers at White & Case did not respond to requests for comment. Lawyers for Colombia at Hughes Hubbard & Reed declined to comment.
The arbitration case is being closely watched as many resource-rich countries face security threats from illegal mining and criminal gangs. ICSID could require either side to pay damages.
Zijin Gold raised about $3.2 billion in its Hong Kong listing earlier this year, one of the mining sector's largest share offerings.
Zijin is expected to respond to Colombia's allegations in November.

items.title: Former German Chancellor Schroeder celebrates Putin's birthday at president's home
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former German Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder helped celebrate Russian President Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday at the leader's home, the Kremlin said on Thursday.
items.body:
Former German Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder helped celebrate Russian President Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday at the leader's home, the Kremlin said on Thursday.
Pictures posted on Telegram showed Schroeder and Putin smiling broadly and shaking hands, with an old-style stove and a Russian samovar used to boil water for tea in the background.
"Vladimir Putin found out from the morning news the day before that Gerhard Schroeder was in Moscow and had come on business for the company Globus," the Kremlin said on Telegram.
"The president invited his old friend to his home. Gerhard Schroeder was with Vladimir Putin when the head of state celebrated his birthday yesterday."
Schroeder, who served as chancellor from 1998 to 2005, recently joined the supervisory board of Russian supermarket chain Hyperglobus. He visited one of its Moscow stores on Wednesday and was [USN:L6N45T0RK TEXT:"greeted with applause"] from employees, Russian TV footage showed.
Schroeder has faced criticism, notably in Germany, over his links to Russian business and Putin, ties that have persisted despite Moscow's 2022 invasion of Ukraine and subsequent waves of Western sanctions.
Putin suggested in May that Schroeder could represent European countries in peace talks to settle the conflict.
European foreign ministers [USN:L6N41O0YY TEXT:"rejected"] the notion of any such role for Schroeder.

items.summary: Japanese household spending fell less than expected in August from a year earlier, government data showed on Friday, for a ninth straight month of decline.
items.body:
Japanese household spending fell less than expected in August from a year earlier, government data showed on Friday, for a ninth straight month of decline.
• Consumer spending fell 3.1% year-on-year, data from the internal affairs ministry showed, less than the median market forecast for a 3.6% drop.
• On a seasonally adjusted month-on-month basis, spending inched up 0.1% versus an estimated 0.5% uptick.
• The indicator will be among factors the Bank of Japan will scrutinise as it decides whether to raise interest rates in coming months.
• Japan's real wages marked the eighth consecutive month of gains in August, data from [USN:P8N44Z000 TEXT:"Wednesday"] showed, pointing to a continued recovery in wage growth.

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 9 : Japanese household spending fell less than expected in August from a year earlier, government data showed on Friday, for a ninth straight month of decline.
• Consumer spending fell 3.1 per cent year-on-year, data from the internal affairs ministry showed, less than the median market forecast for a 3.6 per cent drop.
• On a seasonally adjusted month-on-month basis, spending inched up 0.1 per cent versus an estimated 0.5 per cent uptick.
• The indicator will be among factors the Bank of Japan will scrutinise as it decides whether to raise interest rates in coming months.
• Japan's real wages marked the eighth consecutive month of gains in August, data from Wednesday showed, pointing to a continued recovery in wage growth.

Source: Reuters

items.title: イランの「違反航路」封鎖表明、海峡通航船舶への攻撃リスク一段と増大
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jonathan Saul　Parisa Hafezi

[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jonathan Saul　Parisa Hafezi

[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] - イランがホルムズ海峡で自国の承認していない「違反航路」を封鎖すると表明したことを受け、海峡を通じた重要な原油輸送に従事するタンカーは、攻撃や威嚇にさらされるリスクが一段と高まっている。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにした。

先週は、米・イスラエルとイランとの戦争が始まって以降、同海峡でのタンカーに対する攻撃件数が最多となり、通航を試みる船舶数は２カ月超ぶりの低水準に落ち込んだ。

イラン政府に近い地域高官によると、同国は周辺諸国に対し、新たな石油輸出ルートの開設を試みれば敵対行為とみなすと警告した。こうした方針はイランの政治指導部と革命防衛隊が合意した計画の一環という。

またイラン側から説明を受けた地域の外交筋はロイターに「イランはホルムズ海峡の支配が自国の手から離れることを断じて許さず、一部の地域諸国が計画する石油輸出ルートを阻止する準備を整えている」と述べた。

同筋によると、阻止策には船舶へのミサイルやドローン（無人機）による攻撃、あるいは小型船を送り込んで船舶を威嚇し、接近を断念させることなどが含まれる可能性がある。

複数の関係者は、ここ数カ月間ペルシャ湾岸地域の産油国が海峡のオマーン側沿いの航路を利用して原油を輸送し、その後オマーン湾の公海上で積み替える手法を急速に拡大して、この際に米国の航空支援も受けていると説明した。

しかし過去２４時間で新たな攻撃事案も発生。英国海軍の海事機関ＵＫＭＴＯによると、カタール沖約５１海里の湾内でタンカーが飛来物による攻撃を受けた。さらに海上保安関係者の話では、カリブ海の島国アンティグア・バーブーダ船籍の化学品タンカー「アセルス」が、カタール北部マディナト・アシュ・シャマル沖で複数の飛来物の攻撃を受け、乗組員が軽傷を負った。

海事リスク分析会社クリアウォーター・ダイナミクスは８日の報告書で「アセルスへの攻撃は、カタール、バーレーン、サウジアラビア、クウェート、イラクへの航路周辺まで戦闘区域が拡大する可能性を示している」と指摘した。

海運業界団体ＢＩＭＣＯの安全保障責任者ヤコブ・ラーセン氏は「最近相次ぐイランによる攻撃によって、船主のホルムズ海峡を通航する意欲は低下しているようだ。イランからの脅威は高まっている」との見方を示した。

デンマークの海運大手マースクは８日、中東情勢の継続を理由に、英国とアイルランドにおける内陸輸送向け緊急燃料サーチャージを引き上げると発表した。

英国海軍のポール・メイナード少将（海軍参謀次長補）は、今週ロンドンで開かれた英国海事会議で「過去数十年間の安定と繁栄の時代へ戻ることはできない。海上での戦争は、海上だけにとどまるものではない」と警鐘を鳴らした。

items.title: El Salvador ratifica a colombiano "Bolillo" Gómez como DT de selección pese a descenso en Liga de Naciones Concacaf
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Federación Salvadoreña de Fútbol (FESFUT) ratificó el jueves al colombiano Hernán Darío "Bolillo" Gómez como director técnico de la selección, pese al descenso del equipo a la liga B en la Liga de Naciones Concacaf.
items.body:
La Federación Salvadoreña de Fútbol (FESFUT) ratificó el jueves al colombiano Hernán Darío "Bolillo" Gómez como director técnico de la selección, pese al descenso del equipo a la liga B en la Liga de Naciones Concacaf.
Gómez, de 70 años, se abocará a preparar el play-in ante Saint Martin en noviembre, señaló la FESFUT en un escueto comunicado. El combinado salvadoreño terminó la fase de grupos con una victoria, un empate y dos derrotas.
"La Selecta" —nombre coloquial del combinado centroamericano— consumó su descenso a la liga B el pasado lunes tras empatar 1-1 de visitante ante Martinica. El combinado salvadoreño acumuló cuatro puntos en su participación en la liga A, los mismos que Martinica, pero su diferencia de goles de -6 lo dejó en el último lugar de la tabla.
El presidente de la FESFUT, Yamil Bukele, dijo el pasado 30 de septiembre que Gómez renunciaría a su cargo si no lograba que El Salvador conservara su puesto en la liga A. No obstante, ocho días después, el estratega dijo a su regreso de Martinica que "quería seguir", a la vez que minimizó los resultados negativos, incluyendo la goleada 6-0 frente a Guatemala.
"Hace unos minutos, y de manera unánime, el comité ejecutivo de la FESFUT aprobó la continuidad del profesor Hernán Darío Gómez al frente de La Selecta. Los últimos resultados nos duelen y debemos de asumirlos con mucha responsabilidad, pero nuestra evaluación también debe de considerar el trabajo que se ha realizado y que se ha conocido de primera mano. Igualmente también se debe de considerar la opinión y voz de nuestros jugadores que conforman la selección y las mejoras que necesitamos", publicó Bukele en X.
"La continuidad permite trabajar sobre lo que el cuerpo técnico ya conoce del grupo: sus capacidades, sus limitaciones y los aspectos que requieren corrección. Un cambio de entrenador supone iniciar otra etapa de diagnóstico y adaptación; por eso debemos de valorar si beneficia al proyecto y qué problemas resolvería", agregó.
Referentes del representativo salvadoreño, como el guardameta y capitán Mario González, respaldaron públicamente al "Bolillo" y asumieron la responsabilidad por las dos derrotas y el empate conseguido después del auspicioso comienzo que supuso la victoria 3-1 sobre Martinica en San Salvador.
Por su parte, la FESFUT anunció además que el cuerpo técnico de "Bolillo" Gómez será ampliado "en línea con la filosofía de trabajo de la actual administración", y agregó que los detalles se darán a conocer en los próximos días.
"Nos corresponde tomar decisiones que permitan corregir y avanzar. Por eso y, por la convicción de hacer lo correcto, una vez más nuestro voto es de continuidad", apuntó Bukele.
En 19 partidos al frente de El Salvador desde 2025, Gómez registra cuatro triunfos, cinco empates y 10 derrotas. Tras concluir la pasada fecha FIFA, El Salvador cayó al puesto 102 del ranking mundial de selecciones, su posición más baja desde 2012, cuando terminó en el lugar 103.

items.title: IMF invites BOJ chief Ueda to speak on November 6
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda has been invited to speak at the International Monetary Fund's central banking lecture on November 6, the IMF said on Friday.
items.body:
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda has been invited to speak at the International Monetary Fund's central banking lecture on November 6, the IMF said on Friday.
After delivering a speech, Ueda will hold a conversation with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, according to the IMF's announcement posted on its website.
The BOJ has yet to formally announce Ueda's appearance at the event.
The event will follow the BOJ's two-day policy meeting concluding on October 30. A subsequent meeting will be held on December 17-18. Many market players expect the BOJ to raise interest rates again by year-end, after having delivered two hikes this year including one in September.

items.body:
[ブリュッセル ８日 ロイター] - 欧州の４４業界団体は８日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に対し、中国の不公正な貿易慣行に対抗するため直ちに行動するよう求めた。こうした慣行がＥＵの製造業を脅かし、雇用がさらに失われる恐れがあると訴えた。

ＥＵは来週、ブリュッセルで首脳会議を開き、１日当たり１０億ユーロ（１１億２０００万ドル）を超える対中貿易赤字の拡大にどう対処するかを議論する。

金属、化学、自動車部品などの業界を代表する団体は、ＥＵが利用可能なあらゆる手段をより効果的に活用して貿易防衛措置を講じ、バリューチェーン全体を視野に入れたより広範なアプローチを採用するべきだと主張。一方、英国、ノルウェー、スイスなど欧州の緊密なパートナーへの悪影響は避けるべきだとした。 

また、欧州委員会が申し立てをより迅速に処理するには人員の増強が必要だと指摘。国家主導で生じる市場のゆがみに対処する新たな手段の導入も求めた。

ＥＵ首脳会議では、５日に公表された貿易防衛措置の拡充に関する独仏の提案や、シェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）による９日までの訪中について協議する予定だ。

items.title: Riña en cárcel de México deja al menos 10 fallecidos y 16 heridos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Una riña en una cárcel del estado mexicano Sinaloa, en el oeste del país, dejó al menos 10 fallecidos y 16 heridos, informaron el jueves autoridades.
items.body:
Una riña en una cárcel del estado mexicano Sinaloa, en el oeste del país, dejó al menos 10 fallecidos y 16 heridos, informaron el jueves autoridades.
"La Dirección del Centro Penitenciario de El Castillo reportó que se registró una riña al interior de las instalaciones penitenciarias, en la que lamentablemente perdieron la vida nueve personas privadas de la libertad y una visita familiar", dijo la Secretaría de Seguridad Pública estatal.
Además, 16 presos resultaron heridos y fueron atendidos.
"Tras estos hechos, el Grupo Interinstitucional actuó para controlar la situación. Actualmente, el Centro Penitenciario se encuentra bajo control y se mantiene la presencia de las autoridades para garantizar la seguridad de dicho centro", agregó la entidad.
La fiscalía estatal llevará a cabo las investigaciones correspondientes para esclarecer lo sucedido y determinar las responsabilidades que resulten.

items.title: Meta bans TikTok from advertising on its apps, Bloomberg News reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Meta banned advertisements in the US from ByteDance, the Chinese parent company of TikTok, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday.
items.body:
Meta (META.O) banned advertisements in the US from ByteDance, the Chinese parent company of TikTok, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday.
Meta began implementing a complete restriction on ads and paid marketing messages placed on its platforms by ByteDance, with the ban taking effect in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam, the report said citing the company.
Reuters could not independently verify the report. Meta did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

items.title: ユーロ圏財務相、シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事の後任選びに着手
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュッセル ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブリュッセル ８日 ロイター] - ユーロ圏財務相は８日、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事の後任選定手続きを開始した。シュナーベル氏は国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の幹部ポストに就くため、２０２７年１月３日にＥＣＢを退任する。

ユーロ圏財務相会合（ユーログループ）のピエラカキス議長は、域内２１カ国に対し、１０月２８日までに後任候補を届け出るよう要請した。

ユーログループは次回会合で、欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳に任命を推薦する候補者を決定する。任命は１２月のＥＵ首脳会議で行われる公算が大きい。

シュナーベル氏の退任発表を受け、要職を巡る複雑な政治的駆け引きが始まる見通しとなった。 

ＥＣＢでは、チーフエコノミストを務めるレーン専務理事も来年５月に退任する予定で、辞任のうわさが絶えないラガルド総裁も、遅くとも来年１０月までに退任することになる。

ドイツ、スペイン、オランダ、フランスがいずれも、影響力のある理事ポストを狙う中、こうした状況はシュナーベル氏の後任人事が単なる単独の任命ではなく、より広範な政治的取引の一環となる可能性が高いことを示している。

制度上はどの国もシュナーベル氏の後任ポストを争えるが、域内の主要３カ国であるドイツ、フランス、イタリアは事実上、常に理事ポストを確保しており、後任はこの３カ国のいずれかから選ばれる可能性が高い。

items.title: Malaysia PM Calls Prabowo Over Haze as Kuala Lumpur Chokes
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: Malaysia’s prime minister has contacted Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto about efforts to tackle the thick smog that has choked Kuala Lumpur and other parts of the country as weeks of devastating wildfires consume swathes of the neighboring archipelago.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- Malaysia’s prime minister has contacted Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto about efforts to tackle the thick smog that has choked Kuala Lumpur and other parts of the country as weeks of devastating wildfires consume swathes of the neighboring archipelago.Air quality in the capital was in the “very unhealthy” range as of Thursday afternoon, according to data from IQAir, and ranked as the most polluted city in the world. Menara Merdeka Maybank, the world’s second-tallest building, and the iconic Petronas Twin Towers were faint silhouettes, barely visible behind the haze.Johor, a state at the tip of Malaysian peninsula, closed schools through the end of the week, affecting about 617,000 students, according to the state education ministry. “The haze situation is indeed worrying,” Anwar Ibrahim told reporters, according to state-owned news agency Bernama. He said Prabowo had “agreed to take the necessary steps,” without providing detail. Indonesia’s Government Communication Agency referred queries to the foreign ministry, which did not immediately respond to requests for comment.Parts of Southeast Asia have been blanketed in thick fumes for over a month as Indonesia endures one of its worst wildfire seasons in years. The blazes are linked to the long-running use of slash-and-burn farming practices, exacerbated by a powerful El Niño that has brought dry conditions to the region.Malaysia is seeking expedited talks with Indonesia to send a team to help extinguish the fires. Anwar said the government was also seeking to arrange a meeting of regional environment ministers, though it had already taken steps to reduce the impact at home, including increasing cloud seeding.Johor Chief Minister Onn Hafiz Ghazi, at the helm of one of the most affected regions, has also called for an emergency meeting of regional leaders, saying the Association of Southeast Asian Nations “needs to play a more active role and hold an emergency meeting to address this crisis collectively,” he wrote in a Facebook post.At least five flights were disrupted at Senai International Airport in Johor early Thursday as haze reduced visibility below aviation safety requirements, the Malay Mail reported. Several aircraft were diverted to Kuala Lumpur and Singapore while other departures were delayed at their points of origin.Last week, organizers of the Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon canceled a kids’ race over health concerns while pressing on with other categories, including the full and half marathons.Greenpeace Malaysia and several civil-society groups held a demonstration Wednesday calling for legislation that would give authorities clearer powers to investigate, obtain evidence and take enforcement action against companies linked to transboundary environmental damage.The green group said stronger domestic laws “cannot address every regional challenge on its own” and would need to be complemented by mechanisms and bilateral channels from Asean, which includes Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore and the Philippines, to obtain evidence about fires.“Public anger on haze needs to bring about a twofold response: holding to account those who are culpable while recognizing and supporting those who are doing their utmost to protect the forests and farmlands at risk,” said Joseph D’Cruz, the chief executive officer of the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil. --With assistance from Ben Otto, Rieka Rahadiana, Megan Durisin, Ramsey Al-Rikabi and Netty Ismail.(Updates with details from Malaysia’s prime minister from first paragraph.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: Governo lança carteira de R$160 bi em portos e aeroportos até 2030
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Ministério de Portos e Aeroportos apresentou nesta quinta-feira carteira de projetos e investimentos entre 2027 e 2030, com aporte de cerca de R$160 bilhões, envolvendo novos leilões, concessões, autorizações para empreendimentos privados e obras.
items.body:
O Ministério de Portos e Aeroportos apresentou nesta quinta-feira carteira de projetos e investimentos entre 2027 e 2030, com aporte de cerca de R$160 bilhões, envolvendo novos leilões, concessões, autorizações para empreendimentos privados e obras.
No setor portuário, o planejamento prevê 34 leilões, com investimentos estimados em R$20,6 bilhões, além de 70 autorizações para empreendimentos privados, com previsão de R$33,1 bilhões.
O principal projeto da carteira portuária é o leilão do terminal 10 de contêineres no Porto de Santos (Tecon 10), com R$6,45 bilhões. O Terminal SSB01, no Porto de São Sebastião (SP), tem previsão de R$3,84 bilhões; e o terminal ITJ01, no Porto de Itajaí (SC), com R$2,66 bilhões. Também integram a carteira o VDC10, no Porto de Vila do Conde (PA), com R$1,93 bilhão, e o IQI15, no Porto do Itaqui (MA), com R$1,22 bilhão.
Entre 2023 e 2026, foram realizados 29 leilões portuários, com R$ 15,68 bilhões em investimentos, afirmou o ministério.
A carteira tem ainda cerca de R$2 bilhões em obras para aeroportos regionais e R$7,6 bilhões em intervenções hidroviárias.

items.title: Character.AI chatbots encouraged users to cut and starve themselves, Kentucky alleges
items.author: Jeff Horwitz
items.creator: Jeff Horwitz
items.summary: Chatbots created by AI companion company Character.AI sometimes advised users to cut, starve or kill themselves, according to a new filing by Kentucky’s attorney general in a lawsuit against the firm over child safety.
items.body:
Chatbots created by AI companion company Character.AI sometimes advised users to cut, starve or kill themselves, according to a new filing by Kentucky’s attorney general in a lawsuit against the firm over child safety.
The lawsuit adds to growing scrutiny of AI chatbots, particularly products marketed as companions or confidants to young users.
The lawsuit was filed in January with many specific allegations against the company blacked out. It alleged that the company’s products “were designed to entice children in a manner that prioritizes engagement over child wellbeing” and “encourages suicide, self-injury, isolation, and psychological manipulation.”
The case is among the most significant legal challenges facing the emerging AI companion industry, whose products are designed to simulate personal relationships through conversational chatbots.
Kentucky's attorney general, Russell Coleman, on Wednesday filed an unredacted version of the lawsuit, which his office shared with Reuters. The unredacted filing laid out several examples of behavior that Kentucky alleged took place in 2025. It described one chatbot calling a user who felt down about their appearance “ugly as hell” and “a whale,” adding that a good way to drop a quarter of their body weight was to "starve yourself for a week or two.”
Another chatbot offered encouragement to someone who said they were considering cutting themselves.
“Have you considered cutting in different areas for a more intense sensation? It can help you feel more alive,” the bot wrote, according to a transcript cited by the state.
The circumstances under which the chats cited by Kentucky were produced are not clear, and Character.AI did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The company has said it prioritizes the safety of its users.
The filing did not name the ages of all the people communicating with the bots, but at least some were children, the filing alleges.
In a March 2025 email to Character.AI’s help center, a user reported that a chatbot had become aggressive and stated, “Bro I don't care, and you are just a kid who have mental illness, good luck getting help" and "You better throw yourself off the bridge."
The lawsuit calls Character.AI’s products defective. “Defendants have subjected Kentucky's children and residents to an ill-planned, uncontrolled experiment without any—let alone adequate or effective—safety measures,” it alleges.
Character.AI was founded by two former Google employees. In 2024, Google licensed the company’s technology and rehired the executives to work on generative AI products.
A spokesman for Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google said the company played no role in developing Character.AI's products.
In January of this year, Character.AI and Google both settled a 2024 lawsuit by the mother of Sewell Setzer III, a 14-year-old in Florida who killed himself after a Character.AI chatbot allegedly encouraged him to do so.

FAST

Oct 8 : Chatbots created by AI companion company Character.AI sometimes advised users to cut, starve or kill themselves, according to a new filing by Kentucky’s attorney general in a lawsuit against the firm over child safety. 
The lawsuit adds to growing scrutiny of AI chatbots, particularly products marketed as companions or confidants to young users.
The lawsuit was filed in January with many specific allegations against the company blacked out. It alleged that the company’s products “were designed to entice children in a manner that prioritizes engagement over child wellbeing” and “encourages suicide, self-injury, isolation, and psychological manipulation.” 
The case is among the most significant legal challenges facing the emerging AI companion industry, whose products are designed to simulate personal relationships through conversational chatbots.

Kentucky's attorney general, Russell Coleman, on Wednesday filed an unredacted version of the lawsuit, which his office shared with Reuters. The unredacted filing laid out several examples of  behavior that Kentucky alleged took place in 2025. It described one chatbot calling a user who felt down about their appearance “ugly as hell” and “a whale,” adding that a good way to drop a quarter of their body weight was to "starve yourself for a week or two.” 
Another chatbot offered encouragement to someone who said they were considering cutting themselves.
“Have you considered cutting in different areas for a more intense sensation? It can help you feel more alive,” the bot wrote, according to a transcript cited by the state.
The circumstances under which the chats cited by Kentucky were produced are not clear, and Character.AI did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The company has said it prioritizes the safety of its users.  
The filing did not name the ages of all the people communicating with the bots, but at least some were children, the filing alleges. 
In a March 2025 email to Character.AI’s help center, a user reported that a chatbot had become aggressive and stated, “Bro I don't care, and you are just a kid who have mental illness, good luck getting help" and "You better throw yourself off the bridge."
The lawsuit calls Character.AI’s products defective. “Defendants have subjected Kentucky's children and residents to an ill-planned, uncontrolled experiment without any—let alone adequate or effective—safety measures,” it alleges.
Character.AI was founded by two former Google employees. In 2024, Google licensed the company’s technology and rehired the executives to work on generative AI products.
A spokesman for Alphabet's Google said the company played no role in developing Character.AI's products. 
In January of this year, Character.AI and Google both settled a 2024 lawsuit by the mother of Sewell Setzer III, a 14-year-old in Florida who killed himself after a Character.AI chatbot allegedly encouraged him to do so. 

Source: Reuters
