items.title: Protesters stage 'I Am Jane Doe' rally in New York City against sexual violence
items.author: Maria Tsvetkova
items.creator: Maria Tsvetkova
items.summary: Protesters calling for tougher action against sexual violence rallied on Thursday outside the New York City courthouse where a Cornell University student stirred a national uproar by suing several campus fraternity members she accused of gang rape.
items.body:
Protesters calling for tougher action against sexual violence rallied on Thursday outside the New York City courthouse where a Cornell University student stirred a national uproar by suing several campus fraternity members she accused of gang rape.
The demonstration, drawing a crowd of hundreds to the New York State Supreme Court building in Manhattan, was one of dozens of protests organized on campuses and in communities across the country under the social media banner "#StopSexualViolence: From the Frat House to the White House."
Several hundred people, mostly women, displayed banners reading “I am Jane Doe. Be afraid of me,” “Death to rape culture” and “This is personal” outside the New York Supreme Court in downtown Manhattan, where the Cornell student identified in court documents as Jane Doe filed a lawsuit against her alleged rapists.
“It's entirely frustrating that we are here in 2026 and still dealing with this,” said one of the protesters, Brianna Williams, 40, who works for a nonprofit. “It's just an infuriating moment.”
In a lawsuit filed last month, a Cornell student identified by the pseudonym Jane Doe said she had been plied with drugs and alcohol, then sexually assaulted by members of the campus chapter of the Chi Phi fraternity while she was incapacitated in October 2024.
Doe, who was 20 at the time, named seven Chi Phi members as defendants in the suit, along with the fraternity, a local bar, her own sorority, and the Ivy League university, which she accused of failing to adequately investigate and punish students who were involved.
The lawsuit specifically criticized the university for having offered some of the alleged perpetrators a chance to mitigate their penalties by writing essays.
Doe had reported the alleged assault to police several weeks after the fact, leading to an internal university investigation and a law enforcement probe, but the local prosecutor declined to bring criminal charges in the case.
Since the woman's civil suit was filed, prosecutors reopened a criminal investigation, and New York Governor Kathy Hochul appointed the state's attorney general as special prosecutor in the case. Cornell University hired Sally Yates, a top former US Justice Department lawyer, to lead an independent review of how the school handled the allegations.
NATIONAL OUTCRY Cornell, which has defended its response to the original report, shut down the Chi Phi chapter and imposed a range of discipline on the fraternity members found to be involved, including expulsions of some.
The men named in the suit have all denied any wrongdoing, some saying the sexual activity was consensual and others disputing their participation.
The suit ignited a renewed national outcry against sexual violence and harassment, especially on college campuses, with women taking to the streets in "I Am Jane Doe" protests of solidarity. "I Am Jane Doe" was also a rallying cry for Thursday's scheduled demonstrations in cities including Washington, Philadelphia, Boston, Denver, Salt Lake City, Los Angeles and San Francisco.
Some activists have pointed to comments from President Donald Trump about his behavior toward women and a jury verdict finding him liable for sexual abuse of writer E. Jean Carroll as contributing to a "culture of rape" in the US.
Thousands of students, faculty and community activists marched on Monday through the Cornell campus in Ithaca, New York, demanding that the school administration take firmer action against sexual violence on campus.
The identity of Jane Doe has become part of the conversation. Women on social media have been [USN:L6N45O14X TEXT:"posting #IamJaneDoe"] in solidarity with the accuser and to counter some who have sought to publicly name her.

items.title: UK Police Arrest Latvian Men Found at Second Airbase Used by US
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: British police arrested two men on suspicion of trespassing and national security offenses at an airbase that’s used by the US for intelligence and analysis work, just weeks after a suspected terror plot at another base that was home to American bombers.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- British police arrested two men on suspicion of trespassing and national security offenses at an airbase that’s used by the US for intelligence and analysis work, just weeks after a suspected terror plot at another base that was home to American bombers.The two men, both Latvian nationals in their 30s, were arrested late Wednesday following security patrols near RAF Molesworth in Cambridgeshire. Officers found a “small breach” of the perimeter fence, counterterror police said in a statement. There was nothing to suggest at this stage that the two separate airbase incidents were related, police said, adding that their investigation was at an early stage and that they were keeping an open mind about the motive.RAF Molesworth, located about 90 miles (145 kilometers) north of London, houses the US Joint Intelligence Operations Center Europe and is garrisoned by a US Air Force group.The incursion will deepen scrutiny of the security at airbases in Britain that are used by US forces, as the UK warns of an escalation in sabotage plots involving so-called proxies directed by Iran and Russia.The Pentagon evacuated its bombers at RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire last week after five men were found near the base along with three vans and a quantity of fuel. Several other arrests have since been made and the probe is ongoing. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said it was likely that Iran was involved in the incident.President Donald Trump’s decision to move the bombers may embolden Iran and Russia’s use of proxies to carry out sabotage attacks, current and former British officials told Bloomberg. The UK is concerned that hostile states will take confidence that they can force changes to Western defense arrangements and destabilize their enemies for the relatively small cost of hiring local criminal proxies, the people said.Richard Knighton, the head of Britain’s armed forces, said on Thursday that the country’s bases were safe. “We take the security of all of our bases in Europe enormously seriously,” he said, calling the US move an “operational decision.” Knighton added that the UK has “enormously close relationships from an intelligence perspective and operationally with the US, and that’s what gives me confidence around the safety and security of our bases here.”--With assistance from Sachin Ravikumar.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: El Banco Central argentino y la AGN protagonizan duro cruce por la gestión de reservas de oro
items.author: Tomás Carrió
items.summary: La AGN volvió a apuntar contra la autoridad monetaria por el manejo del oro: “Erró el cálculo y perdió US$1.023 millones”. “La actual conducción de la AGN se encuentra avocada a desprestigiar a la con ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — La Auditoría General de la Nación y el Banco Central de la República Argentina ( BCRA ) volvieron a protagonizar un cruce por la administración de las reservas en oro. A través de un comunicado publicado este jueves, la presidencia del organismo, a cargo de Juan Manuel Olmos, acusó a las autoridades de la autoridad monetaria argentina de realizar operaciones financieras “especulando con una trayectoria determinada” del precio del metal durante 2025. “Erró el cálculo y perdió US$1.023 millones”, apuntó. A través de un comunicado, el BCRA se defendió de las acusaciones al señalar que en 2025 obtuvo un resultado neto positivo de US$2.505 millones por su posición en oro. VER MÁS: IPC septiembre 2026: de cuánto fue la inflación, según anticipan las consultoras en Argentina Tras concluir con la auditoría de los Estados Contables del BCRA al 31 de diciembre de 2025, presentados en mayo de este año, la AGN opinó que los mismos “son razonables en sus aspectos técnicos, sobre la situación patrimonial de la entidad”. Sin embargo, acto seguido el organismo apuntó contra las operaciones vinculadas a las reservas de oro, adquiridas en las gestiones de Alfonso Prat-Gay y Mercedes Marcó del Pont. Durante el ejercicio 2025, indicó la AGN, el Central registró una ganancia patrimonial de más de ARS$8 billones “explicada solamente por la suba internacional del precio del metal”. Pese a ello, apuntó contra la actual gestión de Santiago Bausili porque ese mismo año, con fines de cobertura, la entidad concertó operaciones de derivados liquidables en dólares utilizando parte del oro como bien de respaldo, cuyo resultado “arrojó una pérdida de ARS$1,5 billones (equivalentes a USD 1.023 millones), que se pagó con divisas”. “Al cierre del ejercicio auditado ya no existían posiciones u operaciones abiertas por este concepto”, aclaró la AGN. “En síntesis: durante el 2025 el BCRA realizó operaciones financieras especulando con una determinada trayectoria para el precio internacional del oro, erró el cálculo y perdió US$1.023 millones, según surge de las registraciones contables”, apuntó el organismo. “Desde que se auditan los Estados Contables del BCRA, nunca se había utilizado esta magnitud de reservas físicas (oro) para transacciones de riesgo”, agregó. El texto publicado este jueves por la Presidencia de la AGN recordó, además, que el organismo se encuentra trabajando en la auditoría específica sobre la gestión de las reservas físicas de oro por parte del BCRA, que revelará “por qué se tomó la decisión de trasladar el oro al exterior, a dónde fue enviado y si tuvo algún beneficio específico para el país o, en su defecto, quien se benefició”. Dicho informe, indicó la AGN, ya se encuentra en poder de las autoridades del BCRA “para su descargo”. A través de un comunicado, el BCRA se defendió de las acusaciones al señalar que en 2025 obtuvo un resultado neto positivo de US$2.505 millones por su posición en oro. “Este desempeño refleja el efecto combinado de la evolución del precio del metal y de las operaciones de cobertura financiera que la entidad aplica de manera habitual sobre el total de sus tenencias en este activo”, aclaró la entidad. Según explicó la autoridad monetaria argentina, las operaciones financieras con oro registradas en 2025 “forman parte de la política de cobertura que el BCRA implementa sobre el 100% de su posición en oro”. Dicha estrategia, añadió la entidad, tiene como objetivo proteger las reservas internacionales frente a las pérdidas que podría ocasionar una caída significativa en el precio de uno de sus principales activos. Según recordó el BCRA, “como toda operación de cobertura, estos instrumentos conllevan un costo”. Así, agregó que en años en los que el oro muestra un desempeño favorable —tal como ocurrió en 2025—, los derivados financieros que actúan como seguro suelen registrar un resultado negativo. “Este comportamiento responde a la naturaleza misma de la cobertura: el activo subyacente presenta una ganancia, mientras que el instrumento de protección absorbe una pérdida. Por ello, la evaluación correcta de la estrategia exige considerar ambas partes de la operación en forma conjunta y su efecto neto, que en este caso resultó ampliamente positivo”, precisó. Las coberturas efectuadas en 2025, añadió el comunicado de la entidad que preside Santiago Bausili, “se inscriben en una práctica habitual que el BCRA lleva adelante desde 2007″. “Entre 2007 y 2011, los pagos realizados por coberturas de características similares representaron, en relación con el valor de mercado del oro en cartera, casi el doble de los pagos efectuados en 2025″, recordó. En esa línea, el BCRA apuntó contra la Auditoría General de la Nación (AGN) ya que en esos años no formuló observaciones sobre la estrategia de cobertura utilizada ni sobre los pagos asociados. “Tampoco se registraron observaciones por parte de los auditores externos del BCRA respecto de estas prácticas”, lo que a ojos de las autoridades del Central “confirma que las operaciones de cobertura sobre la posición en oro se ajustan a los estándares de auditoría y control aplicables”. Para las autoridades del BCRA, “la actual conducción de la AGN se encuentra avocada a desprestigiar a la conducción del BCRA, con fines puramente políticos”. Ese desvío de funciones, agregaron, “socava la institucionalidad de la entidad”. Esa parcialidad, indicó el comunicado del Central, quedó reflejada en el último comunicado de la AGN en el que se menciona a las operaciones citadas como operaciones de cobertura, pero a la hora de sintetizar la información se las caracteriza como especulativas. “Una operación financiera no puede ser de cobertura y especulativa a la vez”, señaló. “Esto mismo ya ocurrió con el tema del movimiento del oro donde la AGN publicó una carta donde eligió las palabras cuidadosamente para no faltar a la verdad, pero tampoco contribuir al esclarecimiento de los hechos, cuando contaba con toda la información para hacerlo”, cerró la autoridad monetaria argentina en su respuesta.

items.title: 再送-元米軍医の銃殺刑、異例の中継へ　12月3日執行
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(本文中の誤字を修正しました)

Phil Stewart

［ワシントン　８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
(本文中の誤字を修正しました)

Phil Stewart

［ワシントン　８日　ロイター］ - 米国防総省の当局者は、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。死刑執行の中継は前例のない措置となる。

銃殺刑は１９４５年以来初めてとなる。トランプ大統領が指示した。

これに先立ち、ヘグセス米国防長官はポッドキャスト番組「ヒューマン・イベンツ・デイリー」で、ハサン死刑囚の死刑執行を公開する方針を示した。８日にソーシャルメディアに投稿された発言の動画で明らかになった。

ヘグセス氏によると、銃殺刑は、犯行が行われた場所、時刻、曜日に合わせてフォートフッドで木曜日の午後１時に執行する予定。

「人々が確実に見られるよう、公開する。こうした行為には重大な結果が伴うことを、人々が理解する必要があるからだ」と語った。

ハサン死刑囚が最後の要望を出したかとの質問には「どうでもいい。１２月３日に会うことになる」と答えた。

米軍法では、銃殺刑の執行には大統領の承認が必要となる。国防総省は５日、トランプ米大統領がヘグセス氏の勧告を受けて承認したと発表した。

ヘグセス氏は「（銃殺刑は）第２次世界大戦以来行われていない。第２次大戦の頃のような考え方だ」と述べた。

items.title: 中国、人民元安誘導を否定 欧州は貿易黒字巡り圧力強化 - Reuters

items.title: 中国、人民元安誘導を否定　欧州は貿易黒字巡り圧力強化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yukun Zhang　Kevin Yao

[北京 ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Yukun Zhang　Kevin Yao

[北京 ８日 ロイター] - 中国は８日、為替政策に対する外国からの批判に反論し、競争力の確保を目的とした通貨切り下げを行ったことはないと表明した。欧州の政策当局者が中国の過去最大の貿易黒字と輸出急増を抑制するため、人民元の上昇を求めていることが背景。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）のシェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）は、ＥＵの対中貿易赤字の縮小について協議するため北京を訪れている。

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は詳細な政策声明で、中国が貿易上の優位性を得るために人民元を人為的に安く抑えているとの主張を否定した。

「中国には為替相場の下落を通じて貿易上の競争優位を得る必要も意図もなく、競争的な通貨切り下げを行ったこともない」と表明。

「国内産業の競争力低下や財政・金融規律の弱まり、複雑な構造問題を単純に他国の為替相場のせいにすることは、必要な調整を行う自らの責任を回避し、転嫁することに等しい」とした。

中国の２０２５年の貿易黒字は過去最大の約１兆２０００億ドルとなり、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の約６％に相当した。アナリストは、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連などの先端技術製品の輸出により、２６年も黒字が高水準を維持すると予想している。

人民銀は、中国の貿易の強さは産業の国際競争力に由来するとし、歴史的に多額の貿易黒字を計上してきたのは製造業が強い国だと主張した。

items.title: ハリケーン「イサイアス」襲来、米メキシコ湾原油生産の63％停止
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sumit Saha

[８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sumit Saha

[８日 ロイター] - ハリケーン「イサイアス」の襲来を控え、メキシコ湾地域にある米国のエネルギー企業は日量約１３０万バレルの原油生産と、約１１億立方フィートの天然ガス生産を停止した。米海洋鉱物管理局（ＭＭＡ）によると、生産停止量はメキシコ湾地域での米国の原油生産量の約６３％、天然ガス生産量の約５７％に相当する。

イサイアスは米南部のアラバマ州南部とフロリダ州パンハンドル地域の間に上陸する見通しで、９日夜にミシシッピ、アラバマ、フロリダ各州の州境近くを通過すると予想されている。

イサイアス接近による供給の混乱拡大などを受け、８日の原油価格は前日より４％上昇した。

コンサルティング会社アース・サイエンス・アソシエイツの予測によると、イサイアスの影響によってメキシコ湾全域で約９００万バレルの原油生産が失われる可能性があり、これは７月の熱帯暴風雨「バーサ」が通過した際の７１０万バレルを大きく上回る。影響を最も受けやすい企業として英ＢＰ 、米シェブロン 、イタリアのエニ 、米マーフィー・オイル 、英シェル などを挙げた。

ＢＰは８日、ナキカおよびサンダーホースの施設の稼働を停止し、全従業員を避難させたと発表した。一方、シェブロンはメキシコ湾地域にある５つの施設の稼働を停止し、沖合で勤務する労働者の大半を陸上に移動させた。シェブロンによると、メキシコ湾地域の残る４つの施設では生産を継続している。

シェル社も７日、メキシコ湾での操業を縮小していると発表した。

米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）によると、メキシコ湾の米連邦管轄海域では日量約２００万バレルの原油が産出されており、これは米国の産出量の約１５％に相当する。この地域では天然ガスも日量平均約２１億立方フィートが生産されている。

items.title: Fuertes lluvias provocan una crecida que arrastra vehículos y daña viviendas en Chile
items.author: James Attwood, Antonia Mufarech
items.summary: La crecida se produjo en el barrio de Las Condes tras el desbordamiento de un barranco. Las autoridades evaluaban los daños, sin reportes confirmados de fallecidos o heridos.
items.body: Bloomberg — Una repentina crecida de agua y escombros arrasó el jueves el acomodado barrio de Las Condes, en Santiago, arrastrando vehículos, causando daños en viviendas y provocando atascos de tráfico, mientras unas fuertes lluvias azotaban la capital de Chile. Esta inundación es la última de una serie de perturbaciones relacionadas con el clima que han afectado a Chile en los últimos meses, incluidas las tormentas que han afectado a las operaciones mineras en el norte. Se produce en un momento en que fenómenos meteorológicos extremos en otras partes del mundo han afectado a comunidades, infraestructuras y cadenas de suministro de materias primas. La emergencia en Santiago se inició en los alrededores de las calles General Blanche y San Carlos de Apoquindo después de que un barranco se desbordara durante un intenso aguacero, según informan los medios locales. La información preliminar apuntaba a un desbordamiento de un canal. Ver más: Súper El Niño podría restar 2% al PIB de Latinoamérica y sumar 4,8 millones de pobres: Cepal Las imágenes difundidas por los medios locales mostraban torrentes de agua fangosa que arrastraban rocas, árboles y vehículos por las calles. Un autobús de transporte público volcó debido a la fuerza de la corriente, mientras que algunos residentes informaron de que el agua había entrado en sus viviendas. Las inundaciones y los cortes de carretera también provocaron atascos de tráfico en algunas zonas de la ciudad, mientras que los alumnos quedaron bloqueados en los colegios de la zona. Las autoridades instaron a los residentes a permanecer en sus hogares, ya que seguía lloviendo ligeramente. Ver más: Qué es y pronósticos para Latinoamérica sobre el Súper El Niño 2026 El incidente se produjo tras varios días de lluvias inusualmente intensas en Santiago. En Las Condes ya se habían registrado inundaciones y corrimientos de escombros en los alrededores de la Quebrada Honda a principios de semana, mientras que en otras zonas de la Región Metropolitana se produjeron calles anegadas, cortes de electricidad y crecidas de los ríos. No hubo informes confirmados de inmediato sobre fallecidos o heridos a raíz del incidente del jueves en Las Condes. Las autoridades seguían evaluando la magnitud de los daños. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: New York City man shot in car with child present by ICE agents, mayor says
items.author: Julia Harte, Kristina Cooke
items.creator: Julia Harte, Kristina Cooke
items.summary: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents shot and wounded a man on Thursday in his car with a child present in the vehicle in the Bronx borough of New York City, according to the mayor, city police and eyewitness accounts.
items.body:
US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents shot and wounded a man on Thursday in his car with a child present in the vehicle in the Bronx borough of New York City, according to the mayor, city police and eyewitness accounts.
"Early reports indicate agents surrounded (the man) and a 5-year-old-child in his car before firing multiple rounds," New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said in a statement.
The mayor said the child was believed to have been physically unharmed. He referred to the man shot as a "New Yorker."
"This is an unconscionable and incredibly serious situation," Mamdani said, adding he had called President Donald Trump to talk about the incident. "When we speak I will demand that he ends all ICE enforcement actions in our city. I will not stand by while ICE agents terrorize our communities."
ICE did not immediately respond to a request from Reuters for comment on the incident.
The incident was first reported on X by the New York Police Department, which gave few details other than to say: "there was a shooting involving federal law enforcement agents," and that the person shot was "currently conscious and receiving medical attention."
The shooting occurred at around 4 p.m. ET (2000 GMT) in the Marble Hill neighborhood of the Bronx, the NYPD said.
An NYPD spokesperson said the agents involved in the shooting were part of DHS, the parent agency for Immigration and Customs Enforcement, the Customs and Border Protection and Border Patrol agencies, among others, and that federal authorities were investigating.
Pedro Almarez, owner of a nearby eatery, said he was working at the restaurant when he heard shots fired and went outside to see several officers wearing ICE attire at the scene.
"There were a lot of ICE officers, three or four cars," Almarez told Reuters by phone, adding the man who was shot appeared to be between 20 and 30 years of age. He said NYPD officers arrived about 10 minutes later.
The city police department said its officers were not involved in the shooting.
At the shooting scene, where police strung yellow crime-scene tape to cordon off a city block, a woman standing on a balcony overlooking the area was heckling officers below about "taking our children."

items.title: New Chargers OC Mike McDaniel understands calls for his job
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Los Angeles Chargers are 0-4 and rank 29th in scoring at 16.8 points per game, putting new offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel under increasing scrutiny.
items.body:
The Los Angeles Chargers are 0-4 and rank 29th in scoring at 16.8 points per game, putting new offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel under increasing scrutiny.
The former Miami Dolphins head coach said Thursday he understands the criticism, acknowledging that disappointment "comes with the territory of the job."
The Chargers have scored 16 or fewer points in three of their four games, with their closest defeat coming in Sunday's 30-23 loss at Seattle.
"When you have high expectations, and you're getting the results we're getting, and you're 0-4, that's pretty standard operating procedure," McDaniel said of the criticism. "I would be foolish, or I would feel entitled, if I didn't expect there to be disappointment.
"And so, if you want things to change and you want narratives to change, you have to change them through action collectively. If our results are better, that's the only thing that matters. So it's pretty easy for me to focus on what I need to focus on."
The offensive struggles are particularly surprising with established quarterback Justin Herbert, who has thrown for fewer than 200 yards twice and has more interceptions (six) than touchdown passes (four).
In 2024, Herbert tossed a career-low three interceptions in 504 attempts. He has doubled that in just 119 throws this season while completing a career-worst 59.7% of his passes.
McDaniel cautioned against drawing conclusions about Herbert's performance so early in the season.
"It would probably be an inaccurate wholesale assessment of Justin Herbert four games into a new system with new coaches, new players," McDaniel said. "And fortunately we have plenty of opportunities to change whatever narratives exist because this is just in -- narratives in the first quarter of the season are generally about 40 percent right, good or bad."
McDaniel and the Chargers will try to turn things around Sunday when they host the Denver Broncos in an AFC West matchup.
--Field Level Media

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ ８日 ロイター] - ロシアは８日、シベリアのペスト研究所の女性職員が死亡した問題で、接触者全員に対する健康観察を終了したと発表した。問題に区切りをつけたい意向を示した形だ。

国の衛生当局と地元州知事は声明で、接触者全員の経過観察が終了したとし、約５０００件の検体から危険な病原体は検出されなかったと改めて表明した。

イルクーツク州のコブゼフ知事は「メディアが厳しい目を向ける中、専門家は状況を徹底的に調査した。試練だったが、立派に乗り切った」と述べた。

ただ、世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）や米国が説明を求める中でも、ロシア当局は職員の死因がペストだった可能性について、依然として明確な見解を示していない。

当局はこれまで、職員は肺炎にかかって死亡したが、肺炎の原因はまだ特定されていないと説明している。

items.title: Who needs winter coats when it's still hot? Climate change is upending the fashion industry
items.author: CNA Luxury
items.summary: Winter coats on the runway, T-shirts on the streets. As unusually warm weather disrupts fashion's traditional seasons, luxury brands and retailers are scrambling to adapt.
items.body:
Advertisement

Obsessions

Who needs winter coats when it's still hot? Climate change is upending the fashion industry

Winter coats on the runway, T-shirts on the streets. As unusually warm weather disrupts fashion's traditional seasons, luxury brands and retailers are scrambling to adapt.

Jang Won-Young arrives at the Christian Dior Womenswear Spring Summer 2027 collection presented in Paris, France, Tuesday, Sept. 29, 2026. (Photo: AP/Thomas Padilla)

FAST

Longer, hotter summers are disrupting fashion's seasonal calendar, forcing luxury brands to adapt designs and threatening sales of higher-margin winter clothing.
The industry's traditional cycle has long depended on consumers buying autumn and winter clothing as temperatures cool. But warmer autumns are delaying demand for coats and other cold-weather clothing, leaving retailers at risk of excess stock and markdowns.
In Paris, Saint Laurent billboard ads during Fashion Week showed a model wrapped in a thick fur coat, while the sun shone and tourists wandered the streets in T-shirts and shorts.

A model wears a creation as part of the Saint Laurent Womenswear Spring Summer 2027 collection presented in Paris, France, Tuesday, Sept. 29, 2026. (AP Photo/Teresa Suarez)

"The whole industry should realise that with climate change and higher temperatures, the time for selling coats has shifted later," said Pau Almar, a retail industry consultant who previously spent a decade at Zara.
The disconnect was on show during Paris Fashion Week, where temperatures reached 28 degrees Celsius (82.4 degrees Fahrenheit) and many guests opted for sleeveless tops and mini skirts rather than newly released autumn collections.
Typically, guests at spring/summer runway shows held at the end of September come dressed in autumn/winter products just released in stores. At Louis Vuitton's show on Tuesday, however, coats were scarce.
"I can't believe it's October here in Paris and I was wishing I brought some of my summer clothes from Miami," said Suzy Buckley Woodward, a guest at the show.
"My sales associate was putting a lot of coats in front of me for the show, and I said that's gonna be a waste because I think it's very unlikely that I'll need a coat for the show," she added.
ADAPTING DESIGNS, RETAIL RISKS Louis Vuitton's womenswear designer Nicolas Ghesquiere is already adapting his designs, saying Europe's record heatwaves had a "strong influence" on his latest collection, which featured thin fabrics and airy constructions.
"The focus was on how do you do clothes that are like swimwear almost, like a second skin," he told reporters after Tuesday's show.

A model presents a creation by designer Nicolas Ghesquiere as part of his Spring/Summer 2027 collection for fashion house Louis Vuitton during Paris Fashion Week in Paris, France, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

The warm weather last week left some guests in autumn clothing overheating at Dior’s spring/summer show in the Tuileries Gardens, despite ceiling fans installed above the runway.
The continuing high temperatures also pose a challenge for mass-market fashion retailers as stores begin to replace T-shirts with jackets and knitwear, facing the risk of having to discount excess stock.
Retailers will have to adapt to selling fewer heavy coats and more transitional layers, Almar said.
Profits could come under pressure as outerwear is typically higher-margin, and a delayed winter risks more shoppers waiting until end-November Black Friday discounts to pick up a new coat.
At the Hermes runway show on Saturday, fashion influencer sisters Snehal and Jyoti Babani said the weather, rather than the fashion calendar, had dictated their outfits.
"Is this really fall/winter?" Snehal said. "If the summers are getting hotter, the line between spring/summer and fall/winter will get really blurred."
 
 

Source: Reuters/bt

items.title: 仏国債利回り、ルペン氏が退職年齢引き上げ約束するかが左右＝ＲＢＣブルーベイ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Leigh Thomas　Gabriel Stargardter

[パリ ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Leigh Thomas　Gabriel Stargardter

[パリ ８日 ロイター] - フランス大統領選の有力候補たち、特に極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者で支持率首位のマリーヌ・ルペン氏が、年金受給開始年齢の引き上げを公約するかどうかが、今後のフランス国債利回りの上昇幅を左右する－－。ＲＢＣブルーベイ・アセット・マネジメントの市場戦略責任者を務めるマイク・ベルがロイターのインタビューで、こうした見方を示した。

フランスでは国債が売られて利回りが高騰。背景には脆弱な財政状況と、２０２７年前半に予定される大統領選を巡る政治的不透明感がある。

年金はフランスの公的支出の中で最大の項目で、来年は４３６０億ユーロに達し、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の１４％を占める見通し。ただ年金受給者の購買力を損なう政策への抵抗感は根強く、高齢者はルペン氏率いる国民連合の重要な支持層でもある。

ベル氏は「市場は、勝利の可能性が最も高い候補者、世論調査ではルペン氏だが、その人物が退職年齢引き上げ政策を実施するかどうかを見極めたいと考えている。それがなければ市場の圧力は高まり続ける」と述べた。

ルペン氏はこれまで、早くから働き始めた人を対象に退職年齢を６０歳へ引き下げる方針を支持してきた。６日に自身の予算計画の大部分を公表したが、年金改革の詳細には触れず、数週間以内に発表するとしている。

ベル氏は、退職年齢を現状維持する候補者の当選可能性が高まれば、投資家がフランス１０年国債を保有する際に求めるドイツ国債との利回り格差が最大２００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）まで拡大する可能性があると警告した。このスプレッドは２日に１５０ｂｐを上回り、１１年後半以来の高水準を記録した。

運用資産残高５９８０億ドルのＲＢＣブルーベイはフランス国債を保有しているものの、あえて組み入れ比率を高めていない。ベル氏は２７年４月１８日から５月２日にかけて実施される大統領選までなお時間がある中で、フランス国債への投資を増やすには「かなり勇気が必要だ」と語った。

一方でフランス国債のさらなる下落を見込んだ空売りにはリスクも伴うと述べ、その理由として既に相当程度のリスクが市場価格に織り込まれている点を挙げた。

フランスは先進国の中でも退職年齢が低い国の１つで、出生年によって異なるものの平均的には６２．９歳となっている半面、平均寿命は比較的長い。昨年には政府が、２６年予算成立に向けて社会党議員の支持を得るため、退職年齢を６２歳から６４歳へ段階的に引き上げる２３年改革の実施を停止した。

ベル氏は、ルペン氏が大統領選で勝利した場合、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）との対立が生じる可能性もあると指摘。「強いフランス民族主義を掲げる指導者が、借り入れコスト抑制のために何をすべきかをＥＣＢから指示され、それを素直に受け入れる状況は想像しにくい」と付け加えた。

これに対してＥＣＢや欧州連合（ＥＵ）の一部関係者は、フランス国債利回りの高止まりを次期大統領に財政規律を促す手段とみなしている可能性がある、というのがベル氏の分析だ。ＥＣＢの国債買い入れ支援制度、伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）は、ＥＵの財政ルールを順守している国のみが利用できるが、フランスは現時点でその条件を満たしていないという。

items.title: Sean Strickland considers UFC exit over Conor McGregor pay gap
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: UFC middleweight champion Sean Strickland is considering leaving the promotion over a pay dispute, citing the significantly higher earnings of stars like Conor McGregor.
items.body:
UFC middleweight champion Sean Strickland is considering leaving the promotion over a pay dispute, citing the significantly higher earnings of stars like Conor McGregor.
Strickland aired his grievances Wednesday on social media, suggesting he could give up his title, move to light heavyweight and fight out his UFC contract before pursuing a boxing match with Jake Paul.
Strickland pointed to McGregor's reported payday for his 69-second loss to Max Holloway at UFC 329 in July as one reason he is considering a different path.
"I gotta be honest unless things change with the UFC Im kinda over it," Strickland wrote on X. "McGregor makes 30 million to fight for 30 second and they dont want to pay us a fraction of it."
Strickland, 35, regained the middleweight championship May 9 with a split-decision victory over previously unbeaten Khamzat Chimaev at UFC 328.
He has yet to schedule the first defense of his second title reign. A potential matchup with Nassourdine Imavov had been discussed for later this year, but Strickland reportedly turned it down, previously indicating that compensation was an obstacle in negotiations.
"The thought of just giving up my belt going to 205 and speed running my contract to fight Jake and make what these guys are making sounds pretty damn appealing," Strickland wrote in a separate post.
Paul responded on social media Wednesday, inviting Strickland to contact his company, Most Valuable Promotions, once he becomes a free agent.
Strickland also referenced boxer Conor Benn's reported $15 million, one-fight agreement with Zuffa Boxing.
Strickland has previously criticized the UFC's pay structure despite regularly describing himself as loyal to the promotion.
It is unclear how many fights remain on his current UFC contract.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 仏は予算成立が急務、国債市場混乱でユーロ圏財務相　支援に消極的
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jan Strupczewski

［ブリュッセル　８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Jan Strupczewski

［ブリュッセル　８日　ロイター］ - ユーロ圏財務相と欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は８日、フランスに対し、国債市場の安定化に向け、２０２７年予算案を成立させるよう求めた。巨額の財政赤字と来年の大統領選を巡る懸念からフランス国債利回りは約２５年ぶりの高水準を付け、金融市場で不安が広がっている。

ユーロ圏財務相とＥＣＢは８日午後にルクセンブルクで月例会合を開き、フランスの借入コスト急上昇について議論した。

協議に参加した欧州連合（ＥＵ）のドンブロフスキス欧州委員（経済担当）は会合後の記者会見で、「全ての加盟国、とりわけ高水準の赤字や債務を抱える国々が慎重な財政政策を実施することが極めて重要だ」と指摘し、「予見可能性と信頼性を確保し市場を安心させるため、翌年に向けて健全な予算を整備することが重要になる。この点について（フランスの）レスキュール経済財務相と連絡を取り合っている」と述べた。

ユーロ圏財務相会合のピエラカキス議長は記者会見で、「われわれはフランスの財政に対するコミットメントを信頼している」と述べた。

フランスは９月、２６年の財政赤字が政府目標の５％を超過する見通しだと表明した。２７年は、政府資金の調達とコロナ禍当時の債務借り換えのため、過去最高となる３４００億ユーロ（３８１０億ドル）の国債を発行する計画だ。

ＥＣＢは、域内国の国債価格が極めて不安定になった場合、「トランスミッション・プロテクション・インスツルメント（ＴＰＩ）」という緊急措置で流通市場で買い入れを行うことができる。ただ、当局者らによると、ユーロ圏のどの機関もフランスの借入コスト低下を支援するために介入する用意はなく、フランスが自らが作り出した不確実性を解決すべきという立場だという。

当局者によると、ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁はユーロ圏財務相らに対し、金融政策の円滑な伝達を脅かす不当かつ無秩序な市場力学に対抗する手段はあるものの、明確な適格性基準が存在すると伝えた。

ＥＣＢのウェブサイトで公表されている基準には、ＥＵの財政規律の順守や、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３％というＥＵの上限を超える財政赤字を抱える国を対象とした懲罰的措置「過剰赤字是正手続き（ＥＤＰ）」の対象外であることが含まれる。

フランスは財政赤字が対ＧＤＰ比で５％を超えており、すでに是正手続きの対象となっている。

１９９９年のユーロ導入以降、フランスが、財政赤字をＥＵ上限の３％未満に抑えられたのは６回にとどまる。一部当局者は、債券市場の圧力だけがフランスに財政再建を促す唯一の要因になり得ると指摘した。

items.title: Indonesia Vows to Protect Investment at Launch of Battery, Solar, Aluminum Plants
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indonesia is committed to respecting and safeguarding all investments, President Prabowo Subianto said on Thursday, as he launched nickel- and aluminum-based projects worth billions. Prabowo spoke at a launch ceremony for the commercial operations of industrial facilities and the construction of other projects in an …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
Indonesia is committed to respecting and safeguarding all investments, President Prabowo Subianto said on Thursday, as he launched nickel- and aluminum-based projects worth billions.

Prabowo spoke at a launch ceremony for the commercial operations of industrial facilities and the construction of other projects in an industrial park at Weda Bay, partly controlled by Chinese steelmaker Tsingshan Holding Group.

He also launched the first exports of EV batteries, produced by REPT Battero, at the ceremony.

“I emphasize here an Indonesian government commitment to respect and safeguard all investments, from wherever,” he said. “We are committed to safeguarding our partnership as well as possible. It is a matter of honor for the Indonesian people to support our partners.”

A drone view shows nickel processing facilities at the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park in Central Halmahera Regency, North Maluku province, Indonesia, in this handout picture released October 8, 2026. Indonesia Presidential Palace/Handout via REUTERS

Indonesia has attracted massive investment into its metal industry and smelting, mainly from China, with firms drawn to its rich nickel reserves, but recent policies have raised concerns from some business players.

Chinese companies operating in Indonesia have called for more business-friendly policies, warning in a letter to the president that tighter mining quotas, higher taxes and a new pricing formula are driving up costs and threatening investment.

Country Is World’s Top Exporter of Nickel Products

Indonesia, which holds the world’s largest nickel ore reserves, banned raw nickel exports in 2020 to promote domestic processing industries.

The policy has helped Indonesia become the world’s top exporter of nickel products, accounting for around 60% of global supply, with export value rising from $3.3 billion in 2017 to over $33 billion by 2024.

The Investment Ministry said companies investing in the new projects at Weda Bay include PT Guang Ching Nickel Cobalt, PT Weda Bay Aluminum, and PT Flatsolar Energy Indonesia.

A drone view shows nickel processing facilities at the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park in Central Halmahera Regency, North Maluku province, Indonesia, in this handout picture released October 8, 2026. Indonesia Presidential Palace/Handout via REUTERS

The four projects were worth $3.4 billion, while investment in six other projects is expected to reach $6.8 billion, investment minister Rosan Roeslani said at the same event on Thursday.

The new constructions include facilities to produce nickel-based battery material, battery components, and photovoltaic glass for solar panels, Rosan said. He added that the development of two aluminum plants also launched on Thursday.

items.title: Bruen: Political Power Is Diffusing in Post-American Era
items.summary: Brett Bruen, President of the Global Situation Room and former US diplomat, says Iran may not go along with President Trump's effort to keep tensions down before the midterm elections and could continue using attacks to demonstrate its leverage. Bruen says President Trump cannot speak on behalf of Israel and says Netanyahu will make his own calculations based in part on his political prospects. Bruen says leaders in Europe, Canada, Japan and the Middle East are starting to build their own structures as political power diffuses in what he calls a "post-American era," creating a new economic and political dynamic. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 韓国、駐ウクライナ大使召還へ　北朝鮮兵の移送巡り対立
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ８日 ロイター] - 韓国外務省は８日、駐ウクライナ大使を召還すると発表した。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が北朝鮮兵捕虜２人の韓国移送を公表したことを巡る対立を受けた措置。

両国の間では、移送を非公表とする合意にウクライナ側が違反したと韓国が非難し、対立が続いている。 

同省は、両国間の懸案が解決されることを望んでおり、ウクライナ側との交渉を継続すると表明した。詳細には触れなかった。

ウクライナ外務省報道官は、韓国が大使召還を決めたものの、建設的な対話を再開する用意があると述べた。同省は今週、韓国大使を招き、この問題に関するウクライナの立場を伝えたという。

報道官は「感情よりも外交を優先すべきだと考える」とし、「韓国は大使召還を決めたが、ウクライナは時間がかかっても建設的な対話を再開する用意がある」と述べた。

韓国の李在明大統領は先週、ウクライナが北朝鮮兵捕虜の移送に関する合意の存在を否定し続けるなら追加措置を取ると表明し、合意を認めて謝罪するようウクライナ側に求めていた。

items.title: Nvidia-backed Firmus scraps $5 billion Australian IPO on weak demand
items.author: Scott Murdoch, Christine Chen
items.creator: Scott Murdoch, Christine Chen
items.summary: Australia's Firmus, a data centre operator backed by Nvidia , shelved its $5 billion initial public offering, citing market volatility and conditions, and said it would opt for a private fundraising round instead.
items.body:
Australia's Firmus, a data centre operator backed by Nvidia (NVDA.O) , shelved its $5 billion initial public offering, citing market volatility and conditions, and said it would opt for a private fundraising round instead.
Firmus' IPO would have been the second-largest new share sale in Australia's history but met lukewarm demand, a warning sign that investors remain selective about AI issuers even as the artificial intelligence boom drives global markets.
"Firmus will now pursue capital from the private markets and consider alternative public and private market options," Firmus said in a statement, adding the terms did not correctly reflect the strength of its business and long-term growth outlook.
"The board therefore concluded that proceeding with the offer was not in the best interests of the company and its shareholders," it said.
The company [USN:L1N45N0G2 TEXT:"initially planned"] to sell its shares at A$11 each, giving Firmus an equity valuation of $30.6 billion, nearly triple the $10.5 billion valuation it achieved following a fundraising [USN:L4N444084 TEXT:"round"] at the start of August.
Firmus, backed by major AI companies and investors Nvidia and Coatue Management, along with Blackstone (BX.N) and Jane Street, designs and operates modular AI factories using proprietary energy and cooling technology.
It currently only has two online in Melbourne and Singapore. Five more planned across the Asia-Pacific are in early stages of development.
"I think the Firmus situation represents an important reality check for the AI investment boom, but I wouldn't interpret it as the beginning of the end of the AI trade," said Jun Bei Liu, co-founder of fund manager Ten Cap, who has been critical of the Firmus IPO.
"There are certainly Firmus-specific issues, particularly around the speed of its valuation increase, the enormous capital requirements and the execution risks associated with delivering its ambitious expansion plans."
Liu said there was a broader shift taking place in which investors were becoming more focused on the economics of AI investments, returns on capital and converting infrastructure spending into returns.
Cumulative spending [USN:L6N45N0Q6 TEXT:"globally"] on data centres alone could top $30 trillion by 2050, according to a projection by PwC.
DEBT PILE WORRIES INVESTORS In the latest sign of investors' concerns, US-listed chipmakers (.SOX) , which have soared over 80% so far this year, fell 3.4% on Thursday in the wake of a report from the Financial Times that OpenAI's annualised revenues were $20 billion less than the company previously signalled.
Firmus has about $30 billion worth of debt, according to analysts working for the IPO's joint lead managers, meaning the enterprise value would have been about $60 billion. The deal would have made Firmus, founded in 2019, more valuable than some of Australia's longest-established companies.
The deal's [USN:L1N45N0G2 TEXT:"term sheet"] sent out when the deal launched had said indicative offers for the IPO were already enough to cover the transaction size. But potential investors [USN:L6N45O0KM TEXT:"told Reuters"] they were sceptical about the company's burgeoning valuation, ability to execute on its ambitious growth plans and hefty debt pile.
Firmus said in a [USN:L4N45F0GG TEXT:"draft prospectus"] it would make $5 billion in annual earnings within five years from its portfolio of data centres, but most of those have yet to be built.
Investor grew more concerned about Firmus' huge increase in valuation after they were informed on Tuesday about the deal's escrow arrangements that would have allowed more than half the stock to be sold by existing investors from the proposed first day of trading.

items.title: 英空軍基地内でラトビア人の男2人拘束、米軍も使用の指揮拠点
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
William James

[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
William James

[ロンドン ８日 ロイター] - 英警察の対テロ捜査部門（ＣＴＰ）は、英空軍モールズワース基地内でラトビア人の男２人が拘束された事案について捜査している。関係当局が８日発表した。

拘束されたのは３２歳と３６歳の男で、いずれも英国在住。基地内への不法侵入と器物損壊の疑いで逮捕された後、国家安全保障法違反の疑いで再逮捕された。

ロンドンの北約１００キロにあるモールズワース基地は米軍関係者が使用し、情報分析や指揮活動の拠点となっているほか、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の情報センターも置かれている。飛行運用は行われていない。

警察によると、国防省警察が警備巡回中に放置された車両を発見し、警戒を強化した後の確認で外周フェンスの一部に破損が見つかり、基地内で男２人を発見して拘束した。放置車両は爆発物処理班が調べたものの、不審物は見つからなかった。また警察は近郊のピーターバラ周辺にある２カ所の関係先を捜索している。

英国では先月、西部のフェアフォード空軍基地への攻撃計画に関与した疑いで複数の男が逮捕された。英政府はこの計画についてイランとの関連を指摘しているが、イラン側は関与を否定している。

ＣＴＰロンドン本部のヘレン・フラナガン本部長は「軍事施設への関心や懸念が高まっていることは認識している。しかし現時点で今回の事案と先週のフェアフォード基地の事案を結び付ける情報はない」と述べた。

ストリーティング国防相はＸへの投稿で「軍事施設に対する潜在的な脅威に極めて警戒しており、警察と緊密に連携して施設の安全確保に取り組んでいる」と強調した。

米空軍報道官は、地元法執行当局の迅速な対応に謝意を示した上で「英国当局と緊密に連携し、軍関係者と地域社会の安全確保に努めている」とコメントした。

items.title: Southwest Airlines weighs Boeing 787 for long-haul international push, sources say
items.author: Rajesh Singh, Allison Lampert
items.creator: Rajesh Singh, Allison Lampert
items.summary: Southwest Airlines is leaning toward Boeing's 787 Dreamliner as its first widebody jet as it weighs launching long-haul international flights, according to three people familiar with the carrier's fleet planning.
items.body:
Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) is leaning toward Boeing's (BA.N) 787 Dreamliner as its first widebody jet as it weighs launching long-haul international flights, according to three people familiar with the carrier's fleet planning.
The people, who declined to be named because the deliberations are private, cautioned that no final aircraft decision has been made. The choice would ultimately rest with Southwest's board, which last year formed a Fleet Oversight Committee to help oversee the company's aircraft fleet acquisition strategy.
Southwest has not publicly named an aircraft for long-haul flying. In September, Chief Financial Officer Tom Doxey said long-haul international service was among a range of options under consideration but that no decision had been made.
One of the people said Southwest has contemplated a fleet of dozens of 787s.
Southwest has also examined how quickly it could obtain aircraft, including through lessors or the secondary market, according to two of the people. Reuters could not determine which 787 variant it is considering or whether any leasing arrangements have been made.
Southwest did not directly address questions about the 787, saying in a statement, "We do not have any news forthcoming related to our fleet plans." Boeing referred questions about the fleet plans to the carrier. Airbus (AIR.PA) said it does not comment on discussions with airlines.
The deliberations would take Southwest's overhaul into a new phase. The airline has added assigned seating and extra-legroom seats and announced airport lounges and plans for a premium credit card as it seeks to attract higher-spending travelers.
A widebody fleet would take Southwest into long-haul international flying and more direct competition with larger US rivals. Southwest has publicly discussed long-haul expansion as part of a broader effort to give customers fewer reasons to book with competitors while strengthening its Rapid Rewards loyalty program and co-branded credit-card business.
CEO Bob Jordan has said Southwest does not need a long-haul network comparable with those of Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) , United Airlines (UAL.O) or American Airlines (AAL.O) . In May, he said 8 to 12 long-haul destinations could cover much of where Southwest customers want to travel.
BOEING VERSUS AIRBUS Southwest currently operates an all-Boeing 737 fleet, but Airbus has been aggressively courting the airline as it evaluates future fleet needs, according to people familiar with the discussions. They said the A321XLR and A330neo could serve its long-haul needs, while the smaller A220 has been pitched for other parts of its network.
Choosing Airbus would require Southwest to diversify its fleet. Those people said the 787 has appeared to hold the stronger position in the discussions.
Southwest's pilot union has publicly indicated that more than one path is being examined. Jody Reven, president of the Southwest Airlines Pilots Association, said in a recent union podcast that the company had discussed both a "large aircraft" and a "narrow-body long-haul aircraft" as part of its future plans.
AVAILABILITY COULD SHAPE TIMING The long-haul plan has been discussed on a roughly three-year timetable, one of the people said. But aircraft availability could shape the timing.
Boeing has said the 787 is sold out through the end of the decade.
One of the people said Southwest has explored obtaining some Dreamliners through lessors, potentially allowing an earlier launch. Another said aircraft from the secondary market had been considered for the initial fleet.
Adding a 787 widebody would be a bigger undertaking than expanding Southwest's current 737 operation. Southwest has said adding a new aircraft type could require new maintenance and training programs, regulatory approvals and union negotiations over pay and work rules.
items.raw_description: Southwest Airlines is leaning toward Boeing's 787 Dreamliner as its first widebody jet as it weighs launching long-haul international flights, according to three people familiar with the carrier's fleet planning.

items.title: Simón se dirige a costa de México, tocará tierra como poderoso huracán
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La tormenta tropical Simón se intensificaba rápidamente el jueves a medida que enfilaba hacia la costa occidental de México, donde tocará tierra como un "muy peligroso" huracán de categoría 4 el fin de semana, dijo el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (NHC, por su siglas en inglés) de Estados Unidos.
items.body:
La tormenta tropical Simón se intensificaba rápidamente el jueves a medida que enfilaba hacia la costa occidental de México, donde tocará tierra como un "muy peligroso" huracán de categoría 4 el fin de semana, dijo el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (NHC, por su siglas en inglés) de Estados Unidos.
A las 14.00 hora local (2000 GMT) Simón, que estaba a punto de convertirse en un huracán de categoría 1 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson, se ubicaba a 370 kilómetros al sur de la ciudad portuaria Manzanillo y soplaba vientos máximos sostenidos de 110 kilómetros por hora (km/h), con ráfagas más fuertes, mientras se desplazaba hacia el oeste a 9 km/h, dijo el NHC.
"Simón casi es un huracán", advirtió el NHC, con sede en Miami.
"Se pronostica un fortalecimiento rápido, y se espera que Simón se convierta en huracán esta noche y en un huracán de categoría 4, muy peligroso, antes de llegar a la costa de México", agregó.
Simón tocará tierra muy cerca de Manzanillo, el mayor puerto de México y principal puerta de entrada del comercio con Asia. El domingo, seguirá avanzando tierra adentro y pasará por Puerto Vallarta, un popular destino de playa cuyo municipio homónimo alberga a casi 300,000 habitantes.
Un huracán de categoría 4, sopla vientos destructivos de hasta 250 km/h, descarga lluvias torrenciales y marejadas ciclónicas peligrosas. Además, puede dejar a su paso daños generalizados en estructuras protectoras, desplome de tejados en edificios pequeños e inundaciones en terrenos interiores.
"La amenaza de huracán para el oeste de México está aumentando", dijo Tyler Roys, meteorólogo de AccuWeather, la compañía estadounidense que presta servicios comerciales de pronóstico del tiempo. "Algunas de las mismas zonas que sufrieron fuertes lluvias, vientos intensos y oleaje peligroso a causa del huracán Polo ahora se enfrentan a otra amenaza tropical", agregó.
La semana pasada, [USN:L6N45L0YK TEXT:"Polo tocó tierra"] como un huracán de categoría 2 en la Península de Baja California dejando árboles y postes caídos, calles inundadas y otros daños materiales.
Simon también podría llevar humedad tropical al suroeste de Estados Unidos la próxima semana. Se prevén precipitaciones de 25 a 50 milímetros (mm) en gran parte de Nuevo México, el este de Arizona, el sur de Colorado y el oeste de Texas, con la posibilidad de acumular de 50 a 100 mm en el sur de Nuevo México.
Simon no será el único sistema tropical que afectará a México el domingo. Se pronostica que la tormenta tropical Rachel toque tierra en Baja California, provocando nuevos impactos tropicales en el país y el suroeste de Estados Unidos.

items.title: Flávio lidera 2º turno com 49% das intenções de voto contra 45% de Lula, diz Datafolha
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, confirmou a liderança obtida no primeiro turno e saiu na frente na disputa do segundo turno da eleição presidencial, com 49% das intenções de voto contra 45% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que tenta a reeleição, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, confirmou a liderança obtida no primeiro turno e saiu na frente na disputa do segundo turno da eleição presidencial, com 49% das intenções de voto contra 45% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que tenta a reeleição, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira.
Como a margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, os dois candidatos estão no limite do empate técnico.
Os indecisos somam apenas 1%, enquanto aqueles que dizem que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum candidato chegam a 5%.
Em votos válidos, quando não são considerados os votos brancos e nulos e os indecisos, Flávio tem 52% contra 48% de Lula.
No domingo, Flávio venceu o primeiro turno com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% de Lula.
Segundo a pesquisa divulgada nesta quinta-feira, entre os eleitores que votaram em Augusto Cury (Avante), Renan Santos (Missão), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) e Romeu Zema (Novo) no primeiro turno, a maioria declarou intenção de voto em Flávio agora.
Conforme o Datafolha, 46% dos eleitores que votaram em Cury, Renan, Caiado e Zema disseram que votarão no candidato do PL no segundo turno. No mesmo universo de eleitores, 32% declararam voto em Lula agora.

items.title: スペースＸ、全米規模の周波数帯取得　通信大手に対抗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸは８日、全米をカバーする低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約を結んだ。衛星を通じて米国の既存の携帯通信大手に直接対抗する態勢を整える。

同社の衛星通信サービス「スターリンク・モバイル」が既に保有する世界規模の２ギガヘルツ帯の中周波数帯は大容量通信を担い、新たに取得する周波数帯は障害物を透過する通信を可能にする。契約の金銭的条件は公表されていない。

低周波数帯は電波が遠くまで届き、壁や生い茂った樹木などの障害物を透過しやすい点が評価されている。衛星を使った携帯通信網がこれまで直面してきた大きな技術的課題の解消につながる。

スペースＸは全米の低周波数帯と、高周波の宇宙通信容量を組み合わせることで、従来の携帯基地局に全く依存せず、広い通信範囲と屋内での接続の信頼性の両面で、寡占状態にある携帯通信業界に挑む態勢を整える。

今回の契約により、既存の携帯通信会社は一段と厳しい競争に直面する。衛星と端末の直接通信が、遠隔地の圏外で安全を確保するための補助的な機能から、地上の携帯通信網に取って代わり得る本格的な商用サービスへと変わることになるからだ。

ＴモバイルＵＳ、ベライゾン、ＡＴ＆Ｔの株価は時間外取引で６．５％超下落した。

スペースＸはプライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）企業グレイン・マネジメントが保有する全米の８００メガヘルツ帯の利用権を全て取得する。取引には米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）の承認が必要となる。グレインは今年に入り、この周波数帯をＴモバイルから取得していた。

重要なのは、既存の携帯端末の大半が改造なしで８００メガヘルツ帯に対応しており、消費者が専用の衛星電話を購入する必要がない点だ。

items.title: US health secretary Kennedy launches new push on vaccine injuries
items.author: Ahmed Aboulenein
items.creator: Ahmed Aboulenein
items.summary: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. this week launched an agency-wide effort to study and document any health problems reported after vaccination, the Department of Health and Human Services said on Thursday.
items.body:
US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. this week launched an agency-wide effort to study and document any health problems reported after vaccination, the Department of Health and Human Services said on Thursday.
The initiative is the latest step by Kennedy, who spent years questioning vaccine safety and founded an anti-vaccine group before taking office, to reshape federal immunization policy.
The American Academy of Pediatrics says childhood vaccines are studied in placebo-controlled and comparison-group trials and monitored for safety after approval.
The federal Vaccine Injury Table lists 14 compensable injuries across 16 vaccine types under the Vaccine Injury Compensation Program, a no-fault system in which claimants file against the government, not vaccine makers. Since 1988, it has awarded roughly $5 billion across about 12,300 injury and death claims.
The new moves, which appear to be part of Kennedy's decades-long efforts to sow skepticism about vaccines, come as he faces legal challenges to his attempts to alter US childhood vaccination schedules and growing concern among public health experts about falling immunization rates, particularly against measles, which has seen a resurgence in the US since last year.
The effort centers on a National Institutes of Health clinic opened on Monday to treat and study patients reporting health problems after receiving vaccines, HHS said in a statement.
Other measures include a proposal by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services to reimburse physicians for reporting suspected injuries to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System, or VAERS; a CDC effort to update VAERS; and HHS requiring electronic health records to capture vaccine-related adverse events.
Kennedy has said US children receive too many vaccines, falsely claiming repeatedly that kids get up to 90 doses before age 18, which has been echoed by President Donald Trump . Kennedy has long argued that chemicals in vaccines are dangerous, though experts say there is no evidence of harm.
In his first year heading HHS, he [USN:L4N3SC1BC TEXT:"fired all 17 independent expert members"] of the CDC's vaccine advisory committee and selected new panelists, many of whom shared his anti-vaccine views.
In January, the CDC announced a revamped childhood vaccine schedule that reduced recommended vaccines, dropping universal recommendations for flu, rotavirus, hepatitis A, hepatitis B at birth, some forms of meningitis and respiratory syncytial virus.
A federal court issued [USN:L1N3ZF00J TEXT:"a preliminary injunction"] in March blocking key parts of the proposed changes, finding that Kennedy and HHS had violated federal law in reshaping the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices. The injunction has prevented ACIP from holding meetings to make recommendations on immunizations often needed for insurance coverage.

items.body:
El senador Flavio Bolsonaro aventaja ligeramente a Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en una simulación de la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales de Brasil del 25 de octubre, reveló el jueves una encuesta de Datafolha.
El senador, hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, obtendría el 49% de los votos frente al 45% de Lula, según la encuesta de Datafolha.
Se trata de la primera encuesta de Datafolha tras la primera vuelta celebrada el domingo, en la que el joven Bolsonaro superó sorprendentemente a Lula.

items.title: Flavio Bolsonaro slightly ahead of Lula in Brazil runoff, Datafolha poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is slightly leading President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a simulated scenario of the October 25 presidential runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
items.body:
Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is slightly leading President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a simulated scenario of the October 25 presidential runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
The senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 49% of the vote compared with 45% for Lula, Datafolha poll showed.
It is the first Datafolha poll after the [USN:L6N45N1A0 TEXT:"first-round vote"] on Sunday, in which the younger Bolsonaro surprisingly led Lula.
The poll's result still represents a technical tie as the poll's margin of error is of plus-minus 2 percentage points.
5% of the respondents said they would cast a blank vote, and undecided voters made up 1%, the poll showed.
Datafolha surveyed 2,520 people in-person between October 6-7.

items.body:
＜為替＞ ユーロ圏の国債利回り上昇を受けたユーロ売り・ドル買いの動きが一服する中、ドルが軟調に推移した。一方、年内の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利見通しに対する予想はおおむね維持された    原油価格の急騰でインフレ懸念が強まる中、ユーロ圏の国債利回りは再び大幅に上昇。フランスやイタリアなど債務水準の高い国の国債に売りが集中した。     シムコープのクリストフ・ション氏は「他の多くの通貨は金融政策見通しと逆相関関係にあるように見えるが、それは全てをドルとＦＲＢが支配していたためであり、この状況はここ数週間続いている」と指摘。その上で「興味深いのは、現在ユーロに影響を及ぼす別の要因、つまりフランスとスペインの政治危機が存在することだ」とし、現在は金利差や金融政策ではなく、ユーロ特有の危機がユーロに影響を及ぼしていると述べた。    一方、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測は依然として低い。    ＦＲＢのウォラー理事は８日、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％まで引き下げるには、追加の利上げが必要になる可能性が高いと述べた。しかし、利上げのペースについては「柔軟性」があり、１０月のＦＯＭＣで利上げをいったん見送る可能性も残した。    ＦＲＢが７日公表した９月のＦＯＭＣ議事要旨によると、利上げの理由を巡って当局者の見解が分かれていた。     主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．０８％安の１０２．１７。一時、１０２．４６まで上昇していた。    ドルは対円で０．１２％安の１５７．８８円。日銀は、原材料コスト上昇による価格引き上げの動きが消費財に波及しており、より頻繁に値上げを実施する企業もあると指摘し、インフレ圧力の拡大に対する懸念を示した。    ユーロは０．０８％高の１．１２０４ドル。一時、１．１１７１ドルまで下落した。     英ポンドは０．０７％高の１．３２１９ドル。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが概ね低下した。低下は今週で２度目。３０年債入札で堅調な需要が確認されたことを受け、足元の売り局面にもかかわらず、投資家が長期ゾーン国債の買い意欲を維持していることが示された。    取引序盤は原油高が米国債相場の重しとなっていたものの、トランプ米大統領が１１月の米中間選挙前に米国がイランを攻撃することはないと発言したことを受け、原油は小幅に値を戻した。      アナリストは、３０年債入札への堅調な需要がこの日の相場上昇の大きな要因になったと指摘。最高落札利回りは５．６１８％と、入札締め切り時点の予想利回りを下回った。応札倍率は２．５４倍と、過去６回の入札平均である２．４１倍を上回る水準となった。    インフラストラクチャー・キャピタル・マネジメントのジェイ・ハットフィールド最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、債券市場で１０年債利回りがおそらくピークを付けたと考えているとし、「ピークは恐らく５．３０％近辺、あるいはそれより低い水準だったのではないかと思う」と指摘。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げを巡る悲観論もすでにピークを打ったと考えていると述べた。同氏はＦＲＢが今回のサイクルで利上げできるのは１回のみと予想。現在市場が織り込んでいる３回に対して慎重な見方を示した。    １０年債利回りは５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の５．２２７％。前日には２４年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。    ３０年債利回りは５．９ｂｐ低下の５．６０２％。    金利見通しを反映する２年債利回りは１．３ｂｐ低下の４．７５１％。    ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は４７．１ｂｐ。序盤には５４．２ｂｐと、８月中旬以来の大きさとなる場面もあった。    ＦＲＢのウォラー理事が８日、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％まで引き下げるには、追加の利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとしつつ、利上げのペースについては「柔軟性」があると発言したことを受け、２年債利回りは上昇し、上げ幅は１０年債利回りを上回った。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種・ナスダック総合が下落して取引を終えた。中東情勢の緊迫化と米国の原油生産減少を受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフレや利上げへの懸念が強まった。半導体株の下落も重しとなった。     主要株価指数では、ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が最も大きな下落率を記録した。同指数は６日に終値で過去最高値を付けていた。    今年に入って８０％超上昇していた半導体株が３．４％安とアンダーパフォームした。オープンＡＩの年換算売上高が、同社が従来示唆していた水準を２００億ドル下回ると英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が報じたことなどが重しとなった。    ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのチーフ株式ストラテジスト、テリー・サンドベン氏は「市場は来週始まる第３・四半期決算シーズンを前に横ばいで推移している。加えて、イランでの紛争が続き、原油価格を押し上げている」と指摘。「同様に示唆的なのは、年初来、株式相場は上昇しやすい地合いが続いてきたことだ」と述べた。    原油価格は、ホルムズ海峡で船舶への攻撃が相次いだことに加え、ハリケーンの影響による米国の生産減少を巡る懸念から急伸した。    Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の主要１１業種では、エネルギーが上昇率トップだった。一方、半導体株への売りを背景に情報技術の下落率が最大だった。    メモリー半導体大手の韓国サムスン電子が過去最高の四半期営業益を見込んだものの市場心理の改善にはつながらず、同社株はソウル市場で下落して取引を終えた。競合の米マイクロン・テクノロジーは４．８％下落した。nL6N45T1BN    米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は７日、ブロードコムがオープンＡＩの人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体向けに５００億ドルの資金調達の調整を進めているほか、オラクルも金額は不明だが調達を模索していると報じた。これを受け、ハイテク企業による大規模な債券発行が資本獲得競争を激化させるとの懸念が高まった。    ブロードコムは４．４％、オラクルは５．５％、それぞれ下落した。    飲料大手ペプシコは３．７％高。通期のコア利益見通しを引き下げる一方、追加のコスト削減を進めると表明した。    コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスは０．４％下落。メキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルの買収を模索していると伝わった。チポトレは６．２％急伸した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 前日に約２カ月ぶり安値を付けた後、ＦＲＢの利上げ方針や米国債務水準への懸念が交錯する中で小幅に上昇した。金現物は０．４％高の１オンス＝４１２６．７８ドルとなり、米金先物１２月限は０．４％高の４１５７ドルで取引を終えた。

米ドルと米１０年債利回りは２日連続で高水準を維持。ウィズダムツリーのコモディティストラテジスト、ニテシュ・シャー氏は「高水準の債務への懸念が広がる中、金は法定通貨や政府資産の対極として選好されやすい」と指摘した。

ＦＲＢの９月のＦＯＭＣ議事要旨では、利上げの必要性を巡り政策当局者の意見が分かれたことが示された。市場では１０月の利上げ確率が１７％、１２月は８１％と見込まれている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は４％上昇して取引を終えた。中東での紛争継続を巡る懸念が再燃したほか、米南部メキシコ湾岸に接近しているハリケーンによる供給混乱の拡大も意識された。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．０８ドル（４．１％）高の１バレル＝１０４．２８ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．２１ドル（３．６％）上昇の９１．４９ドルとなった。    米国による対イラン攻撃の可能性が懸念されたほか、ハリケーン「イサイアス」が９日に上陸する見通しであることを背景に、両指標とも５ドル超上昇する場面もあった。ブレントは一時、９月２９日以来の高値を付けた。    ただその後、トランプ米大統領が米国がイランと「建設的な」協議を行っているとした上で、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないとの考えを表明したことを受け、価格は高値から押し戻された。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

＜為替＞ ユーロ圏の国債利回り上昇を受けたユーロ売り・ドル買いの動きが一服する中、ドルが軟調に推移した。一方、年内の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利見通しに対する予想はおおむね維持された    原油価格の急騰でインフレ懸念が強まる中、ユーロ圏の国債利回りは再び大幅に上昇。フランスやイタリアなど債務水準の高い国の国債に売りが集中した。     シムコープのクリストフ・ション氏は「他の多くの通貨は金融政策見通しと逆相関関係にあるように見えるが、それは全てをドルとＦＲＢが支配していたためであり、この状況はここ数週間続いている」と指摘。その上で「興味深いのは、現在ユーロに影響を及ぼす別の要因、つまりフランスとスペインの政治危機が存在することだ」とし、現在は金利差や金融政策ではなく、ユーロ特有の危機がユーロに影響を及ぼしていると述べた。    一方、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測は依然として低い。    ＦＲＢのウォラー理事は８日、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％まで引き下げるには、追加の利上げが必要になる可能性が高いと述べた。しかし、利上げのペースについては「柔軟性」があり、１０月のＦＯＭＣで利上げをいったん見送る可能性も残した。    ＦＲＢが７日公表した９月のＦＯＭＣ議事要旨によると、利上げの理由を巡って当局者の見解が分かれていた。     主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．０８％安の１０２．１７。一時、１０２．４６まで上昇していた。    ドルは対円で０．１２％安の１５７．８８円。日銀は、原材料コスト上昇による価格引き上げの動きが消費財に波及しており、より頻繁に値上げを実施する企業もあると指摘し、インフレ圧力の拡大に対する懸念を示した。    ユーロは０．０８％高の１．１２０４ドル。一時、１．１１７１ドルまで下落した。     英ポンドは０．０７％高の１．３２１９ドル。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが概ね低下した。低下は今週で２度目。３０年債入札で堅調な需要が確認されたことを受け、足元の売り局面にもかかわらず、投資家が長期ゾーン国債の買い意欲を維持していることが示された。    取引序盤は原油高が米国債相場の重しとなっていたものの、トランプ米大統領が１１月の米中間選挙前に米国がイランを攻撃することはないと発言したことを受け、原油は小幅に値を戻した。      アナリストは、３０年債入札への堅調な需要がこの日の相場上昇の大きな要因になったと指摘。最高落札利回りは５．６１８％と、入札締め切り時点の予想利回りを下回った。応札倍率は２．５４倍と、過去６回の入札平均である２．４１倍を上回る水準となった。    インフラストラクチャー・キャピタル・マネジメントのジェイ・ハットフィールド最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、債券市場で１０年債利回りがおそらくピークを付けたと考えているとし、「ピークは恐らく５．３０％近辺、あるいはそれより低い水準だったのではないかと思う」と指摘。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げを巡る悲観論もすでにピークを打ったと考えていると述べた。同氏はＦＲＢが今回のサイクルで利上げできるのは１回のみと予想。現在市場が織り込んでいる３回に対して慎重な見方を示した。    １０年債利回りは５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の５．２２７％。前日には２４年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。    ３０年債利回りは５．９ｂｐ低下の５．６０２％。    金利見通しを反映する２年債利回りは１．３ｂｐ低下の４．７５１％。    ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は４７．１ｂｐ。序盤には５４．２ｂｐと、８月中旬以来の大きさとなる場面もあった。    ＦＲＢのウォラー理事が８日、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％まで引き下げるには、追加の利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとしつつ、利上げのペースについては「柔軟性」があると発言したことを受け、２年債利回りは上昇し、上げ幅は１０年債利回りを上回った。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種・ナスダック総合が下落して取引を終えた。中東情勢の緊迫化と米国の原油生産減少を受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフレや利上げへの懸念が強まった。半導体株の下落も重しとなった。     主要株価指数では、ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が最も大きな下落率を記録した。同指数は６日に終値で過去最高値を付けていた。    今年に入って８０％超上昇していた半導体株が３．４％安とアンダーパフォームした。オープンＡＩの年換算売上高が、同社が従来示唆していた水準を２００億ドル下回ると英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が報じたことなどが重しとなった。    ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのチーフ株式ストラテジスト、テリー・サンドベン氏は「市場は来週始まる第３・四半期決算シーズンを前に横ばいで推移している。加えて、イランでの紛争が続き、原油価格を押し上げている」と指摘。「同様に示唆的なのは、年初来、株式相場は上昇しやすい地合いが続いてきたことだ」と述べた。    原油価格は、ホルムズ海峡で船舶への攻撃が相次いだことに加え、ハリケーンの影響による米国の生産減少を巡る懸念から急伸した。    Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の主要１１業種では、エネルギーが上昇率トップだった。一方、半導体株への売りを背景に情報技術の下落率が最大だった。    メモリー半導体大手の韓国サムスン電子が過去最高の四半期営業益を見込んだものの市場心理の改善にはつながらず、同社株はソウル市場で下落して取引を終えた。競合の米マイクロン・テクノロジーは４．８％下落した。nL6N45T1BN    米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は７日、ブロードコムがオープンＡＩの人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体向けに５００億ドルの資金調達の調整を進めているほか、オラクルも金額は不明だが調達を模索していると報じた。これを受け、ハイテク企業による大規模な債券発行が資本獲得競争を激化させるとの懸念が高まった。    ブロードコムは４．４％、オラクルは５．５％、それぞれ下落した。    飲料大手ペプシコは３．７％高。通期のコア利益見通しを引き下げる一方、追加のコスト削減を進めると表明した。    コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスは０．４％下落。メキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルの買収を模索していると伝わった。チポトレは６．２％急伸した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 前日に約２カ月ぶり安値を付けた後、ＦＲＢの利上げ方針や米国債務水準への懸念が交錯する中で小幅に上昇した。金現物は０．４％高の１オンス＝４１２６．７８ドルとなり、米金先物１２月限は０．４％高の４１５７ドルで取引を終えた。

米ドルと米１０年債利回りは２日連続で高水準を維持。ウィズダムツリーのコモディティストラテジスト、ニテシュ・シャー氏は「高水準の債務への懸念が広がる中、金は法定通貨や政府資産の対極として選好されやすい」と指摘した。

ＦＲＢの９月のＦＯＭＣ議事要旨では、利上げの必要性を巡り政策当局者の意見が分かれたことが示された。市場では１０月の利上げ確率が１７％、１２月は８１％と見込まれている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は４％上昇して取引を終えた。中東での紛争継続を巡る懸念が再燃したほか、米南部メキシコ湾岸に接近しているハリケーンによる供給混乱の拡大も意識された。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．０８ドル（４．１％）高の１バレル＝１０４．２８ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．２１ドル（３．６％）上昇の９１．４９ドルとなった。    米国による対イラン攻撃の可能性が懸念されたほか、ハリケーン「イサイアス」が９日に上陸する見通しであることを背景に、両指標とも５ドル超上昇する場面もあった。ブレントは一時、９月２９日以来の高値を付けた。    ただその後、トランプ米大統領が米国がイランと「建設的な」協議を行っているとした上で、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないとの考えを表明したことを受け、価格は高値から押し戻された。

items.title: US to livestream Army execution of Fort Hood shooter, Pentagon official says
items.author: Phil Stewart
items.creator: Phil Stewart
items.summary: The US will livestream the Army's upcoming firing squad execution on December 3 of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move.
items.body:
The US will livestream the Army's upcoming firing squad execution on December 3 of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move.
Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist, is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, who championed the push to execute Hasan by firing squad, had told the Human Events Daily program broadcast earlier on Thursday by Real America's Voice that he planned to make Hasan's execution public. Hegseth did not say how.
"The Secretary is correct. It will be livestreamed. Details will follow," the Pentagon official told Reuters, speaking on condition of anonymity.
Hegseth said deciding to execute Hasan by firing squad at Fort Hood on a Thursday at 1 pm — the approximate time, day of the week and location of the 2009 shooting — was a "no brainer."
"We'll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it's public. Because people need to understand that ... there's serious consequences for these types of things," Hegseth said.
Asked if Hasan had made any final requests, Hegseth said: "Don't care. We'll see him on December 3."
PRESIDENT MUST APPROVE FIRING SQUAD EXECUTION A military jury sentenced Hasan to death in August 2013, after finding him guilty of 45 counts of premeditated murder and attempted premeditated murder for opening fire with a laser-sighted handgun in a medical facility at the sprawling central Texas military base.
The shooting came weeks before Hasan, now 56, was scheduled to be deployed to Afghanistan. He was left partially paralyzed and confined to a wheelchair from being shot by police during his arrest.
Under US military law, a US president must approve an execution by firing squad. President Donald Trump did so on Hegseth's recommendation, the Pentagon disclosed on Monday.
"It hasn't been since World War Two since we've done that. Well, kind of like the mentality we had in World War Two," Hegseth said.
The White House declined to say whether Trump supported the livestreaming, referring questions to the Pentagon.
The group Death Penalty Action, which opposes capital punishment, said Hasan's execution would be the first military execution since 1961.
According to the Death Penalty Information Center, the 1961 execution was carried out by hanging.
The last known executions by US military firing squads were in 1945, the center reported.
At least five states have firing squads on the books, according to the Death Penalty Information Center. In 2025, [USN:L2N3PP0X8 TEXT:"South Carolina"] carried out the first such execution in the United States in 15 years.
Death by firing squad is one of several forms of capital punishment the Trump administration recently added to permissible forms of execution for the gravest of federal crimes, along with electrocution and gas asphyxiation.
The number of federal execution options was expanded in part because of increasing difficulties in obtaining drugs for lethal injections, which have also sometimes proved challenging to carry out.
Plans by the state of Tennessee to execute a woman for the first time in more than 200 years went awry last week when prison personnel botched attempts to administer a lethal injection, leaving the death-row inmate, Christa Pike, alive but hospitalized.
Her lawyers said on Wednesday she awoke "[USN:L1N45T0M9 TEXT:"angry and confused"]" in a hospital. Pike remains very sick and shackled to her hospital bed, they said.
items.raw_description: The US will livestream the Army's upcoming firing squad execution on December 3 of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move.

items.title: SpaceX adquiere espectro de banda baja para convertir a Starlink en operador móvil
items.author: Sana Pashankar, Christopher Palmeri
items.summary: SpaceX adquirió espectro de banda baja a Grain Management para combinar Starlink con una red terrestre y ofrecer cobertura móvil en EE.UU., sujeto a autorización de la FCC.
items.body: Bloomberg — SpaceX ( SPCX ), la empresa de Elon Musk, anunció que adquirió espectro de banda baja que le permitirá utilizar sus satélites Starlink para convertirse en un “importante operador de telefonía móvil” en Estados Unidos, lo que ha provocado una caída de hasta el 8% en las acciones de los operadores de telefonía móvil tradicionales. En una publicación en X el jueves, Musk afirmó que el espectro de banda baja es “la última pieza fundamental del rompecabezas del espectro que necesita SpaceX para ofrecer una cobertura telefónica completa en Estados Unidos”. Las acciones de los principales proveedores de servicios de telefonía móvil cayeron en las operaciones fuera de horario. AT&T Inc. ( T ) bajó un 7,3%, mientras que T-Mobile US Inc. ( TMUS ) y Verizon Communications Inc. ( VZ ) se desplomaron un 6,6% a las 17:00 en Nueva York. Las acciones de SpaceX subieron un 1,5% en las operaciones fuera de horario. Ver más: SpaceX dispara su riesgo crediticio tras buscar US$40.000 millones para chips de Nvidia Bloomberg News informó en agosto de que SpaceX se encontraba entre las empresas interesadas en dicho espectro. Musk, CEO de SpaceX, pareció rechazar la idea, respondiendo “no es cierto” en su plataforma de redes sociales X a la publicación de un usuario que hacía referencia a dicho informe. SpaceX afirmó que, una vez reciba la autorización de la Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones, combinará sus servicios de satélite a móvil con una red terrestre capaz de conectar dispositivos en cualquier lugar. El nuevo espectro, que SpaceX adquirió a la empresa de inversiones Grain Management LLC, permite a la empresa ofrecer un servicio de telefonía móvil capaz de atravesar paredes y prestar servicio a dispositivos en interiores. Según indicó SpaceX en una publicación en su página web, es compatible con la mayoría de los dispositivos móviles actuales. Ni SpaceX ni Grain Management han revelado públicamente el precio del acuerdo. Ver más: SpaceX propone construir un gasoducto para abastecer de combustible a sus cohetes Starship Las licencias de la banda de 800 MHz quedaron disponibles después de que Grain completara en agosto un intercambio de espectro con T-Mobile. Los términos de dicha transacción, aprobados por la Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones, exigían que Grain convocara una licitación para desarrollar el espectro, que, según la orden de la comisión, había estado infrautilizado. La comisión había indicado que deseaba que la licitación concluyera antes del 5 de noviembre. Las licencias cubren prácticamente a toda la población de EE.UU. y se consideran valiosas para ayudar a los proveedores de servicios por satélite a establecer un enlace terrestre para servicios de voz, lo que se conoce como “piloto de red”. Grain se ha mostrado convencida de que los servicios por satélite y terrestres pueden coexistir en la banda de 800 MHz, a pesar de que anteriormente solo se había utilizado para servicios móviles terrestres, según declaró en agosto a Bloomberg una persona familiarizada con la estrategia de la empresa. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: NFL backs Supreme Court review in betting oversight case
items.author: Angelica Medina
items.creator: Angelica Medina
items.summary: The National Football League on Thursday backed New Jersey officials' request for US Supreme Court review of a dispute over whether federal regulators or states should oversee sports-related prediction-market contracts, saying the Commodity Futures Trading Commission may lack resources to adequately police sports betting.
items.body:
The National Football League on Thursday backed New Jersey officials' request for US Supreme Court review of a dispute over whether federal regulators or states should oversee sports-related prediction-market contracts, saying the Commodity Futures Trading Commission may lack resources to adequately police sports betting.
The NFL filed an amicus brief supporting the appeal, urging the court to resolve a split among lower courts over whether the CFTC or state regulators have authority over prediction markets.
"The league is joining with many voices to encourage the Court to take this opportunity, now, to resolve the disagreement in the lower courts about who should regulate prediction markets — the CFTC or the states," an NFL spokesperson told Reuters.
The NFL said the issue would be less significant if the CFTC adopted protections comparable to those used by state gambling regulators, adding that it was "unclear if the Commission has the resources or staff to adequately regulate sports betting."
The league also said it has urged the CFTC and prediction-market companies to adopt safeguards including restrictions on bets susceptible to manipulation, protections against betting by insiders and a minimum age of 21.
"Neither the CFTC nor the prediction market companies themselves — despite our persistent urging — have banned categories of bets susceptible to manipulation or set a 21 age limit," the NFL spokesperson said.
In a statement to Reuters, the CFTC said it had engaged with the NFL from the beginning.
"It's unfortunate the NFL declined to sign an MOU (Memorandum of Understanding) with the CFTC which would've provided the league the ability to better discuss, cooperate, and exchange information with us to promote the integrity and resilience of prediction markets," the agency said.
COURT SPLIT PUTS PREDICTION-MARKET OVERSIGHT IN FOCUS The case follows a September 25 ruling by the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals against prediction-market operator Kalshi, which held that Ohio and Tennessee can regulate its event contracts under their gambling laws.
The ruling deepened a split among federal appeals courts and raised the prospect of Supreme Court review.
Kalshi said it expected the decision would not withstand further review. "The ruling shows exactly why a state-by-state patchwork doesn't work," company spokesperson Dani Lever [USN:L6N45H114 TEXT:"told Reuters last month"].
"Markets can't operate when the rules change at every state line, which is why Congress created a single federal regulator with nationwide rules."
Prediction markets allow users to trade contracts tied to outcomes including sports, elections, weather and cultural events.
States have challenged the ability of operators such as Kalshi and Polymarket to offer such contracts without complying with state gambling laws.
Kalshi has until November 9 to respond to the petition. The court is not expected to decide whether to hear the case before December.
Sports leagues have become increasingly vocal about gambling-related integrity and safety risks as wagering has expanded across the US following the Supreme Court's 2018 decision striking down a federal ban on state-authorized sports betting.
Last month,[USN:L6N45717T TEXT:" the NFL and four other major US professional leagues"], along with their players' associations, called on state regulators to impose lifetime betting bans on people who threaten or harass athletes, coaches, officials or their families over wagers.
items.raw_description: The National Football League on Thursday backed New Jersey officials' request for US Supreme Court review of a dispute over whether federal regulators or states should oversee sports-related prediction-market contracts, saying the Commodity Futures Trading Commission may lack resources to adequately police sports betting.

items.title: Mamdani Says Child Was in Car When ICE Shot Man in New York
items.author: Myles Miller

items.title: Padres ace Michael King has option decision to make
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: After an impressive postseason, San Diego Padres right-hander Michael King faces a decision that could determine whether he returns to the team in 2027.
items.body:
After an impressive postseason, San Diego Padres right-hander Michael King faces a decision that could determine whether he returns to the team in 2027.
The 31-year-old has made it clear that he would welcome another season in San Diego.
King has two seasons remaining on a three-year, $75 million contract and he holds a player option for each of the remaining seasons.
He can either remain with the Padres at a $28 million salary for 2027 or opt out of the deal, accept a $5 million buyout and become a free agent. His 2028 option is worth $30 million.
If King opts out, he would join a free-agent pitching class expected to be headlined by left-hander Tarik Skubal.
After the Padres ended their season with Wednesday's 3-1 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 4 of the National League Division Series, King called it a "future decision."
But after three seasons with the Padres, more than financial factors are involved.
"This is where we started a family," King told reporters after Game 4. "... We started our foundation here. San Diego's been incredible for me, and it's all the way across the country from home.
"But now I feel like I have a second home on the West Coast, so it's been awesome. And yeah, I hope to continue."
King went 1-0 with a 0.64 ERA in three appearances (two starts) this postseason. He gave up just one hit over seven innings while beating the Chicago Cubs in the NL wild-card series.
Against Milwaukee, King gave up one run and three hits over five-plus innings in Game 2. Two days later, he recorded a 40-pitch, two-innings save to help the Padres beat the Brewers in Game 3.
In the 2024 playoffs, King struck out 12 and allowed five hits over seven innings in a win over the Atlanta Braves in the wild-card round.
King is 30-22 with a 3.15 ERA in 77 starts and one relief appearance during three seasons with the Padres. King was acquired from the Yankees along with four other players in the December 2023 trade that sent Juan Soto to New York.
--Field Level Media
