items.body:
Yuliia Dysa　Max Hunder

［キーウ　８日　ロイター］ - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は８日、米国はロシアとウクライナの停戦仲介を模索する一方で、ロシアとの経済関係を追求していると指摘し、ウクライナを支援する意思がないと非難した。ロシアのミサイル攻撃能力を弱めるため、米スペースＸの衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」へのアクセス拡大を求めた。ウクライナの交渉団が協議のため９日と１０日に訪米すると明らかにした。 

関係者によると、米国とウクライナは９日に米フロリダ州マイアミで実務者協議を行う見込み。欧州や北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の当局者も参加する予定という。

ロシアは、プーチン大統領の誕生日に当たる７日から８日にかけて、ウクライナ各地をミサイルと無人機で攻撃した。ゼレンスキー氏は８日夕、 ２日間の攻撃で計７８人が死亡、２１５人が負傷したと述べた。 

同氏は、ロシアの弾道ミサイル発射台をたたくため、スターリンクへのアクセス拡大を求める自身の要請を受け入れるよう、米国に強く求めた。

「ウクライナにスターリンクを開放してもらいたい。イランへの対応の際には開放した。私は率直に訴えてきた。ウクライナにスターリンクを提供し、われわれが自国の空を守り、制空権を確保するのを支援してほしい。そうすればプーチン大統領は交渉のテーブルに着くだろう」とした。

ルビオ米国務長官は８日、ロシアとウクライナの戦争は危険な膠着状態に陥っていると指摘し、米国は紛争終結に向けた取り組みを継続すると述べた。一方、ロイターは、プーチン大統領の特使であるドミトリエフ氏やトランプ米大統領の娘婿クシュナー氏を含む米ロ高官が、ロシアの欧州向けガスパイプライン事業「ノルドストリーム」に米投資家を参画させる案について協議したと関係者の話を引用して伝えた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、「真実や誠実さはどこにあるのか。何が膠着状態なのか。意思の欠如ではないか」とし、「一方でロシアと将来の経済プロジェクトについて協議しておきながら、他方で外交的な膠着状態に陥っていると言うことはできない」と述べた。

＜東部でバス攻撃＞

ロシア軍は８日、ウクライナ東部ドネツク州クラマトルスクで民間バス２台が攻撃した。ウクライナ当局によると３３人が死亡し数十人が負傷した。ドネツク州知事は「ロシア軍は意図的に民間人を標的にしている。乗客で満員のバスは、１回の攻撃で可能な限り多くの人々を殺害できるため、彼らにとって格好の標的だ」とメッセージアプリ「テレグラム」で述べた。その後、新たな無人機攻撃が２人死亡し、死者は計３５人となった。 

首都キーウでも攻撃で４人が死亡した。

items.summary:
Shares of Chipotle Mexican Grill jumped after the Financial Times reported that Starbucks Corp. has worked with advisers in recent months on a takeover proposal for the burrito chain.

The status of the takeover plans couldn’t be immediately learned and a mega deal of this size might never get off the ground, the FT said, citing people familiar with the matter. Brian Niccol, Starbucks’ chief executive officer since 2024, previously spent six years as the top executive at Chipotle, where he spearheaded a period of rapid growth.

For more, we speak with Redd Brown, Bloomberg News Consumer Reporter. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Refresco plots potential IPO at $10 billion-plus valuation, sources say
items.author: Abigail Summerville, Echo Wang
items.creator: Abigail Summerville, Echo Wang
items.summary: Netherlands-based Refresco and its owner KKR took pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on a potential initial public offering of one of the world's largest independent beverage manufacturers, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Netherlands-based Refresco and its owner KKR (KKR.N) took pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on a potential initial public offering of one of the world's largest independent beverage manufacturers, according to people familiar with the matter.
Refresco is studying a listing which could happen in either the United States or Europe, with any market debut likely valuing the company at more than $10 billion, the people said, speaking anonymously to discuss confidential matters. The plans are preliminary and could change, the people cautioned.
Investment firm KKR acquired the company in 2022 for roughly $8 billion through its global infrastructure strategy, which invests in critical infrastructure assets. Its other investments out of that strategy include utilities, energy and communication services companies.
Refresco and KKR declined to comment.
Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Rotterdam, Netherlands, Refresco works with retailers such as Walmart (WMT.O) and Aldi on their private label beverage products and with branded beverage companies including Coca-Cola (KO.N) , PepsiCo (PEP.O) and Monster Beverage (MNST.O) .
Describing itself as the world's largest independent beverage manufacturer, Refresco provides manufacturing, bottling, warehousing, logistics and distribution services to its partners, and has 85 production facilities across North America, Europe and Australia.
The company generated close to $7 billion of revenue and around $930 million of adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) in 2025, according to its annual report.
Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE.O) , a North Carolina-headquartered beverage manufacturer, could be a suitable peer to Refresco despite mainly working with Coca-Cola, the sources noted. The company has a roughly $12.5 billion market valuation, and trades at an EBITDA multiple of close to 12 times, per data provider LSEG.
The US IPO market had a strong start to the year, with traditional IPOs raising nearly $140 billion so far, according to Dealogic, putting 2026 on pace to approach the record levels of 2021. But market volatility, higher bond yields, rate-hike fears and growing questions over artificial intelligence spending and valuations are threatening to derail what was expected to be a blockbuster fall IPO season.
Several companies, [USN:L4N45L0NO TEXT:"including smart-ring maker Oura,"] have delayed planned listings in recent weeks. Still, IPO advisers and investors said companies are continuing to hold pitch meetings with bankers for roles on public offerings — known as bake-offs. They are also continuing to meet informally with investors and otherwise prepare for offerings, seeking to be ready to move quickly when market conditions improve.

items.title: European industry groups call for urgent EU action on China trade
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Forty-four European industry associations urged EU members on Thursday to take immediate action to combat what they said were unfair Chinese trade practices threatening EU manufacturing and risking further job losses.
items.body:
Forty-four European industry associations urged EU members on Thursday to take immediate action to combat what they said were unfair Chinese trade practices threatening EU manufacturing and risking further job losses.
The call from the associations representing sectors including metals, chemicals and automotive parts comes a week before EU leaders convene in Brussels to discuss how best to tackle a growing trade deficit with China of more than €1 billion ($1.12 billion) a day.
The associations said the European Union should more effectively use all instruments available to impose trade defence measures and adopt a broader approach to look at entire value chains, while avoiding negative impacts on close European partners, such as Britain, Norway and Switzerland.
They said the European Commission needed more staff to process complaints more rapidly. They also called for new tools to deal with state-driven distortions.
EU leaders at the summit are set to discuss [USN:L6N45R0Q0 TEXT:"Franco-German proposals"] for expanded trade defence published on Monday and European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic's two-day trip to Beijing ending on Friday. Sefcovic is [USN:L6N45T0P1 TEXT:"seeking to persuade China"] to agree to cut exports to the EU in one sector, most likely hybrid vehicles.
($1 = 0.8920 euros)

items.title: Taylor Farms suspenderá envíos de lechuga mexicana a EE.UU. el próximo verano
items.author: Kristina Peterson
items.summary: Tras la aparición este verano de casos de ciclosporiasis, una enfermedad gastrointestinal, la empresa suspendió la producción en las instalaciones del centro de México relacionadas con el parásito y n ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Taylor Farms suspenderá indefinidamente los envíos de lechuga iceberg del centro de México durante gran parte del próximo verano, después de que sus productos fueran vinculados con un brote parasitario que causó diarrea este verano. La empresa, con sede en Salinas, California, no cosechará ni procesará lechuga iceberg procedente del centro de México durante la temporada de Cyclospora definida por los Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades (CDC) de EE.UU., según señaló Bruce Taylor, director ejecutivo de Taylor Farms, en una carta pública. La temporada se extiende del 1 de mayo al 31 de agosto, según los CDC, y coincide con la temporada de lluvias en México, indicó la empresa en la carta. Taylor Farms cultiva y procesa una gran parte de los productos hortofrutícolas vendidos en EE.UU., incluido el 40% de las ensaladas envasadas o empaquetadas, según la empresa. El proveedor también ha señalado que es el mayor productor de verduras ecológicas de Norteamérica. Tras la aparición este verano de casos de ciclosporiasis, una enfermedad gastrointestinal, la empresa suspendió la producción en sus instalaciones del centro de México , que habían sido relacionadas con el parásito. Taylor Farms no ha indicado cuándo las reabrirá. En septiembre, los CDC declararon oficialmente el fin del brote causado por el parásito detectado en la lechuga iceberg, que provocó miles de infecciones y dos fallecimientos este verano. Más de 12.800 personas contrajeron ciclosporiasis relacionada con la lechuga vendida por Taylor Farms, según la agencia. A principios de este mes, la Administración de Alimentos y Medicamentos (FDA) concluyó su investigación y dijo que había identificado varias explotaciones agrícolas y una planta de procesamiento en México que suministraban la lechuga retirada del mercado y distribuida por Taylor Fresh Foods, la empresa matriz de Taylor Farms. La FDA indicó que recogió dos muestras in situ en México que dieron positivo por Cyclospora. “Aunque actualmente no hay pruebas suficientes para determinar de forma concluyente cómo se produjo la contaminación en este brote, las muestras positivas demuestran que la Cyclospora estaba presente en el entorno donde se cultivaba y procesaba la lechuga”, afirmó la FDA. Taylor Farms señaló a principios de este mes que ya no trabajaba con el productor independiente en cuyas instalaciones se encontró una muestra positiva. El director ejecutivo de Taylor Farms señaló que la empresa también estaba ampliando su programa de control sanitario durante todo el año y aumentando los análisis del agua de riego y de sus cultivos, además de invertir en nuevas investigaciones y tecnologías para facilitar la detección de Cyclospora. Lee más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Aces star A’ja Wilson wins record fifth MVP award
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las Vegas Aces star A'ja Wilson became the first five-time MVP in WNBA history Thursday, extending her record with another selection as the league's top player.
items.body:
Las Vegas Aces star A'ja Wilson became the first five-time MVP in WNBA history Thursday, extending her record with another selection as the league's top player.
Wilson received 65 of 74 first-place votes, becoming the first player to win three straight MVP awards. Prior to the current streak, she also won in 2020 and 2022.
Wilson, 30, averaged 26.2 points to lead the league in scoring for the third straight season. She also averaged 9.4 rebounds, 3.2 assists, 1.9 blocked shots and 1.4 steals in 41 games.
Wilson (713 points) also received nine second-place votes. Minnesota rookie point guard Olivia Miles (442) earned six first-place votes to finish second, while Indiana Fever guard Kelsey Mitchell (287 points, two first-place votes) finished third.
Indiana guard Caitlin Clark finished fourth with 212 points and one first-place vote, followed by New York Liberty forward Breanna Stewart with 171 points.
Wilson was very emotional when she was informed of the award on the Aces' practice court.
Later, she reflected on an earlier segment of her life where she never would have guessed "five-time MVP" or "three-time champion" would be labels attached to her name.
"When you dream as a young girl, you dream so big and you write your goals out and you just never imagine you will be able to check them off," Wilson said in a press conference. "And when you're able to check them off -- small wins, big wins -- it truly means a lot. I think that's why I cried a little bit harder on this one because 15-year-old A'ja wasn't sitting up here dreaming about being a five-time MVP, she wasn't dreaming about being a three-time champion, she was dreaming about surviving this world.
"For me to sit up here surrounded by these trophies and to be able to play the game of basketball every single day, it just means a little bit more to me and it's something I won't take for granted."
Wilson, an eight-time All-Star, scored at least 20 points in 33 games, the third-highest single-season streak in WNBA history behind Mitchell's 35 this season and Wilson's 34 in 2024.
Wilson also tied the WNBA single-season record she set in 2025 with 13 games of at least 30 points.
The Aces, winners of three of the past four WNBA championships, face elimination Friday night when they host the Golden State Valkyries in Game 3 of their best-of-five semifinal series. Golden State holds a 2-0 lead.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Storm Simon seen exploding into major hurricane before hitting Mexico
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tropical Storm Simon is forecast to rapidly strengthen into a major hurricane before striking Mexico's Pacific coast this weekend, threatening destructive winds, life-threatening flooding and dangerous storm surge, the US National Hurricane Center said on Thursday.
items.body:
Tropical Storm Simon is forecast to rapidly strengthen into a major hurricane before striking Mexico's Pacific coast this weekend, threatening destructive winds, life-threatening flooding and dangerous storm surge, the US National Hurricane Center said on Thursday.
Simon was about 245 miles (395 km) south of Manzanillo at midday, with maximum sustained winds of 65 mph (100 kph), the Miami-based center said. It was moving west at 5 mph and is expected to turn northward on Friday, approaching southwestern and west-central Mexico late on Saturday.
The hurricane center said Simon was likely to become a hurricane later on Thursday and intensify into a "very dangerous" Category 4 hurricane before reaching the coast.
A hurricane watch was in effect from the port city of Manzanillo to vacation hotspot Punta Mita.
Forecasters warned Simon could dump 8 to 15 inches (20 to 38 cm) of rain across parts of southwestern Mexico through Sunday, with isolated totals of up to 25 inches (64 cm) possible in the states of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in mountainous areas.
A dangerous storm surge was also possible near and east of where the storm's center makes landfall, the center said, with large and destructive waves expected along the coast. Swells generated by Simon were forecast to create hazardous surf and rip current conditions over the coming days.
Private forecaster AccuWeather said Simon could make landfall in western Mexico on Sunday with wind gusts of 120 to 130 mph (193 to 209 kph) near the point of impact and storm surge of up to 15 feet (4.6 meters) in the worst-hit areas. It said some of the same regions affected by Hurricane Polo late last month were now facing another tropical threat.
AccuWeather also said tropical moisture from Simon could spread into the US Southwest next week, bringing 1 to 2 inches (2.5 to 5 cm) of rain to parts of New Mexico, eastern Arizona, southern Colorado and western Texas, with higher totals possible in southern New Mexico.

items.title: Most Medicare Advantage drug plan enrollees in high-quality plans, US government says
items.author: Amina Niasse, Sahil Pandey
items.creator: Amina Niasse, Sahil Pandey
items.summary: The US government said on Thursday that about 71% of Medicare Advantage prescription drug plan enrollees are currently in contracts that will have quality ratings of four stars or higher in 2027, a measure aimed at helping consumers compare health plans.
items.body:
The US government said on Thursday that about 71% of Medicare Advantage prescription drug plan enrollees are currently in contracts that will have quality ratings of four stars or higher in 2027, a measure aimed at helping consumers compare health plans.
The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, part of the US Department of Health and Human Services, rates Medicare Advantage and prescription drug plans on a scale of one to five stars, with five stars indicating the highest quality. Higher ratings lead to bonus payments from the government that collectively amount to billions of dollars and boost plan enrollment.
About 95% of Humana members were enrolled in plans that scored four stars or higher, according to an Oppenheimer calculation, a 53% improvement compared with the year prior.
Oppenheimer analyst Michael Wiederhorn said improved scores could add $3.6 billion for Humana in revenue and provide greater visibility into future earnings.
Average ratings for UnitedHealth and CVS declined 15% from the year prior, Wiederhorn said, while Elevance and Centene fell 10% and 9%, respectively.
Shares of Humana (HUM.N) rose about 14% in extended trading, while those of UnitedHealth and CVS Health (CVS.N) fell about 0.5% and 4%, respectively.
The government posted a low performance warning for a California-based prescription drug plan operated by CVS Health's Aetna insurance unit.
Aetna President Steve Nelson said the company's performance ratings reflected progress in its clinical services and improved health outcomes for members.
UnitedHealth Group (UNH.N) , one of the largest providers of Medicare Advantage plans in the United States, said the ratings were in line with its expectations.
The companies operate government-backed Medicare Advantage plans for adults aged 65 and older and people with disabilities. CMS will pay insurers over $13 billion in bonus payments in 2026, according to data from health policy research firm KFF.
CMS also said about 37% of Medicare Advantage prescription drug contracts that will be offered in 2027 earned four stars or higher for their overall rating.
The ratings are designed to help beneficiaries compare plans based on factors such as customer satisfaction, access to care and management of chronic conditions. Five-star plans attract more members and can enroll new ones round the year.
The 2027 ratings will be displayed during Medicare open enrollment, which runs from October 15 through December 7, and will affect 2028 Medicare Advantage quality bonus payments.
UnitedHealthcare and Aetna can offset reductions in bonus payments with membership changes and private health plans the companies operate, Oppenheimer's Wiederhorn said.
A spokesperson for Humana did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
"These results provide a strong foundation for further progress and we look forward to working with CMS as it modernizes the Star Ratings program," a spokesperson for UnitedHealthcare said.

items.title: OpenAI's annualized revenue $20 billion less than previously signaled, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20 billion less than has been previously signaled, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, citing financial documents shared with investors.
items.body:
OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20 billion less than has been previously signaled, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, citing financial documents shared with investors.
OpenAI did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Reuters could not independently verify the report.
Here are some details:
The company has recently told investors its revenue was approaching $50 billion on an annualized basis at the end of September, the report said, far short of the [USN:L4N45L1EC TEXT:"$70 billion reported by"] media outlets, including Reuters, late last month
The discrepancy arose from attempts by OpenAI's own investors to produce a direct comparison with Anthropic's annualized revenue, the FT reported, citing a person with knowledge of the matter
The pair calculate the figure in different ways, with Anthropic including the revenue from sales via cloud partners such as AWS and Google Cloud, while OpenAI does not, the Financial Times report said
Annualized revenue run rate is sometimes misleading sales metric, which often involves multiplying one month's revenue by 12, but it has nonetheless become a popular metric commonly used by fast-growing Silicon Valley startups
OpenAI and its rival Anthropic are potentially preparing to go public, which could give Wall Street a clearer view of their finances, including the sustainability of their rapid revenue growth due to the AI boom

items.title: RTX's Raytheon wins up to $6.3 billion US missile contract
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: RTX's Raytheon said on Thursday it won a multi-year US military contract worth up to $6.3 billion to produce and sustain Standard Missile-3 Block IB interceptors, as the Pentagon seeks to rebuild missile-defence inventories and boost munitions production.
items.body:
RTX's Raytheon said on Thursday it won a multi-year US military contract worth up to $6.3 billion to produce and sustain Standard Missile-3 Block IB interceptors, as the Pentagon seeks to rebuild missile-defence inventories and boost munitions production.
The award comes as the Pentagon looks to replenish stockpiles depleted by conflicts in the Middle East and meet growing demand for air and missile defence systems.
The Standard Missile-3 Block IB is a ballistic missile-defence interceptor used by the U.S. Navy against short- and intermediate-range ballistic missile threats.
The deal follows a series of large Pentagon missile contracts. In October, Raytheon secured a contract worth up to [USN:L1N45N15T TEXT:"$24.4 billion"] to produce Standard Missile-6 interceptors for the U.S. Navy, while Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) won a $58.6 billion Patriot missile contract in July.
The agreements are part of the Trump administration's push to expand U.S. weapons production by encouraging contractors to increase manufacturing capacity. Industry executives, however, have warned that a lack of congressional funding could delay investment in facilities and supply chains.
Raytheon said it has invested in expanding production capacity for the Standard Missile family. Work under the contract will be performed primarily at its facilities in Tucson, Arizona, and Huntsville, Alabama.

items.title: Peso mexicano lidera pérdidas cambiarias tras minuta Banxico, bolsa retoma senda positiva
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El peso mexicano registró el jueves el peor desempeño entre una cesta de monedas principales, después de que la minuta de la más reciente reunión del Banco de México abrió la puerta a posibles recortes de la tasa clave de interés si la inflación continúa cediendo.
items.body:
El peso mexicano registró el jueves el peor desempeño entre una cesta de monedas principales, después de que la minuta de la más reciente reunión del [USN:L1N45U0OW TEXT:"Banco de México"] abrió la puerta a posibles recortes de la tasa clave de interés si la inflación continúa cediendo.
La perspectiva de menores rendimientos en México amenaza con reducir el diferencial frente a Estados Unidos, en un contexto en el que se espera que la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] (Fed) siga elevando el costo de los créditos, restando atractivo a las operaciones de carry trade que durante años han apuntalado a la divisa local.
* La moneda cotizaba en 18.1950 unidades hacia el cierre de los negocios, con una pérdida del 1.2%, pese a que el [USN:L1N45U0UR TEXT:"dólar estadounidense"] cedió impulso durante la sesión a medida que se moderó una subida de los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona euro.
* Según la minuta, tres de los cinco miembros de la [USN:L1N45U0OW TEXT:"junta de gobierno"] de Banxico consideraron que podrían evaluarse futuros recortes de tasas si mejora el panorama inflacionario. Aun así, los funcionarios señalaron que el balance de riesgos para la inflación sigue sesgado al alza.
* Datos publicados por la mañana mostraron que el [USN:L1N45U0FT TEXT:"índice general de precios al consumidor"] se aceleró en septiembre, aunque menos de lo previsto. El componente subyacente, en tanto, continuó moderándose, pero se mantuvo en la parte alta del rango objetivo.
* El peso ha estado bajo presión desde que la Fed elevó su tasa a mediados de septiembre y anticipó nuevos ajustes, mientras que Banxico mantuvo la suya sin cambios y descartó responder mecánicamente a los movimientos de la autoridad estadounidense.
* En medio de las turbulencias, la moneda llegó a negociarse durante el día en 18.23 unidades por dólar y analistas no descartan que podría seguir bajo presión.
* "Mi lectura inicial es que el sesgo sigue siendo alcista mientras respete la zona de 17.90–18.00, con una primera resistencia relevante entre 18.23 y 18.46 pesos", dijo Humberto Calzada, economista jefe de Rankia Latinoamérica.
* La bolsa mexicana, por su parte, retomó la tendencia positiva de las últimas jornadas, que fue interrumpida el miércoles por un ajuste de posiciones, mientras los inversores se preparan para el próximo inicio de la temporada de reportes corporativos del tercer trimestre.
* El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) subió un 0.52% a 64,986.91 puntos, con lo que recuperó parte de la caída del 1% registrada el miércoles.
* Las acciones de la embotelladora Coca-Cola FEMSA (KOFUBL.MX) encabezaron las alzas, con un avance del 3.21% a 199.72 pesos, seguidas por los títulos de su matriz, la también minorista FEMSA (FEMSAUBD.MX) , que sumaron un 2.88% a 216.60 pesos.
* En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años cayó siete puntos básicos a un 9.32%, mientras que la tasa a 20 años descendió cinco puntos base, a 9.76%.

BONDS: UK gilt yields at [USN:S8N42Q0DU TEXT:"19-year high"], Italian yields 3-year high but euro spreads tighten. US yields fall up to 6 bps at long end after strong 30-year auction, curve flattens most in 3 weeks.
COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L6N45U00Z TEXT:"Oil"] +4%, largely ignoring Trump's Iran pledge. Brent has best day in a month.

Today's Talking Points:
Reality check
US tech and AI stocks sank on Thursday after the FT reported that OpenAI's annualized revenues are $20 billion lower than the $70 billion previously signaled. It appears that there is a difference between how OpenAi and Anthropic book revenues in their accounts, which goes a long way to explaining the discrepancy.
However, it also gets to the heart of investors' concerns about the AI buildout, namely the borrowing, off-balance sheet debt, circular financing, and ultimately, future returns. With trillions on the table, and stock prices and concentration at record highs, markets are vulnerable to reports like this. Especially regarding OpenAI which, along with Anthropic, is one of the most important parts in the whole AI story.
Scores on the doors
Thursday's US 30-year bond auction wrapped up a week that saw Treasury sell nearly $120 billion of 3-, 10- and 30-year debt. The long bond sale cleared at 5.618%, reportedly the highest since 2000, but demand was strong - the bid/cover ratio of 2.54 was one of the highest in the last decade, primary dealers' takedown was low, and indirect bidders - a proxy for foreign central banks - took up a high share.
Overall, this week's sales went much better than the 2-7 year auctions two weeks ago, in which the 5-year sale was particularly bad. The highest yields since the 2000s attracted buyers, and the question now is whether the selloff is over. Some market participants on Thursday mischievously pointed to the front cover of The Economist, sometimes seen as a contrarian indicator, as a signal that it is. The latest cover asks the question: 'Will bonds blow up?'
Tariff impact on inflation
Were it not for President Donald Trump's tariffs, US consumer goods' prices would have fallen. As it was, however, they rose due to the tariffs, which had added nearly 3 percentage points to goods price inflation as of February this year. So says the authors of a New York Fed paper published this week, in which they studied a sample basket of 67 goods.
The good news? The pass through has likely faded by now and base effects mean the tariff contribution will be negative through the middle of next year. Among the other takeaways, around a quarter of a tariff increase is passed through to goods prices, although the indirect effect on goods made in the US takes longer to materialize, so the full effect of a tariff takes about a year to appear.

items.title: Depois de cobrança de aliados, PT amplia participação de Alckmin em campanha
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.summary: Discreto até agora na sua participação na campanha eleitoral, o vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin ganhará mais espaço nesse segundo turno, depois de cobrança de aliados por uma presença sua mais forte não apenas em atos, mas na própria propaganda eleitoral.
items.body:
Discreto até agora na sua participação na campanha eleitoral, o vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin ganhará mais espaço nesse segundo turno, depois de cobrança de aliados por uma presença sua mais forte não apenas em atos, mas na própria propaganda eleitoral.
"Esquecido" no primeiro turno, Alckmin fez poucos atos sozinho, sem Lula, e também não participou das inserções eleitorais. Agora, com Lula ainda se concentrando em gravações e reuniões internas de coordenação, a agenda já está cheia.
A cobrança por uma participação mais ativa do vice-presidente já vem de antes do primeiro turno, mas aumentou depois que Flávio Bolsonaro ficou quase 2 pontos percentuais à frente do presidente na votação de domingo.
A avaliação dos aliados é que Alckmin tem capacidade de atrair um eleitor moderado que não quer votar em Flávio, mas não sente confiança em Lula.
Da mesma forma, Alckmin teria esse espaço com o mercado financeiro. Oriundo do PSDB, o vice, mesmo tendo se aliado com o PT, é visto mais favoravelmente pelo mercado. Até agora, no entanto, o PT havia deixado essa interlocução com o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan.
Como mostrou a Reuters, Alckmin é mesmo cotado para assumir o Ministério da Fazenda em um eventual novo mandato de Lula, o que é considerado um sinal de estabilidade fiscal.
AGENDA POPULAR E MERCADO FINANCEIRO O vice-presidente gravou inserções eleitorais na quarta-feira e também fez uma visita à feira de Ceilândia, maior cidade-satélite do Distrito Federal, com Leandro Grass, candidato do PT ao governo do DF, que disputa o segundo turno.
Nesta quinta, foi à comunidade de Paraisópolis, em São Paulo.
Nas duas participações, fez um tipo de campanha que Lula não tem feito, até pelas dificuldades de ser presidente: caminhar nas ruas, tirar fotos, postar vídeos.
O vice ainda deve ter outra agenda popular no próximo domingo: participar de uma manifestação organizada pela União Nacional dos Estudantes (UNE) na Avenida Paulista.
Alckmin também deve assumir dois outros papéis nesse segundo turno, de acordo com fontes ouvidas pela Reuters: o contato com comunidades religiosas e com empresários e representantes do mercado financeiro.
Ainda que católico fervoroso, o vice-presidente tem boa relação com religiosos de diferentes matizes, e sua agenda já está tomada de eventos do tipo.
Na noite desta quinta, participa de uma live com católicos chamada "Plenária Povo de Deus com a Democracia"; no sábado, grava uma sabatina com evangélicos e ainda participa de um evento de apoio à chapa presidencial organizado pelo grupo Judias e Judeus pela Democracia, em São Paulo.
No dia 12, como faz há 40 anos, Alckmin irá a Aparecida, participar da missa na Basílica pelo dia da Padroeira.

items.title: Kremlin: Russia agrees with Rubio that Ukraine conflict is in a stalemate
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov was quoted as saying on Thursday that Russia agreed with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the Ukraine conflict was in a stalemate.
items.body:
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov was quoted as saying on Thursday that Russia agreed with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the Ukraine conflict was in a [USN:L1N45U0GU TEXT:"stalemate"].
"Yes, we agree with him," Russian news agencies quoted Peskov as saying on the sidelines of a meeting of leaders of ex-Soviet states in Turkmenistan.
State news agency RIA quoted Peskov as saying it was up to diplomats to find ways of moving towards peace.
"The art of diplomacy precisely involves finding some way out that would allow moving onto a peaceful track," Peskov was quoted as saying.
US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will meet Ukrainian representatives on Friday in Miami to discuss new ideas and try to produce a unified proposal for resolving the war, an American source familiar with the plan [USN:L1N45U0VZ TEXT:"said"] on Thursday.
Peskov was quoted as saying he saw no immediate prospect for a three-way summit between Putin, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and US President Donald Trump.
He restated the Kremlin's position that Russia wanted an overall solution to the conflict and was not interested in temporary measures, like a limited ceasefire.
"We are not for a fragmented solution, we are for a comprehensive solution that will allow for sustainable settlement for many, many years, for decades," the agencies quoted him as saying.

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、欧州の参加に期待　9─10日に米国で実務者協議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[８日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は８日、ロシアとウクライナの和平を仲介する米国主導の取り組みの一環として、ウクライナ代表団が９─１０日に米国で協議を行うと明らかにした。また、ウクライナと米国の協議に欧州のパートナー国も加わることを期待していると述べた。

米国の関係筋はこの日、米国とウクライナが９日に米フロリダ州マイアミで実務者協議を行い、ロシアとウクライナの和平を巡る新たな構想や提案などについて話し合うと明らかにした。協議には米国からウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使ら、ウクライナからブダノフ大統領府長官らが出席するほか、英独仏や北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の当局者も招待されているという。

ゼレンスキー大統領は首都キーウで記者団に対し、ロシアによるほぼ連日の攻撃を踏まえ、ウクライナ代表団は防空能力の強化について協議すると述べた。

ロシアはウクライナ全土に対する攻撃を強めており、この２日間の攻撃で７０人を超える民間人が死亡している。

items.title: Petróleo sobe 4% com temores sobre Oriente Médio e impacto do furacão Isaias
items.author: Arathy Somasekhar
items.creator: Arathy Somasekhar
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de 4% nesta quinta-feira, devido ao ressurgimento das preocupações com a guerra em curso no Oriente Médio e às crescentes interrupções no abastecimento causadas por um furacão que se aproxima da costa do Golfo dos Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de 4% nesta quinta-feira, devido ao ressurgimento das preocupações com a guerra em curso no Oriente Médio e às crescentes interrupções no abastecimento causadas por um furacão que se aproxima da costa do Golfo dos Estados Unidos.
Os futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam com alta de US$4,08, ou 4,1%, a US$104,28, enquanto o petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos subiu 3,6%, ou US$3,21, para US$91,49.
Mais cedo, em determinado momento, ambos os contratos registraram alta de mais de US$5 por barril, com o Brent atingindo seu maior nível desde 29 de setembro devido a preocupações com possíveis ataques dos Estados Unidos ao Irã e à previsão de que o furacão Isaias atinja o continente na sexta-feira.
Os preços recuaram de suas máximas depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que Washington estava mantendo discussões produtivas com o Irã e prometeu não atacar o país até depois das eleições intermediárias de 3 de novembro nos EUA.
A agência de notícias iraniana Tasnim informou que o ministro das Relações Exteriores, Abbas Araqchi, disse que Teerã está analisando a resposta dos EUA à sua proposta de reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz em até sete dias, afirmando que responderá nos próximos dias.
No entanto, os EUA impuseram novas sanções ao Irã nesta quinta-feira, visando indivíduos, redes e 17 embarcações pelo transporte de petróleo, derivados de petróleo e produtos petroquímicos iranianos, informou o Departamento do Treasury, em um esforço para aumentar a pressão econômica sobre Teerã.
A França e a Arábia Saudita estão analisando várias opções envolvendo recursos militares franceses para ajudar a proteger o terminal petrolífero de Yanbu, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o chefe do Estado-Maior das Forças Armadas da França, general Fabien Mandon.
A Síria também estava considerando fornecer assistência militar à Arábia Saudita, seu principal aliado, no conflito com os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, no Iêmen, disseram uma autoridade norte-americana e um oficial militar sírio a par do assunto. As opções em consideração incluem ajuda defensiva ou o envio de forças em caráter ofensivo para ajudar as tropas iemenitas apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita, afirmaram as fontes.

items.title: Commanders waive rookie RB Kaytron Allen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Washington Commanders on Thursday waived running back Kaytron Allen, who was a sixth-round draft pick this past April.
items.body:
The Washington Commanders on Thursday waived running back Kaytron Allen, who was a sixth-round draft pick this past April.
Allen, 23, saw snaps in each of Washington's four games so far and rushed 12 times for 41 yards. He also appeared on special teams.
However, the Commanders brought back veteran Austin Ekeler earlier this season to complement starter Jacory Croskey-Merritt and No. 2 back Rachaad White, who have gotten the bulk of the work in Washington's backfield.
Allen starred for four seasons at Penn State, where he never rushed for fewer than 867 yards. He finished his college career with 769 attempts for 4,180 rushing yards and 39 touchdowns, along with 70 receptions for 490 yards and four TDs.
He earned second-team All-America honors from the AFCA in 2025, when he racked up 1,303 rushing yards and 15 touchdowns.
--Field Level Media

items.title: American Express fined $350 million for insufficient anti-money laundering program
items.author: Pete Schroeder, Chris Prentice
items.creator: Pete Schroeder, Chris Prentice
items.summary: American Express was fined $350 million by US bank regulators after they determined the lender's programs to identify potential money laundering were insufficient and the company potentially missed billions of dollars in suspicious activity.
items.body:
American Express was fined $350 million by US bank regulators after they determined the lender's programs to identify potential money laundering were insufficient and the company potentially missed billions of dollars in suspicious activity.
The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and the Federal Reserve announced the enforcement action Thursday, saying the company, primarily via its national bank, failed to maintain a sufficient anti-money laundering compliance program, including inadequate resources, inexperienced staff, weak training, and internal control gaps.
A spokesperson for American Express, which did not admit or deny the regulators' findings, did not respond immediately to a request for comment.
The OCC said "systemic breakdowns" in its monitoring and reporting meant the lender failed to identify, evaluate and sufficiently report roughly $13 billion in suspicious activity over the past decade.
"The OCC expects banks of American Express’s size and complexity to devote sufficient resources to ensure compliance with laws and regulations designed to detect and prevent money laundering, which are critical to both economic and national security,” said Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould in a statement.
Specifically, the OCC said American Express focused on risks in its relatively narrow deposit products, while not devoting sufficient attention to its much larger credit card business. The regulator also identified shortcomings in customer due diligence and identification programs.

items.title: Chuvas reduzem potencial da safra de trigo do RS, afirma Emater
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Uma sequência de chuvas, elevada umidade, baixa luminosidade e a ocorrência de granizo e ventos fortes prejudicaram o potencial produtivo da safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul em 2026, afirmou nesta quinta-feira a Emater, em boletim semanal.
items.body:
Uma sequência de chuvas, elevada umidade, baixa luminosidade e a ocorrência de granizo e ventos fortes prejudicaram o potencial produtivo da safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul em 2026, afirmou nesta quinta-feira a Emater, em boletim semanal.
"No centro-oeste e noroeste do Estado, os eventos meteorológicos no período provocaram acamamento, debulha de espigas e perdas de estruturas reprodutivas em áreas atingidas por granizo, reduzindo as expectativas inicialmente projetadas para a safra", afirmou o órgão de assistência técnica do Rio Grande do Sul.
O Estado poderia ser o principal produtor de trigo do Brasil em 2026, com uma produção de 2,2 milhões de toneladas, segundo a estatal Conab. A Emater não divulgou uma nova projeção.
Esse volume já implicaria em uma redução de 36,8% na comparação com a temporada passada, por diminuição na área plantada e menores produtividades estimadas.
Produtores plantaram menos por questões de mercado e também cautela diante do El Niño, que geralmente traz chuvas excessivas para o Sul do país.
Com a quebra de safra, também registrada no Paraná, o Brasil deverá elevar importações do cereal neste ciclo.
Em nota nesta semana, a Associação Brasileira da Indústria do Trigo (Abitrigo) afirmou que as compras externas podem se aproximar de 9 milhões de toneladas no ciclo atual, acima da projeção inicial de 7,5 milhões. A Conab [USN:L1N44A11V TEXT:"alertou"] já em agosto sobre patamares elevados de importações pelo Brasil.
Nas lavouras em maturação, acrescentou a Emater, a continuidade das chuvas também aumentou a preocupação com os parâmetros de qualidade do produto, especialmente quanto à redução do peso hectolitro (PH) e à atividade enzimática associada à germinação pré-colheita.
A elevada umidade durante o período reprodutivo favoreceu a incidência de doenças fúngicas como giberela, manchas foliares, ferrugens, oídio e de outras doenças, disse a Emater.
A colheita de trigo avançou esta semana para 4% da área total plantada com o cereal no Estado.
As lavouras apresentam avanço expressivo para as fases finais do ciclo, predominando as de enchimento de grãos (60%) e de maturação (27%), segundo o boletim.

items.title: Novo Congresso representa risco para a legislação ambiental, diz Observatório do Clima
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.summary: O próximo Congresso brasileiro provavelmente representará um obstáculo ainda maior para a legislação de proteção ambiental após as eleições deste mês, mostrou um estudo do Observatório do Clima, apontando que quase 70% dos parlamentares eleitos têm pouco ou nenhum comprometimento com questões ambientais.
items.body:
O próximo Congresso brasileiro provavelmente representará um obstáculo ainda maior para a legislação de proteção ambiental após as eleições deste mês, mostrou um estudo do Observatório do Clima, apontando que quase 70% dos parlamentares eleitos têm pouco ou nenhum comprometimento com questões ambientais.
O estudo analisou projetos de lei, propostas legislativas, discursos e declarações públicas de parlamentares novos e reeleitos e concluiu que 64 dos 81 membros do Senado têm um histórico de comprometimento "muito baixo" ou "baixo" com questões ambientais. Na Câmara dos Deputados, 345 dos 511 parlamentares foram classificados na mesma categoria.
O Partido Liberal, sigla do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (RJ) -- que enfrentará o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais ainda neste mês --, é o que tem menor comprometimento com as questões ambientais dentre as principais legendas, segundo o estudo.
Todos os 28 senadores do partido eleitos no domingo, assim como os deputados eleitos, foram classificados como tendo um comprometimento muito baixo nesta área.
Outros partidos de direita, incluindo Novo, Republicanos, Progressistas e União Brasil, também apresentaram baixo apoio a causas ambientais, afirmou o estudo.
Defensores do meio ambiente podem enfrentar um cenário político mais desafiador com a inclinação do Congresso ainda mais à direita e caso Flávio Bolsonaro -- cujos comentários sobre mudanças climáticas já causam preocupação -- seja eleito presidente, afirmou o Observatório do Clima.
A Reuters entrou em contato com os partidos mencionados, mas não obteve resposta.
Propostas que podem enfraquecer as proteções ambientais, incluindo medidas para reduzir áreas protegidas, permitir a mineração em terras indígenas e facilitar os requisitos de licenciamento ambiental, podem ganhar força sob o novo Congresso, acrescentou o grupo.
"Este quadro evidencia quatro anos de muito esforço para aqueles que atuam em clima e meio ambiente, e muita preocupação tanto com graves retrocessos quanto com as terríveis consequências disso tudo para a crise climática. Somando com um governo negacionista de Flávio Bolsonaro, isso significará o caos ambienta", disse Suely Araújo
, coordenadora de políticas públicas do Observatório.
items.raw_description: O próximo Congresso brasileiro provavelmente representará um obstáculo ainda maior para a legislação de proteção ambiental após as eleições deste mês, mostrou um estudo do Observatório do Clima, apontando que quase 70% dos parlamentares eleitos têm pouco ou nenhum comprometimento com questões ambientais.

items.title: トランプ氏「誤解された」、イランがロス「壊滅」可能発言巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は８日、イランがカリフォルニア州の都市を「壊滅させる」ことができるとした自身の発言は誤解されたとの認識を示した。

トランプ大統領は５日、ネブラスカ州で開いた集会で、イランとの戦争に伴うエネルギー価格の高騰について、「世界と米国の安全を守るための代償としては小さい」として自身の政策を擁護。その上で、「イランは一つの都市を破壊することもできる。ロサンゼルスやサンディエゴを壊滅させてみればいい」と述べた。

この発言を受け、カリフォルニア州では民主党指導者だけでなく、一部共和党議員からも批判の声が上がった。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「私が言いたかったのは、ガソリン価格の一時的な上昇は、イランが核兵器を保有しないための代償としてはささいなものだということだ」と説明。その上で、「大きな代償」について「サンディエゴやロサンゼルスが爆撃されたらどうなるか想像できるか」とし、両都市が大好きだと述べた。

items.title: New ‘Bridgerton’ series to follow young Violet and Edmund Bridgerton romance
items.author: Danielle Broadway
items.creator: Danielle Broadway
items.summary: A new “Bridgerton” limited television series centered on a younger version of Violet Bridgerton is in the works, Netflix and Shondaland announced on Instagram on Thursday.
items.body:
A new “Bridgerton” limited television series centered on a younger version of Violet Bridgerton is in the works, Netflix (NFLX.O) and Shondaland announced on Instagram on Thursday.
"The time has come for us to turn our attention to the Matriarch of our beloved Bridgertons," the social media post said, referring to Violet Bridgerton, who has been portrayed by English actress Ruth Gemmell across the first four seasons of the Netflix series.
"A new series, chronicling the romance of a young Violet and Viscount Edmund Bridgerton, is underway," the post added.
The not-yet-titled limited series marks the latest spin-off in the “Bridgerton” universe.
Shonda Rhimes and Nicholas Nardini, a producer on the previous "Bridgerton" spin-off series “Queen Charlotte,” will serve as showrunners, writers and executive producers on the new show.
The Regency-era romance franchise is based on the "Bridgerton" books by Julia Quinn, with each installment focusing on a different Bridgerton sibling's romance.
Season 5 of “Bridgerton” is currently in production in London and will center on Francesca Bridgerton, played by Hannah Dodd, and Michaela Stirling, played by Masali Baduza.
"Bridgerton" became a global phenomenon when it debuted in 2020 and won praise for its diverse cast.

items.title: Ucrânia espera que europeus participem das negociações com os EUA, diz Zelenskiy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a Ucrânia espera que os parceiros europeus de Kiev participem das negociações com os Estados Unidos nos próximos dias.
items.body:
O presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a Ucrânia espera que os parceiros europeus de Kiev participem das negociações com os Estados Unidos nos próximos dias.
Anteriormente, Zelenskiy havia dito que os negociadores da Ucrânia iriam ter conversas nos Estados Unidos na sexta-feira e no sábado, como parte dos esforços liderados pelos norte-americanos para buscar um acordo para a guerra com a Rússia, que já dura quatro anos e meio.
Em declarações à imprensa em Kiev, o presidente ucraniano disse que os negociadores do país devem levantar a questão das defesas aéreas diante dos ataques russos quase constantes contra cidades ucranianas. Mais de 70 pessoas foram mortas em ataques nos últimos dois dias.
Zelenskiy também disse que a Ucrânia havia “retribuído” os ataques russos a data centers, referindo-se a um ataque a instalações da empresa de tecnologia russa Yandex.
“Sempre respondemos de forma espelhada”, disse Zelenskiy. “Todos vocês sabem que eles têm atacado e continuam atacando nossos data centers. Estamos respondendo. Não posso compartilhar todos os detalhes.”
A empresa russa de tecnologia e IA Yandex informou nesta quinta-feira que ainda não é possível determinar se os equipamentos de um data center atingido por um ataque com drones ucranianos poderiam ser restaurados.

items.title: Operarios de mina chilena Centinela mantienen huelga; dicen impacto en producción se verá en noviembre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina de cobre chilena Centinela sumaban el jueves una segunda jornada de su huelga y aseguraron que el impacto de la paralización de operadores clave se evidenciará plenamente en noviembre, dijeron los sindicatos.
items.body:
Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina de cobre chilena Centinela sumaban el jueves una segunda jornada de su huelga y aseguraron que el impacto de la paralización de operadores clave se evidenciará plenamente en noviembre, dijeron los sindicatos.
Los agremiados iniciaron el miércoles la paralización tras fracasar su negociación contractual con Antofagasta Minerals, lo que pone presión a los precios globales del cobre en momentos en que la industria está afectada por problemas operativos, eventos naturales y bajas leyes de mineral.
"El efecto de la huelga en la producción de cobre se irá incrementando progresivamente, al necesitar Centinela mover una gran cantidad de lastre para alcanzar el mineral", dijeron los gremios en un comunicado.
El efecto en la producción de cobre se evidenciará a plenitud en noviembre, con una disminución de cerca del 50%", agregaron.
Los sindicatos afirman contar con sobre el 50% de los operadores de mina críticos, como operadores de pala y perforadoras, y sobre el 60% de los mantenedores de equipos de mina.
Ambas partes han afirmado estar dispuestas a buscar una solución, pero los sindicatos insisten en que la empresa no ha planteado una solución a su demanda principal, que es que todos los trabajadores reciban el mismo nivel de beneficios independiente del sindicato al que se encuentren afiliados.
Antofagasta -que ofreció bonos finales y préstamo blando por el equivalente de unos 26.400 dólares por socio y un ajuste del sueldo base del 2%- dijo el miércoles que desde 2020 los calendarios de negociación se separaron y los incrementos se acordaron en momentos diferentes.

items.title: Aritzia Q2 profit roughly triples to $201.7 million as U.S. revenues grow
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Aritzia Inc.’s second-quarter earnings roughly tripled from last year as the company expanded further outside Canada.
items.body: Aritzia Inc.’s second-quarter earnings roughly tripled from last year as the company expanded further outside Canada. The Vancouver-based retailer says its net income for the period ended Aug. 30 increased by 204 per cent from last year to $201.7 million. That amounted to $1.70 per diluted share compared with 56 cents a year before. Over the same period, its net revenue increased 44 per cent to $1.17 billion. Almost $780 million of that revenue was derived in the U.S., where the company has been opening more stores. The strength of the quarter has encouraged Aritzia to boost its guidance. It now expects to close out the year with between $4.78 billion and $4.88 billion, which would be an increase of up to 32 per cent from last year. --- Tara Deschamps, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 8, 2026.

[ヒューストン　８日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は４％上昇して取引を終えた。中東での紛争継続を巡る懸念が再燃したほか、米南部メキシコ湾岸に接近しているハリケーンによる供給混乱の拡大も意識された。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．０８ドル（４．１％）高の１バレル＝１０４．２８ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．２１ドル（３．６％）上昇の９１．４９ドルとなった。

米国による対イラン攻撃の可能性が懸念されたほか、ハリケーン「イサイアス」が９日に上陸する見通しであることを背景に、両指標とも５ドル超上昇する場面もあった。ブレントは一時、９月２９日以来の高値を付けた。

ただその後、トランプ米大統領が米国がイランと「建設的な」協議を行っているとした上で、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないとの考えを表明したことを受け、価格は高値から押し戻された。

items.title: CME expands sports derivatives push with baseball futures
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Derivatives exchange CME said on Thursday it would launch the world's first baseball futures.
items.body:
Derivatives exchange CME (CME.O) said on Thursday it would launch the world's first baseball futures.
Here are some more details:
The contracts will track CME FutureSports Performance Indexes covering statistics from 30 professional baseball teams.
Trading is set to begin October 12, pending regulatory review, starting with the 2026 postseason and four clubs in the League Championship Series.
"We see an opportunity to bring investing and hedging discipline to the business of professional baseball," Tim McCourt, CME's senior managing director and global head of equities, FX and alternative products, said.
The derivatives exchange also [USN:L4N4481CA TEXT:"launched"] the world's first index-based hockey futures in August.
CME [USN:L4N43V15Y TEXT:"partnered"] with FutureSports in July to develop derivatives linked to professional and college sports, offering an alternative to event-based contracts traded on prediction markets.
US exchanges and prediction markets have looked to bring popular cultural and emerging economic themes into financial markets, creating new instruments for businesses and investors.

items.body:
A Anthropic lançou nesta quinta-feira ferramentas que permitem aos usuários criar painéis de dados e animações por meio do chatbot Claude.
O Claude Dashboards, disponível em versão beta para planos pagos, conecta-se a plataformas de dados empresariais e sistemas de gestão de clientes, permitindo que os usuários criem painéis em tempo real e análises a partir de consultas em linguagem natural.
O Claude Motion, em versão beta para clientes dos planos Team e Enterprise, permite que os usuários criem animações editáveis e as exportem como arquivos de vídeo.
A Anthropic afirmou que as ferramentas têm como objetivo ajudar os usuários a analisarem dados empresariais e criarem conteúdo visual sem precisarem programar.
A empresa também disponibilizou suas ferramentas Claude Docs, Slides e Design para todos os planos do Claude após os testes beta.
(Por Prathik Jayaprakash)

items.title: Moraes determina que Eduardo Bolsonaro comece a cumprir pena
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), determinou que o ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) comece a cumprir pena após ter sido condenado por coação no curso do processo por sua atuação a favor da imposição de tarifas e sanções por parte do governo dos Estados Unidos.
items.body:
O ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), determinou que o ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) comece a cumprir pena após ter sido condenado por coação no curso do processo por sua atuação a favor da imposição de tarifas e sanções por parte do governo dos Estados Unidos.
No despacho, visto pela Reuters nesta quinta-feira, Moraes ordenou uma série de providências, como a expedição de um mandado de prisão para cumprimento da pena de quatro anos e dois meses de prisão em regime inicialmente semiaberto e também o cancelamento do passaporte do ex-deputado.
Eduardo Bolsonaro, que reside nos EUA desde o início do ano passado, foi condenado pela Primeira Turma do Supremo por ter articulado nos Estados Unidos retaliações do governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, contra o Brasil e autoridades brasileiras com o objetivo de tentar influenciar no julgamento que levou o seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro (PL), a ser condenado pelo tribunal por tentativa de golpe de Estado, entre outros crimes.
Em nota à imprensa, o ex-parlamentar chamou a ordem de Moraes de "arbitrária, inoportuna e inócua, uma vez que os Estados Unidos já deixaram claro que não cumprem decisões delirantes dessa natureza".
"O único efeito prático desse ato, tomado deliberadamente no meio do processo eleitoral, é acirrar ainda mais, e sem nenhuma necessidade, os ânimos do país", acrescentou.
Eduardo tem sido cotado para assumir um eventual Ministério das Relações Exteriores caso o irmão dele, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-SP), seja eleito no segundo turno para a Presidência da República.

"The incumbent wireless carriers have been vocal in expressing skepticism that SpaceX's network will be able to match the quality of their networks," William Blair analysts said.

The transaction, which involves acquiring 100 per cent of private-equity firm Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio, remains subject to regulatory approval by the Federal Communications Commission. Grain had acquired the airwaves from T-Mobile earlier this year.

items.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq fecham em baixa com alta nos preços do petróleo; ações de chips pesam
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: As ações nos EUA caíram nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os preços do petróleo bruto dispararam devido a um aumento repentino das tensões no Oriente Médio e a um corte na produção dos EUA, o que alimentou temores de inflação e de aumento das taxas de juros, enquanto as ações do setor de chips tombaram.
items.body:
As ações nos EUA caíram nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os preços do petróleo bruto dispararam devido a um aumento repentino das tensões no Oriente Médio e a um corte na produção dos EUA, o que alimentou temores de inflação e de aumento das taxas de juros, enquanto as ações do setor de chips tombaram.
Entre os principais índices acionários dos EUA, o Nasdaq fechou com a maior queda percentual, dois dias depois que o índice, de forte presença do setor de tecnologia, atingiu um recorde no fechamento. A queda do S&P 500 foi mais modesta, enquanto o Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, registrou um ganho nominal.
As fabricantes de chips (.SOX) , que subiram mais de 80% neste ano, tiveram um desempenho claramente inferior no dia, caindo 3,4% após uma reportagem do Financial Times que afirmou que as receitas anualizadas da OpenAI eram US$20 bilhões menores do que a empresa havia sinalizado anteriormente.
“O mercado está em consolidação, na expectativa da temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre, que começa na próxima semana, e há também o conflito em curso no Irã, que está elevando os preços do petróleo”, disse Terry Sandven, estrategista-chefe de ações do US Bank Wealth Management, em Minneapolis, Minnesota. “O que é igualmente revelador é que, no acumulado do ano, a trajetória de menor resistência para as ações tem sido de alta.”
Os preços do petróleo saltaram devido a preocupações com a oferta, após uma série de ataques a navios no Estreito de Ormuz, combinados com uma redução na produção dos EUA devido à atividade de furacões.
O WTI e o Brent fecharam em alta de 3,6% e 4,1%, respectivamente.
A escassez global de petróleo bruto durante a guerra no Irã fez com que o petróleo bruto dos EUA disparasse mais de 60% neste ano, alimentando as pressões inflacionárias. Em resposta a essas pressões, o Federal Reserve elevou as taxas de juros em setembro pela primeira vez desde julho de 2023.
Atualmente, os mercados financeiros esperam que o banco central mantenha as taxas inalteradas neste mês, enquanto a probabilidade de um aumento em dezembro é de 69,2%, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME.
Isso reflete a trajetória esperada de aumento das taxas pelo Banco Central Europeu e foi confirmado pelo diretor do Fed Christopher Waller, que afirmou que provavelmente serão necessários aumentos adicionais, mas que o momento desses aumentos é “flexível”.
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 0,10%, para 51.231,64 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 0,47%, para 7.765,36 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 1,25%, para 27.193,34 pontos.
Entre os 11 principais setores do S&P 500, as ações do setor de energia (.SPNY) lideraram os ganhos percentuais, enquanto o setor de tecnologia (.SPLRCT) , prejudicado pelo setor de chips, sofreu a maior queda.
A previsão de lucro trimestral recorde da gigante de chips de memória Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) não conseguiu melhorar o ânimo do mercado, e suas ações fecharam em baixa na Coreia do Sul. A rival Micron Technology (MU.O) caiu 4,8%.
Na quarta-feira, o Wall Street Journal noticiou que a Broadcom (AVGO.O) está preparando um financiamento de US$50 bilhões para a OpenAI, com a Oracle (ORCL.N) também buscando um montante não especificado, o que gerou temores de que a emissão maciça de dívida por parte das empresas de tecnologia possa intensificar a competição por capital.
A Broadcom e a Oracle caíram 4,4% e 5,5%, respectivamente.

items.title: Coca-Cola looks to sell Costa Coffee, Semafor reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Coca-Cola is seeking to unwind its $5 billion acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee after a sales process failed earlier this year, Semafor reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Coca-Cola (KO.N) is seeking to unwind its $5 billion acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee after a sales process failed earlier this year, Semafor reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Here are some more details:
Coca-Cola had [USN:L4N3YF0EF TEXT:"scrapped "]its plans to sell Costa earlier this year after the offers from private equity firms came in below expectations, the Financial Times reported in January.
The beverage giant acquired Costa in 2018 for $5.1 billion in an effort to extend its push into healthier drinks.
At least one strategic acquirer mulled what a deal for Costa would look like before passing due to valuation and strategic issues, the Semafor report added.
Coca-Cola did not immediately respond to a request for comment
It could not be determined what price Coca-Cola might seek for Costa if it were to put the coffee chain back on the market, the report added.

items.title: 米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック下落、原油急騰で　半導体株が安い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種・ナスダック総合が下落して取引を終えた。中東情勢の緊迫化と米国の原油生産減少を受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフレや利上げへの懸念が強まった。半導体株の下落も重しとなった。 

主要株価指数では、ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が最も大きな下落率を記録した。同指数は６日に終値で過去最高値を付けていた。

今年に入って８０％超上昇していた半導体株が３．４％安とアンダーパフォームした。オープンＡＩの年換算売上高が、同社が従来示唆していた水準を２００億ドル下回ると英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が報じたことなどが重しとなった。

ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのチーフ株式ストラテジスト、テリー・サンドベン氏は「市場は来週始まる第３・四半期決算シーズンを前に横ばいで推移している。加えて、イランでの紛争が続き、原油価格を押し上げている」と指摘。「同様に示唆的なのは、年初来、株式相場は上昇しやすい地合いが続いてきたことだ」と述べた。

原油価格は、ホルムズ海峡で船舶への攻撃が相次いだことに加え、ハリケーンの影響による米国の生産減少を巡る懸念から急伸した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の主要１１業種では、エネルギーが上昇率トップだった。一方、半導体株への売りを背景に情報技術の下落率が最大だった。

メモリー半導体大手の韓国サムスン電子が過去最高の四半期営業益を見込んだものの市場心理の改善にはつながらず、同社株はソウル市場で下落して取引を終えた。競合の米マイクロン・テクノロジーは４．８％下落した。

米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は７日、ブロードコムがオープンＡＩの人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体向けに５００億ドルの資金調達の調整を進めているほか、オラクルも金額は不明だが調達を模索していると報じた。これを受け、ハイテク企業による大規模な債券発行が資本獲得競争を激化させるとの懸念が高まった。

ブロードコムは４．４％、オラクルは５．５％、それぞれ下落した。

飲料大手ペプシコは３．７％高。通期のコア利益見通しを引き下げる一方、追加のコスト削減を進めると表明した。

コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスは０．４％下落。メキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルの買収を模索していると伝わった。チポトレは６．２％急伸した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．２８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは１．３３対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８８億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７７億４０００万株。

米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は７日、ブロードコムがオープンＡＩの人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体向けに５００億ドルの資金調達の調整を進めているほか、オラクルも金額は不明だが調達を模索していると報じた。これを受け、ハイテク企業による大規模な債券発行が資本獲得競争を激化させるとの懸念が高まった。

ブロードコムは４．４％、オラクルは５．５％、それぞれ下落した。

飲料大手ペプシコは３．７％高。通期のコア利益見通しを引き下げる一方、追加のコスト削減を進めると表明した。

コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスは０．４％下落。メキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルの買収を模索していると伝わった。チポトレは６．２％急伸した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．２８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは１．３３対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８８億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７７億４０００万株。

items.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq end lower as crude prices jump, chip stocks weigh
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: US stock indices slid on Thursday as crude oil prices surged, prompted by intensifying Middle East tensions. Major benchmarks, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, saw a drop that illustrates growing investor jitteriness. The chip sector struggled after a revenue target cut for OpenAI was disclosed, amplifying market fluctuations.
items.body: US stocks dipped on Thursday as crude prices surged on a spike in Middle East tensions and a cut in US output that fed inflation and rate-hike fears, while semiconductor stocks slumped.According to preliminary data, the S&P 500 lost 36.07 points, or 0.46%, to end at 7,765.70 points, while the Nasdaq Composite lost 341.59 points, or 1.24%, to 27,197.10. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 45.68 points, or 0.09%, to 51,225.48.Of the major US stock indexes, the Nasdaq closed with the steepest percentage loss, two days after the tech-heavy index reached a record closing high.Chipmakers, which have soared over 80% so far this year, were clear underperformers on the day following a report from the Financial Times that said OpenAI's annualized revenues were $20 billion less than the company previously signaled. The market's going sideways in anticipation of third-quarter earnings season, which begins next week, and then there's the ongoing conflict in Iran that's pushing oil prices higher, said Terry Sandven, chief equity strategist at US Bank Wealth Management in Minneapolis, Minnesota. What's equally telling is that year-to-date, the path of least resistance for equities has been up. Oil prices jumped on supply concerns after a spate of attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, combined with a cut in US output due to hurricane activity.Front-month WTI and Brent settled up 3.6% and 4.1%, respectively.Tight global crude supplies during the Iran war have sent US crude soaring more than 60% so far this year, stoking inflation pressures. In response to those pressures, the US Federal Reserve hiked interest rates in September for the first time since July 2023.During Thursday's session, benchmark US Treasury yields inched higher, hovering near multi-year highs, while yields on 2-year notes, which tend to reflect Fed rate expectations, moved up more decisively.Financial markets currently expect the central bank to leave rates unchanged this month, while the probability of a December hike is nearly 70%, according to CME's FedWatch tool.That mirrors the expected rate hike path of the European Central Bank, and was affirmed by Fed Governor Christopher Waller, who said additional rate hikes will probably be necessary, but the timing of those hikes is flexible. Memory-chip giant Samsung Electronics' record quarterly profit forecast failed to lift sentiment, with its shares closing lower in South Korea.On Wednesday, the Wall Street Journal reported that Broadcom is lining up $50 billion in financing for OpenAI, with Oracle also seeking an unspecified sum, spurring fears that massive debt issuance by technology companies could intensify the competition for capital. Both Broadcom and Oracle ended the session lower.PepsiCo shares gained after the beverage company said it would pursue additional spending cuts while lowering its annual core profit forecast.Starbucks dipped following reports that the coffee chain was exploring a purchase of Chipotle Mexican Grill , whose shares jumped on the news.Palantir climbed after Goldman Sachs upgraded its rating on the data analytics software provider to buy from neutral .

FAST

Oct 8 : The US government said on Thursday it is suspending some of the world's biggest tech and IT firms including Microsoft, Cognizant and Capgemini from a key green card program that allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency through their employment. 
Senior US officials cited alleged fraud as the reason behind the move, saying companies have been using the program to replace American workers with cheaper foreign workers, and comes as the latest step in the Trump administration's crackdown on skilled foreign labor. 
WHAT IS UNDER SUSPENSION?
The suspension is targeting a key employer-sponsorship mechanism, called the Permanent Labor Certification or PERM, which is used by major technology companies and outsourcing firms. The US government said that for certain companies, it would not accept any new PERM applications or process any pending ones.

PERM came into effect in 2005, aiming to speed up the long processing times experienced under the previous paper-based "Alien Employment Certification" program.
Under the program, the US Department of Labor (DOL) allows an employer to sponsor a foreign worker permanent residency. The process is initiated by qualified US employers, and not individual workers.
The Labor Department must certify to the US Citizenship and Immigration Services that there are not enough US workers that are qualified and available for a given job opportunity, and that the employment of the foreign worker will not affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed Americans. 
Outside of PERM and family-based routes to permanent residency, individuals can also self-petition for green cards through processes such as the EB-1A application for individuals with extraordinary ability or the EB-2 National Interest Waiver.
WHY IS IT IMPORTANT? 
The PERM program serves as a critical bridge between temporary work status and a green card for many foreign skilled workers. Many IT firms employ hundreds of thousands of workers who typically start on temporary work visas such as the H-1B, and later seek permanent residency. 
Without the option to be sponsored by their employer under PERM, foreign workers could lose a key route to permanent residency and would have to stay on temporary visas for longer. For companies, recruiting foreign talent could become harder, as many workers overseas view the path to permanent US residency as a key reason for taking a job. 
WHICH COMPANIES ARE UNDER SUSPENSION? 
The US said it is suspending Microsoft and Adobe along with some of the largest IT firms in the world, including Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini.   
Other companies such as Meta, Amazon or Alphabet's Google remain free to participate in the program. 
WHY IS THE US FREEZING APPLICATIONS?
The move widens an ongoing crackdown on visas which the Trump administration has said cost US jobs. Vice President JD Vance said, without citing specific evidence, companies are using the PERM program to replace American employees with foreign workers and undercut their wages. 
Vance said on Thursday: "Our message to Microsoft is: You're a great American company, but you've got to hire great American workers."
The suspensions follow President Trump's move to impose a one-time $100,000 fee on new H-1B visa petitions for highly skilled foreign workers, which has been blocked by federal court orders. 
HOW IS PERM DIFFERENT FROM H-1B?
H-1B is a temporary work visa that allows skilled foreign workers to work in the US, generally for up to six years. PERM meanwhile is a permanent labor-certification process. The freeze does not appear to directly affect current holders of H-1B visas. 
HOW CURTAILING PERM COULD BACKFIRE
Some experts said that while the PERM suspensions might target specific companies, such policies risk making the US less competitive globally by deterring highly skilled foreign talent.
"It is a fallacy to think that you can protect American workers by keeping skilled foreign workers out of the country. You think that foreign talent competes with Americans within our borders, they'll certainly compete with Americans by working abroad," said Chad Sparber, Director of the Lampert Institute for Civic and Global Affairs at Colgate University.
Ahmet Gulek, Postdoctoral Fellow at Stanford’s Immigration Policy Lab, said that permanent residency is the primary way for talented foreign workers to stay in the country and without it, some will leave, and some will not come in the first place, even temporarily.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Tech stocks drag Nasdaq lower on report of OpenAI revenue fall, high yields
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: US equity indexes fell, influenced by megacap technology stocks and concerns regarding OpenAI's revenue performance. The Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 saw declines as the yield on the 10-year Treasury rose. Additionally, increased oil prices and energy supply fears contributed to market pressure. Federal Reserve comments indicated potential for further interest rate increases, impacting credit sectors. A rise in economic-policy uncertainty reflects growing concerns among investors amid upcoming election dynamics.
items.body: Megacap technology stocks dragged US equity indexes lower as concerns grew that OpenAI’s revenue could disappoint investors already questioning the sustainability of the AI boom, Bloommberg reported.The Financial Times reported that ChatGPT-maker OpenAI’s annualised revenue was $20 billion below the amount it had previously indicated.The Nasdaq 100 fell 1.9%, while the S&P 500 declined 0.9% as of 1:26 p.m. in New York. The yield on the 10-year Treasury rose to 5.3%, weighing on rate-sensitive stocks as renewed energy-supply risks reinforced expectations that borrowing costs could remain high.The Cboe Volatility Index, commonly known as Wall Street’s fear gauge, climbed above 16.Technology and AI-related stocks came under pressure after several negative developments. Chip stocks too fell, with the Philadelphia semiconductor index dropping 3.5%.Oracle shares also fell following a report that the company was transporting natural gas to data centres to overcome power-supply bottlenecks, as reported by Bloomberg.Renewed concerns about global energy supplies further weakened market sentiment. Oil prices rose after a report said the White House had asked the Pentagon to prepare possible military-strike options against Iran that could be executed before the midterm elections.Hurricane Isaias was also developing in the Gulf, adding to fears of potential disruptions to energy production and transportation.Hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller added to the pressure. Waller said further interest-rate increases would probably be required to bring inflation under control, although policymakers had flexibility over the timing and did not necessarily need to raise rates at consecutive meetings.The final month of the US midterm campaign has also brought artificial-intelligence regulation and government spending on healthcare and defence into sharper focus for equity investors.Election uncertainty is beginning to influence the market, according to Matt Miskin, a strategist at Manulife John Hancock Investments. He noted that banks and industrial companies—sectors that “typically do better under Republican policies”—had recently weakened.That performance could indicate that investors are “pricing in a bit more of a blue wave,” he said.Banks are also facing pressure as credit-card, auto-loan and mortgage rates remain close to 20-year highs. Miskin said lenders can benefit because “higher yields can lead to better revenues, but they can also lead to a tipping point where consumers just can’t pay these kinds of loans.”Artificial intelligence remains critical to the outlook for the US earnings season. Deutsche Bank strategists expect third-quarter profits to grow 34% from a year earlier, a historically strong pace, with AI-related demand supporting earnings growth of about 54% among megacap technology companies.Citigroup strategists Richard Schlatter and David Chew expect a larger share of US companies to beat third-quarter earnings forecasts than in the previous quarter. Their model projects that 66% of Russell 1000 companies will surpass estimates, up from slightly more than 60% in the second quarter. Technology companies are expected to deliver the most earnings beats.Investor responses to recent AI-related results have been mixed. Samsung reported record preliminary quarterly results, but they fell short of the most optimistic forecasts. TSMC, meanwhile, posted 51% sales growth.The contrasting reactions underscore the high expectations surrounding AI as investors prepare for a US earnings season likely to be dominated by technology spending and demand.Policy uncertainty is also increasing. An index tracking US economic-policy uncertainty has registered one of its sharpest increases in three years, even as overall market volatility remains relatively subdued.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)
