items.title: ‘Necessity and opportunity’: Turning a side hustle into a small business
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: An increasing number of Canadians are turning to side hustles to pay the bills, and many of those gigs have the potential to scale into small businesses, says the CEO of Ownr, an RBC-owned ...
items.body: An increasing number of Canadians are turning to side hustles to pay the bills, and many of those gigs have the potential to scale into small businesses, says the CEO of Ownr, an RBC-owned incorporation and registration platform. “What starts out as a side hustle, a passion project or a small opportunity or niche that someone has identified, can eventually turn into a full-time business,” Jordan Casey told BNN Bloomberg in an interview on Thursday. “Side hustles are becoming a big pathway into business ownership.” Casey’s comments came after Ownr and RBC released new data suggesting nearly a quarter of Canadians earn extra money through a side gig. “Another 25 per cent are thinking about pursuing one… I think that’s really encouraging to see that Canadians are looking towards alternative sources of income in a pretty challenging macroeconomic environment,” he said. According to survey data from Ownr, financial challenges are the main motivation for Canadians who have taken up side hustles. Thirty-nine per cent of respondents said they were looking to supplement their regular income, while 33 per cent cited rising living costs, and another 26 per cent said they turned to side hustles to pay down existing debt. “What that tells me is households are really stretching to keep up, but they’re not being passive about it, and I think that’s the encouraging thing,” said Casey. “They’re taking action and they’re building something.” ‘Necessity and opportunity’ Casey argued that in addition to necessity, opportunity is the other main driver of growth in the gig economy, as more Canadians with thriving side hustles set their sights higher. “What the data is telling us is that it’s both a product of necessity and opportunity,” he said. “Nearly one in five side hustlers say they’re likely to go full time, and that’s closer to three in 10 amongst the Gen Z audience.” In a release detailing Ownr’s findings, Casey said the survey data suggests there is plenty of untapped “entrepreneurial ambition” in Canada, but when side hustlers do decide to take the leap towards business ownership, they often falter. “That’s where it gets hard,” Casey said in the release. For people who have picked up a side hustle they believe can grow into a full-time endeavor, it takes time and expertise to understand the complexities involved in the process - two things usually in short supply for busy, working Canadians. “Where people stall is all the administrative stuff, right? And there’s a huge confidence gap. More than a third of entrepreneurs don’t know when they’re required to register, and nearly 40 per cent don’t understand the legal or compliance requirements that apply to them,” said Casey. “I think the ambition is there amongst Canadians, but where they need support is clarity on that next step.” Methodology The findings mentioned are from an Ipsos survey conducted on behalf of Ownr between September 1 and 8, 2026. A total sample of n=1,501 Canadians aged 18+ participated via Ipsos’ online panel. Quotas and weighting were used to align the sample with Canadian population statistics based on census parameters. The credibility interval for the total sample is ±3.1 percentage points, 19 times out of 20. Unless otherwise noted, questions asked only of respondents who reported having a side hustle are based on a subsample of n=834 and have a credibility interval of ±4.2 percentage points, 19 times out of 20. Credibility intervals are larger for demographic and other subgroups of the population.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、欧州国債売り一服　円は157円台後半
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Chuck Mikolajczak

[ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Chuck Mikolajczak

[ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター] - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロ圏の国債利回り上昇を受けたユーロ売り・ドル買いの動きが一服する中、ドルが軟調に推移した。一方、年内の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利見通しに対する予想はおおむね維持された

原油価格の急騰でインフレ懸念が強まる中、ユーロ圏の国債利回りは再び大幅に上昇。フランスやイタリアなど債務水準の高い国の国債に売りが集中した。 

シムコープのクリストフ・ション氏は「他の多くの通貨は金融政策見通しと逆相関関係にあるように見えるが、それは全てをドルとＦＲＢが支配していたためであり、この状況はここ数週間続いている」と指摘。その上で「興味深いのは、現在ユーロに影響を及ぼす別の要因、つまりフランスとスペインの政治危機が存在することだ」とし、現在は金利差や金融政策ではなく、ユーロ特有の危機がユーロに影響を及ぼしていると述べた。

一方、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測は依然として低い。

ＦＲＢのウォラー理事は８日、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％まで引き下げるには、追加の利上げが必要になる可能性が高いと述べた。しかし、利上げのペースについては「柔軟性」があり、１０月のＦＯＭＣで利上げをいったん見送る可能性も残した。

ＦＲＢが７日公表した９月のＦＯＭＣ議事要旨によると、利上げの理由を巡って当局者の見解が分かれていた。 

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．０８％安の１０２．１７。一時、１０２．４６まで上昇していた。

ドルは対円で０．１２％安の１５７．８８円。日銀は、原材料コスト上昇による価格引き上げの動きが消費財に波及しており、より頻繁に値上げを実施する企業もあると指摘し、インフレ圧力の拡大に対する懸念を示した。

items.title: New Brazil Congress poses risk to environmental legislation, campaign group says
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.summary: Brazil's next Congress is likely to pose a greater obstacle to legislation to protect the environment after elections this month, according to a study by climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima, which found that almost 70% of elected lawmakers have little or no commitment to environmental issues.
items.body:
Brazil's next Congress is likely to pose a greater obstacle to legislation to protect the environment after elections this month, according to a study by climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima, which found that almost 70% of elected lawmakers have little or no commitment to environmental issues.
The study analyzed bills, legislative proposals, speeches and public statements by new and re-elected lawmakers and concluded that 64 of the Senate's 81 members have a track record of "very low" or "low" commitment to environmental issues. In the lower house, 345 of 511 lawmakers were placed in the same category.
The Liberal Party, home to right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, who will face President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a runoff election for the presidency later this month, has the weakest environmental credentials among major parties, the study found.
Bolsonaro defied pollsters to beat Lula in the first round, though he did not secure enough votes to avoid a second vote.
All of the party's 28 senators elected on Sunday, as well as members elected to the lower house, were classified as having very low commitment to environmental issues.
Other right-leaning parties, including Novo, Republicanos, Progressistas and Uniao Brasil, also showed low support for environmental causes, the study said.
Environmental advocates could face a more challenging political landscape with Congress shifting further to the right and if Bolsonaro -- whose [USN:L6N45U0TV TEXT:"past comments on climate change"] have caused concern -- is elected president, Observatorio do Clima said.
Reuters contacted the named parties but did not receive responses.
Proposals that could weaken environmental protections, including measures to reduce protected areas, allow mining on Indigenous lands and ease environmental licensing requirements, may gain momentum under the new Congress, the group added.
"This picture points to four years of difficult work for those focused on climate and environmental issues," said Suely Araujo, the group's public policy coordinator.

items.title: Lawmakers raise alarm at Google plan to acquire Spirit Airlines data for AI models
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: More than 120 US lawmakers raised concerns on Thursday about a deal for Alphabet's Google unit to acquire defunct carrier Spirit Airlines' internal data for $10 million to train artificial intelligence systems.
items.body:
More than 120 US lawmakers raised concerns on Thursday about a deal for Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google unit to acquire defunct carrier Spirit Airlines' internal data for $10 million to train artificial intelligence systems.
As part of Spirit's closure and asset liquidation, Google won an auction in August for data from spreadsheets and calendars as well as for marketing, productivity and operations. Spirit Airlines halted operations in May.
A privacy ombudsman on Monday recommended a US bankruptcy judge approve the deal at an October 14 hearing after excluding passenger personal information from 97 million Spirit customers.
The lawmakers led by Senator Elizabeth Warren and Representative Steven Horsford said the sale would include 100 million emails, 500 million Microsoft (MSFT.O) Teams messages and other employee records.
The lawmakers asked the company to "exclude employee information from the transaction to the greatest extent possible."
"Innovation should not come at the expense of workers’ privacy or the confidentiality of information they were required to provide as a condition of employment," said the lawmakers. "The unprecedented scale and sophistication of modern artificial intelligence make it particularly important that privacy protections keep pace with the technology."
Google said it did not want to acquire personal information.
"We are not looking to buy any personal information from Spirit. The information will either be completely excluded or will be de-identified by an independent third party before Google receives any data. We're already working constructively with the appointed privacy ombudsman," a Google spokesperson said.
Union leaders have expressed concern about the sale. Sara Nelson, president of the Association of Flight Attendants-CWA, said, "The outcome of conditions on this proposed sale to Google carries tremendous implications for workers across the economy."
Spirit also received a $7.5 million bid from Mercor, an AI data company, for the employee data.
The Federal Aviation Administration this week approved the $58.5 million sale of Spirit's slots at New York LaGuardia airport to JetBlue Airways (JBLU.O) .

items.title: Brazil finance minister calls Bolsonaro trade a 'hollow illusion'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazil's Finance Minister Dario Durigan on Thursday dismissed market enthusiasm over the prospect of a Flavio Bolsonaro presidency as a "cheap, hollow illusion," after assets rallied following the senator's stronger-than-expected first-round performance against President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
items.body:
Brazil's Finance Minister Dario Durigan on Thursday dismissed market enthusiasm over the prospect of a Flavio Bolsonaro presidency as a "cheap, hollow illusion," after [USN:L1N45R06Y TEXT:"assets rallied"] following the senator's stronger-than-expected [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"first-round"] performance against President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
In an interview with CNN Brasil, Durigan said Bolsonaro's economic blueprint echoes that of Argentina's President Javier Milei, accusing it of prioritizing a rapid reduction in the debt-to-GDP ratio to satisfy market demands.
Durigan said Bolsonaro's plan would amount to a drastic fiscal shock, stripping 200 billion reais ($39.80 billion) from the federal budget without detailing how the cuts would be achieved.
"If, under the pretext of investing in the future, you destabilize the organism, the cost becomes very high," he said.
The minister contrasted that with Lula's economic platform, which he said would preserve the current administration's fiscal adjustment while potentially altering its pace.
Durigan also criticized Bolsonaro's proposal to review parts of Lula's landmark consumption-tax reform, approved in late 2023 and due to take effect next year, saying the legislation was well designed and would generate productivity gains for Brazil's economy.
($1 = 5.0245 reais)

items.title: MLB pitches shorter season as salary cap fight looms
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Major League Baseball proposed cutting its regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029 during bargaining on Thursday, a plan the players' union said was tied to a salary cap it firmly opposes.
items.body:
Major League Baseball proposed cutting its regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029 during bargaining on Thursday, a plan the players' union said was tied to a salary cap it firmly opposes.
The proposal, which comes as the two sides negotiate a new collective bargaining agreement before the current one expires on December, would also expand the Division Series of the playoffs to a best-of-seven from a best-of-five affair.
According to MLB, shortening the regular season would create a standard weekly off day benefiting player health.
Under its proposal, the higher-seeded clubs in both the Wild Card and Division Series would select their opponents beginning in 2027.
PLAYERS REVIEWING PROPOSAL The Major League Baseball Players Association said it is reviewing the proposed changes.
"Players will weigh in on these proposals and we will respond at the bargaining table," MLBPA said in a statement.
"Unfortunately, the league once again made clear that all of its proposals are contingent on players' agreement to a salary cap, a system that guts player rights and compensation, as well as its other anti-player proposals."
Other North American leagues have lengthened their schedules in recent years.
The National Hockey League went to 84 games from 82 this season, and the National Football League, which added a 17th game in 2021, wants an 18th. The NFL players' union has pushed back.
SALARY CAP FIGHT The bigger fight, however, is expected to be over a salary cap, which could lead to a lockout or strike.
In their first proposal in May, MLB owners asked for a hard cap of $245.3 million, including player benefits, and a payroll floor of $171.2 million, starting in 2027.
The MLBPA has long opposed any form of salary cap. The current collective bargaining agreement expires on December 1.
The last time owners pushed for a cap, players went on strike in 1994. The 232-day stoppage forced the cancellation of that year's World Series.

items.body:
O plano do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) para a presidência da República atende a uma demanda do mercado por redução da dívida pública, mas não leva em conta impactos sobre a atividade econômica e empregos, disse nesta quinta-feira o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan.
Em entrevista à CNN Brasil, Durigan, que coordena o plano econômico para reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), afirmou que agentes de mercado têm comprado uma “ilusão vazia” sobre uma eventual gestão de Flávio.
"O modelo que o Flávio está inspirado é o modelo (Javier) Milei (presidente da Argentina), que é um modelo que quer responder com ansiedade a essa demanda única do mercado em relação à dívida sobre PIB", disse.
"Não adianta a gente querer tratar com um medicamento de alta dosagem o tema do endividamento público e não olhar para o crescimento, não olhar para o emprego, não olhar para a balança comercial, não olhar para projetos estratégicos."
Ele afirmou que um novo governo de Lula se comprometeria a alcançar superávits primários crescentes, podendo eventualmente aumentar a velocidade das ações de ajuste das contas públicas.
CAVALO DE PAU Na avaliação do ministro, Flávio daria um "cavalo de pau" na gestão da economia ao retirar R$200 bilhões do Orçamento com medidas de ajuste fiscal, ressaltando que o candidato do PL não explicou como isso será feito. Para ele, uma ação desse tipo inviabilizaria a execução de políticas públicas.
Reportagem da Folha de S.Paulo mostrou que equipe de Flávio estuda alterar as correções dos benefícios da Previdência Social e do Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC) e dos gastos obrigatórios com saúde e educação em busca de [USN:L6N45U0RI TEXT:"R$250 bilhões"] de economia nas contas públicas. Após a publicação, o senador e assessores vieram a público para negar as medidas, embora já tenham se comprometido a um duro ajuste fiscal.
Durigan disse na entrevista que a presidência de Jair Bolsonaro, pai de Flávio, não fez nenhuma correção de rumo fiscal e defendeu que o governo Lula organizou as contas do país.
O ministro voltou a argumentar que a elevação da dívida pública não foi causada pelos resultados fiscais, estabilizados pelo governo Lula, mas pelo elevado nível dos juros.
Na entrevista, Durigan ainda afirmou que a campanha de Flávio propõe mudanças na reforma tributária, o que seria um retrocesso em um sistema que deve elevar a eficiência e a produtividade do país.
Flávio disse mais cedo nesta quinta que o mecanismo de "split payment" introduzido pela reforma tributária sobre o consumo deverá produzir uma “quebradeira generalizada” de empresas, argumentando que, por isso, sua equipe estuda propor a [USN:L1N45U0K8 TEXT:"retirada"] desse sistema.
Com o "split payment", tributos sobre o consumo serão automaticamente transferidos ao governo no momento da transação, em vez de serem recolhidos posteriormente pelas empresas, o que, para Flávio, prejudica o fluxo de caixa das companhias.

items.title: 米・ウクライナ、9日にフロリダ州で実務者会合　欧州当局者も招待＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン　８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン　８日　ロイター] - 米国とウクライナが９日に米フロリダ州マイアミで実務者協議を行い、ロシアとウクライナの和平を巡る新たな構想や提案などについて話し合うことが８日、計画に詳しい米国の関係筋の話で分かった。米国からウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使ら、ウクライナからブダノフ大統領府長官らが出席するほか、英独仏や北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の当局者も招待されている。

関係筋によると、協議にはトランプ米大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏のほか、ホワイトハウス国家安全保障会議（ＮＳＣ）や財務省の代表者も参加する。ウクライナ側はブダノフ氏のほか、ウメロフ対外情報機関長官、アラハミア首席交渉官らが出席。ロシアとの和平実現後にロシアによる再侵攻を防ぐためのウクライナに対する「安全保障の保証」のほか、戦後の復興計画などについて協議する。

欧州からは英独仏の国家安全保障担当補佐官が招待されており、欧州側はエネルギー価格の高騰やロシアによるウクライナ全面侵攻に伴う大きな経済的影響への不満を米国側に伝えているという。

関係筋は「戦争が終わらなければ厳しい冬になる。米国は統一的な提案をまとめることを目標に当事者間の仲介を進めている」と述べた。

items.title: プーチン氏、イラン紛争解決支援の用意表明　ペゼシュキアン氏と会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[８日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は８日、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領と会談し、イランを巡る紛争の終結に向け、ロシアがあらゆる措置を講じる用意があると表明した。ロシアのインタファクス通信が報じた。

報道によると、プーチン大統領はトルクメニスタンで開催された旧ソ連諸国首脳会議の合間にペゼシュキアン大統領と会談し、「われわれは、この（イランの）状況の解決を支援するために、できる限りのことを行う用意がある」と伝えた。その上で「イランが、自らに責任のない形で勃発したこの紛争を終結させるために、真摯な努力を払っていることをわれわれは認識している」と述べた。

items.title: Big Ten commish: Sticking with '18 strong members' for now
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Commissioner Tony Petitti sees no reason to make the Big Ten any bigger right now.
items.body:
Commissioner Tony Petitti sees no reason to make the Big Ten any bigger right now.
Petitti said Thursday at Big Ten basketball media days in Chicago there are no active talks or plans regarding expansion of the conference as rumors swirl about interest from LSU and Miami, among others.
There are "absolutely no discussions taking place around expansion," Petitti said, with his explicit focus on helping current conference membership adjust to the evolving college landscape.
"This conference has got 18 strong members," Petitti said. "We're focused on that. There's lots of things that we think we can do inside the conference to continue to grow the position that we have with the 18 members."
The conference expanded most recently in 2024, plucking Pac-12 powers Oregon, UCLA, Southern California and Washington.
Petitti said the Big Ten was supportive of the Protect College Sports Act, which provides a path toward helping conferences be in lockstep on wide-reaching realms such as eligibility limits, transfer rules and universal state adherence to existing legislation.
"The bill isn't going to stop every possible thing," he said. "That's not what it's intended to do. In areas like eligibility, transfer, legislating litigation around NIL, states trying to come over the top of the system, and the settlement, this will clean all that up, and so that's really critical."
--Michigan State head coach Tom Izzo knows all about the challenges of winning in the Big Ten, which houses 2026 Final Four teams and a heavily remodeled national champion in Ann Arbor. Michigan had three first-round NBA draft picks and head coach Dusty May "got drafted first," as Boynton put it Thursday, after cutting down the nets in Indianapolis.
That Final Four also included Illinois. The Illini start the season with several new faces, too. Top freshman Keaton Wagler was a lottery pick of the Los Angeles Clippers.
Izzo said he's been around long enough to know it's not the names and the faces but the places that will matter once conference play begins.
"The Big Ten is going to be damn good. Michigan, Illinois, UCLA and USC have a lot of talent," he said. "I'm leaving others out. I think Maryland will be far improved. But what isn't appreciated is our home buildings. Every game is an event. You can't rest in this league."
Michigan will be in the hands of Mike Boynton Jr., who replaced May upon his departure for the Dallas Mavericks.
Not everything is new for the Wolverines. Guards Elliot Cadeau and Trey McKenney lead the cast of familiar faces hoping to put the defending champions in position to play in Detroit -- site of the 2027 Final Four -- at season's end.
Boynton, an assistant under May, said his former boss is "the best I've ever been around just in terms of emotional IQ."
"His ability to surround himself with high-quality, competent people and give them the vision to execute. The biggest part I've tried to replicate," Boynton said, "is just having the right people in the room."
-- Less than 48 hours before Thursday's media-day appearance, Tony Stubblefield was an assistant on Dana Altman's Oregon staff. Suddenly, Stubblefield was thrust into the spotlight at Big Ten media days as the interim head coach at Oregon following Altman's retirement announcement Wednesday.
That doesn't mean Altman's decision -- or its timing -- took Stubblefield by surprise.
"Not totally surprised," Stubblefield said. "We had a challenging year last year... I think that took a lot out of him."
Stubblefield was the head coach at DePaul from 2021-24, bookended by stints on the Ducks' staff. He was familiar with Eugene as far back as 2010.
Stubblefield inherits a program that reached the NCAA Tournament's second round in 2024 and 2025 but missed the event in three of the past five seasons. Last season was Oregon's first sub-.500 finish under Altman (12-20).
"Obviously it's a lot for these young men," Stubblefield said on Big Ten Network. "They came there to play for Dana Altman, to play at the University of Oregon. What I told them, we've got to stay more connected now. We've got to be tight. ... This is a very good group. We've had very good leadership with (seniors) Sean Stewart, Fred Payne, Andrew Meadow. And I told those guys we've gotta be tighter than ever."
-- Rutgers also faces a coaching transition, with longtime head coach Steve Pikiell undergoing cancer treatment and associate head coach Brandin Knight temporarily directing the program.
Knight represented the Scarlet Knights in Chicago and said the longtime head coach was guiding him from the background.
"He's involved in my day-to-day, and I'm always checking on him from a standpoint of what he sees, what he's thinking, what I should be worried or concerned about," said Knight, who has never served as a head coach. "And then he takes some of the pressure off of myself just because he's still trying to be there as much as he can at every waking moment.
"So at times we have to tell him -- yesterday he apologized to the staff for not being there for us and being able to do more. And it's just kind of a testament to who he is as a person and just as a supporter of us."
--Michigan was far from the only Big Ten success story last March and April. The league had more participants in the Final Four (two), Elite Eight (four) and Sweet 16 (six) than any other conference.
Ninth-seeded Iowa bested fourth-seeded Nebraska in a Sweet 16 Battle of the Corn. The Hawkeyes' reward under then-first-year coach Ben McCollum was to go up against a veteran Illinois team in the Elite Eight, and Brad Underwood guided the Fighting Illini to their first Final Four since 2005.
Illinois returns several key contributors, bringing heightened expectations that Underwood believes his team should embrace.
"(We're) not running from it. We're accepting the fact that people think we're pretty good, OK?" Underwood said. "We worked for that, we deserve that. Handle the ups and the downs. ...
"This group hasn't done anything. Last year's team did. Keaton Wagler's not coming back through the door... Let's make our own identity, and let's make it a better one. The only way we know to do that is work."
For the first time in a long time, McCollum will be without point guard Bennett Stirtz, whom he coached from Division II Northwest Missouri State to Drake to Iowa. The coach told Big Ten Network he'd need a by-committee approach to replace the do-everything Stirtz, who's now in the NBA.
"I do think we'll play more players," he said. "I think you have to be careful with that, though, that you don't just play guys because you have them. You need to just play harder," McCollum said.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Venezuela's president expects third-quarter growth after earthquake hit
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Venezuela's economy is projected to expand 6.5% in the third quarter this year, acting President Delcy Rodriguez said on Thursday, highlighting recovery in both oil and non-oil sectors after devastating twin earthquakes struck the country in June.
items.body:
Venezuela's economy is projected to expand 6.5% in the third quarter this year, acting President Delcy Rodriguez said on Thursday, highlighting recovery in both oil and non-oil sectors after devastating twin earthquakes struck the country in June.
Oil production in the country increased 8% year-to-date, she added, speaking at an event with business leaders.
Since the US capture of former President Nicolas Maduro in January, Washington has been trying to secure a stable flow of Venezuelan crude for US refineries while promoting American investment into the OPEC country's deteriorated energy industry.
Venezuela currently produces some 1.25 million barrels per day of crude.
Rodriguez added that the country expects to receive $12 billion in public and private financing over the next two years.

スーパーマーケット大手のテスコは５．２％高。通期利益見通しを上方修正し、買われた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続落して取引を終えた。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は約４カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。原油高によるインフレ懸念や長期金利上昇が相場の重荷となり、銀行株など大半の業種の株価が下落した。財政懸念が強いフランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は０．５１％安と、約半年ぶりの安値を付けた。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は２．０４％安。ドイツ銀行は０．７％、フランスのソシエテ・ジェネラルは２．３％、スペインのサンタンデールは２．９％、イタリアのウニクレディトは３．１％、いずれも下落した。

ヘルスケア株指数は２．４７％安。欧州のバイオ医薬品会社アルジェニクスは１５．９％下落した。シェーグレン病の臨床試験で主要目標を達成する見込みが薄いとして試験を中止したことを受け、売られた。

原油先物価格の値上がりを受けて、石油・ガス株指数は２．４２％上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

原油価格の急騰を受けてインフレ懸念が強まる中、域内国債利回りが上昇した。ただ、フランスやイタリアなど債務残高が大きい国の国債売りをいったん手控える動きが見られた。

８日の北海ブレント先物は一時、５％高の１バレル＝１０５ドルと、１週間ぶりの高値を付けた。米・イラン戦争や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジアラビアとの紛争を背景に、中東からの原油供給途絶が懸念されている。

エネルギー価格の上昇を受け、市場では欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）による追加利上げ観測が強まった。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年債利回りは２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．５０％。

ＥＣＢの政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは５ｂｐ上昇の３．０８％。

フランス１０年債利回りは２ｂｐ上昇の４．８８％。取引序盤には９ｂｐ上昇する場面もあった。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１３８ｂｐと２ｂｐ拡大した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ低下の４．６３％となった。

items.title: Urea offers in India tender fall nearly 10%, offering relief to farmers
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Urea import prices fall nearly 10% from August, offering relief to Indian farmers and potentially easing the government's fertiliser subsidy burden ...
items.body: India, a major fertilizer importer, received offers in a urea tender nearly 10% below its August purchase price, signaling some relief for global farmers who have faced surging input costs this year.  Indian Potash Ltd., which also imports urea on behalf of the government, received offers for the west coast between $356.25 and $416.50 a ton in a tender that closed Wednesday, according to traders with direct knowledge of the tender. Offers for supplies to the east coast ranged between $352.10 and $465 a ton, they said.  In both regions, the total volume offered was more than double the amount the agency is seeking. India’s purchases are closely watched as a price benchmark for other importers, who have faced volatile costs this year after the war in Iran curbed the vital Middle Eastern supply. The country paid as much as $959 a ton for urea when the conflict began earlier this year. Prices have since plunged as supply constraints eased while global demand weakened. In its last tender in August, the South Asian nation bought supplies at $390.25 to $393.65 a ton. The decline could signal some relief for farmers worldwide, who are grappling with expensive costs for other key inputs, such as diesel. In India, farmers are preparing to sow crops like wheat, rapeseed and chickpeas in the approaching winter planting season, boosting demand for urea, a key nitrogen-based nutrient needed for crop growth. Lower import prices could also reduce pressure on the government’s fertilizer subsidy bill. A fertilizer ministry spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.title: ＦＲＢ、物価目標達成に追加利上げ必要＝セントルイス連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は８日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はインフレ率を目標の２％に戻すために追加利上げを実施する必要があると述べた。ただ、今月下旬の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での対応については言及を避けた。

ムサレム氏はニューヨークで開かれたブルームバーグ主催のイベントで「インフレ率を適時に目標へ戻すには一段の金融引き締めが必要になる」とし、「『適時』を１８カ月程度と考える場合、向こう６─９カ月の適切な時期に追加利上げが必要になることを示唆している」と語った。

ＦＲＢは２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで利上げを決定すべきかとの質問に対しては「毎回の会合に極めてオープンな姿勢で臨んでおり、その会合の結果や自分がどう行動するかについて予断を持っていない」と述べるにとどめた。ただ、「インフレ動向を踏まえると、追加的な政策引き締めを検討する必要がある」と述べた。ムサレム氏は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持っていない。

このほか、力強い経済成長と安定した労働市場が続く中で、インフレが米経済にとって最大の課題になっていると指摘。雇用を大きく損なうことなくインフレ率を引き下げられる可能性が高く、ＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すことで経済全体に幅広く恩恵をもたらすことができるとの見方を示した。

このところ上昇している国債利回りについては、ＦＲＢに対する信認が失われていることを示すものではなく、経済が堅調で資本需要が強い環境下では実質金利が上昇するとの見方が背景にあると指摘。ハイテク部門の旺盛な投資や政府の巨額な資金調達需要も利回りを押し上げる要因になっていると述べた。同時に「米政府は過去２０年近くにわたり持続不可能な財政運営の軌道をたどっている」とし、多額の政府債務が経済に問題を引き起こすリスクが存在すると警告した。

items.title: Taylor Farms suspenderá cosecha de lechuga en México durante temporadas de ciclosporiasis
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Taylor Farms anunció el jueves que suspenderá indefinidamente la recolección y el procesamiento de lechuga iceberg procedente del centro de México destinada a la venta en Estados Unidos o Canadá durante la temporada de ciclosporiasis, tras un reciente brote que afectó a miles de personas.
items.body:
Taylor Farms anunció el jueves que suspenderá indefinidamente la recolección y el procesamiento de lechuga iceberg procedente del centro de México destinada a la venta en Estados Unidos o Canadá durante la temporada de ciclosporiasis, tras un reciente brote que afectó a miles de personas.
El proveedor de productos frescos dijo que dejaría de comercializar lechuga iceberg de la región durante el periodo identificado por los Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades (CDC) de Estados Unidos como la temporada de ciclosporiasis, que coincide con la época de lluvias en el centro de México.
La temporada de ciclosporiasis en Estados Unidos se extiende del 1 de mayo al 31 de agosto, según la página web de los CDC.
Más tarde, la empresa afirmó que espera satisfacer la demanda de lechuga iceberg con los cultivos que tienen tanto en Canadá como en Estados Unidos, sin dar más detalles.
El brote de julio provocó que miles de personas enfermaran en todo Estados Unidos y alteró el funcionamiento de restaurantes, entre ellos los de Taco Bell, de Yum Brands (YUM.N) , que usaban la lechuga retirada del mercado.
La contaminación provocó una de las mayores retiradas de productos alimenticios de los últimos años y reavivó el escrutinio de los controles de seguridad alimentaria de los productos agrícolas importados.
La ciclosporiasis es una enfermedad intestinal causada por el parásito Cyclospora. Las personas pueden infectarse tras ingerir alimentos o agua contaminados, y los síntomas pueden incluir diarrea, calambres estomacales, náuseas y fatiga.

items.title: US President Donald Trump buys $1 million-plus stakes in Meta, Microsoft, McDonald’s; adds SpaceX debt
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Donald Trump invested over $1 million in stocks of several major companies during August. Notable purchases included Meta Platforms, McDonald's, Microsoft, and space-related debt from SpaceX. His investment activities encompass trading in shares of Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices, key players in the AI sector. Trump's financial dealings during his presidency have raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest.
items.body: US President Donald Trump purchased at least $1 million each in shares of Meta Platforms, McDonald’s and Microsoft in August, while also acquiring at least $1 million in SpaceX debt, according to a financial disclosure released on Thursday, Bloomberg News reported.The 18-page filing, published by the US Office of Government Ethics, details 517 transactions completed during the month. Trump’s investment accounts have recorded thousands of transactions each quarter, involving tens of millions of dollars and shares of major companies whose business interests are affected by his administration’s policies.His largest disclosed purchase in August was Meta stock valued at between $5 million and $25 million. Federal officials must report transaction values within broad ranges rather than disclose exact amounts.Trump also traded shares of Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices, two chipmakers central to the artificial-intelligence boom. His administration has strongly supported the AI industry, which has become a major issue in the midterm election campaign amid debates over data centres, energy consumption and safety regulations, as per Bloomberg reported.For live updates on US Markets, click hereHe also acquired stakes worth at least $1 million in Comcast, Netflix, Abbott Laboratories, ConocoPhillips and Chevron.The filing disclosed purchases and sales of municipal bonds, along with a tranche of debt issued by Elon Musk’s Space Exploration Technologies. Trump bought the SpaceX notes on August 18, and they mature in July 2031. He also purchased Tesla shares valued at no less than $51,000.Trump has not divested his assets or placed them in a blind trust overseen by an independent manager, as previous presidents have typically done. He is the only US president this century to maintain investment accounts that actively buy and sell stocks while in office. At the same time, he has supported legislation seeking to ban members of Congress from trading shares.His extensive business empire is managed by two of his sons and operates in several industries that intersect with federal policy.The Trump Organisation has said that independent third-party financial institutions manage the president’s stock and bond holdings and retain complete control over investment decisions. It has also said that transactions are executed through automated processes without involvement from Trump, his family or the company.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

WASHINGTON, Oct 8 : The four leaders of US President Donald Trump's AI task force are slated to meet on Thursday, task force vice chair Scott Kupor told Reuters, adding that he expects the full committee to convene next week as pressure builds on Washington to take action on AI.
The task force is expected to help shape the administration's approach to AI at a pivotal moment for the technology. 
Public uneasiness with AI, and the small group of people who seemingly hold sway over it, has risen in recent months. Most US voters think Trump's administration and Congress are not taking the risks of AI seriously enough and want the government to write new regulations for the technology, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll published on Wednesday. 
The AI companies "need to step up and demonstrate that they are taking concerns that people have around security and vulnerabilities very seriously, as do we," Kupor said.

Kupor said he expects the group to release a charter outlining its goals and responsibilities after its first full committee meeting. The group will have four to five staff members who will be assigned to the committee full-time, he said.
Trump has dubbed the group the Super Intelligence Task Force, using his preferred term for artificial intelligence. It is led by Intelligence Director Jay Clayton, with Kupor, Federal Trade Commission Chair Andrew Ferguson and Defense Department technology lead Emil Michael. Trump calls the Defense Department the Department of War.
Kupor said he will focus on engaging industries outside the technology sector, including banking, healthcare and utilities, to better understand how AI could affect their exposure to cyber threats. Michael will work directly with AI developers, Kupor said.

items.title: Fed's Musalem says tighter monetary policy needed to lower inflation
items.author: Michael Derby
items.creator: Michael Derby
items.summary: St. Louis Federal Reserve President Alberto Musalem said on Thursday the US central bank will need to hike interest rates again to bring inflation back to its 2% target, although he declined to say what policymakers should do at their meeting later this month.
items.body:
St. Louis Federal Reserve President Alberto Musalem said on Thursday the US central bank will need to hike interest rates again to bring [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation back"] to its 2% target, although he declined to say what policymakers should do at their meeting later this month.
"To bring inflation back to target in a timely manner, more monetary policy firming will be required," Musalem said at an event held by Bloomberg in New York.
"If a timely manner is something like 18 months, that kind of suggests that rates ought to be going up further in an appropriate period of time in the next six to nine months," he said.
Musalem, who is not a voting member of the central bank's rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee this year, demurred when asked if the Fed should raise rates at the October 27-28 meeting.
"I go into every meeting with a very open mind, and I haven't prejudged what the outcome of that meeting is going to be, or what I'm going to do at that meeting," Musalem said, adding that the general direction of "inflation requires us to be thinking of further policy firming here."
Traders broadly expect the Fed will hold its policy rate in the 3.75%-4.00% range at the meeting in October. The Fed [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"hiked rates"] at its September 15-16 meeting in an effort to bring high levels of inflation back to its target.
Policymakers at that meeting also penciled in another rate hike by the end of this year. Traders had been putting strong odds on an October rate hike until New York Fed President John Williams said last week that there is [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"no urgency to act"] while the Fed weighs incoming data. Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson followed up by saying he saw no imminent need to raise rates.
The Fed is now expected to deliver its next rate hike in December.
'UNSUSTAINABLE FISCAL PATH' In his remarks, Musalem said inflation is the economy's primary problem amid strong growth and a stable job market. He said the Fed can likely lower inflation without denting hiring, and that getting inflation back to the 2% goal would be broadly helpful.
Musalem also noted that even with the notable rise in bond yields, "financial conditions remain accommodative and supportive of economic growth."
He said the rise in yields does not signal investors are losing confidence in the Fed. Instead, yields are up on expectations that real rates will go up in a strong economy marked by a lot of competition for capital. Strong investment in the tech sector and large government borrowing needs are helping to keep yields up, he said.
"The US federal government has been on an unsustainable fiscal path now for the better part of two decades," Musalem said, adding that "the risk is there" that heavy levels of government borrowing could create [USN:L6N45T16X TEXT:"problems"] for the economy.

items.title: Rosa prevê superávit comercial de ao menos US$90 bi em 2026, acima de estimativa oficial
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Brasil deve ter um superávit comercial de ao menos US$90 bilhões este ano a despeito da recente redução da estimativa oficial do governo para um saldo de cerca de US$85 bilhões, disse nesta quinta-feira o ministro de Indústria Comércio Bens e Serviços, Márcio Elias Rosa.
items.body:
O Brasil deve ter um superávit comercial de ao menos US$90 bilhões este ano a despeito da recente redução da estimativa oficial do governo para um saldo de cerca de US$85 bilhões, disse nesta quinta-feira o ministro de Indústria Comércio Bens e Serviços, Márcio Elias Rosa.
Segundo ele , o país vem apostando na diversificação de mercados para compensar o impacto sobre as exportações de movimentos como o tarifaço dos EUA e o embargo a carnes bovinas e de aves imposto pela União Europeia. “Continuo apostando em US$90 bilhões, se não passar de US$90 bilhões", disse ele a jornalistas na Firjan (Federação das Indústrias do Estado do Rio de Janeiro).
Rosa disse que as negociações para flexibilização do tarifaço norte-americano estão caminhando e em três ou quatro semanas o governo brasileiro espera receber uma nova [USN:L1N45M15C TEXT:"proposta"] dos EUA. "Nós podemos constituir um grupo de trabalho, se for o caso, enquanto isso as equipes técnicas podem dialogar."
O Mdic reduziu na terça-feira sua projeção para o superávit da balança comercial brasileira em 2026 a US$84,4 bilhões, contra previsão feita em julho de saldo de US$90 bilhões, prevendo ganho menor nas exportações e arrefecimento de preços internacionais.
Apesar da revisão para baixo, o resultado ainda seria 24% mais forte do que o observado no ano anterior, quando o saldo foi de US$68,1 bilhões, e marcaria o segundo maior saldo da série histórica, atrás apenas do dado de 2023.

items.title: Law firms give lawyers time off billing grind to test-drive AI
items.author: Sara Merken, David Thomas
items.creator: Sara Merken, David Thomas
items.summary: (Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com)
items.body:
(Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com )
As Ropes & Gray ramps up its use of AI, the law firm said its 1,000-plus associates and counsel can now count up to 100 hours of AI experimenting and training toward their annual billing requirements.
The move, part of a firmwide AI training initiative in place since the spring, expands on the firm's decision last year to allow first-year associates to [USN:L1N3WF0V8 TEXT:"devote up to 20% of their required billable hours"] – nearly 400 hours – to AI training and simulations.
All of Boston-founded Ropes' first-year associates participated in the program, which the firm found to be a "huge success," said Patrick Ryan, its director of knowledge management innovation.
A Ropes spokesperson said the firm has "invested over 35,000 associate hours to AI time this year" under the hourly-credit program.
Law firms use hourly requirements to ensure lawyers are busy, assess their productivity and allocate bonuses. Devoting a portion of them to non-client work is another sign of the legal industry's investment in AI, which firms are using to speed up legal work and streamline their business operations.
Two Ropes associates told Reuters the credit program gives them flexibility to try AI tools even when it can't be billed directly to clients.
Kevin Schoonveld, a New York-based ninth-year debt finance associate, said learning to use prompts that yield accurate results takes time that busy associates might otherwise be less willing to commit.
“When you're first playing around with these AI tools, you're investing a lot of time in it and you're not seeing a ton of efficiencies at first," he said.
Some other firms are also allowing limited billable hours credits for work using AI that’s not directly for clients.
At Akerman, lawyers since April have been able to get credit for AI-related projects that are “really contributing value” to the firm, said chairman Scott Meyers.
He said the firm posts AI assignments on an internal portal for associates to take up or propose their own. So far, associate projects have included building an AI agent to review construction contracts and testing AI research tools to document where they have produced inaccurate results, he said.
“We understand that there may be some compression in billable hours” due to AI being able to handle more work, Meyers said. But he said that alone shouldn't dictate a need for fewer associates, and the credits program helps to address associates' concerns about AI's impact on the time they're billing.
“If we need to find other ways to fill that time, I suspect it will be that combination of billable and creditable hours,” he said. As at most large firms, billable hours credits are also allocated for pro bono work.
At Ropes & Gray, the AI credits are part of a broader training and professional development program for all the firm's attorneys. Lawyers move through training modules toward applying AI to client work and are later encouraged to develop internal AI tools or processes, Ryan said.
The firm is also including AI as a topic in lawyers' annual review conversations, but not with the aim of penalizing them, said Amy Ross, the firm's chief legal talent officer.
"To the extent that we're finding people aren't using it, we want to address that too," she said.
KIRKLAND TIGHTENS LID ON FINANCES Kirkland & Ellis, the highest-grossing US law firm, said it will no longer report its annual financial results to The American Lawyer.
The firm, whose revenue topped $10 billion last year, said in a Wednesday letter to editors at the legal trade publication that "public reporting of our revenue and profits does not provide meaningful value to our clients nor adequately reflect the caliber of our firm’s legal services."
It said publicizing its finances for ranking purposes "could incentivize quantitative metrics over qualitative strengths," like the quality of its legal services, according to the letter, which was viewed by Reuters.
The American Lawyer annually publishes lists of the 200 highest-grossing and most profitable law firms in the country. Kirkland, driven in part by its private equity and restructuring work, has topped the revenue rankings since 2017.
Kirkland's revenue hit $10.56 billion in 2025, while its average profits per equity partner reached $11.1 million. The firm has a tiered partnership in which a substantial number of partners do not have a traditional ownership stake.
Also on Billable Hours' radar this week...
--AT&T's legal department has stopped paying law firms to handle many routine assignments typically done by junior lawyers, and is instead using an in-house team using AI, Reuters columnist Sara Randazzo [USN:L6N45S1A5 TEXT:"reports"]. AT&T's general counsel said its roster of 30 or so outside law firms could shrink in the future.
--President Donald Trump’s administration is vying in federal court to allow the EEOC to keep information secret from the public about its probes last year targeting the employment practices at some major US law firms. The [USN:L6N45S09L TEXT:"administration is contesting"] a lawsuit over access to the records and says a significant amount of information must remain confidential.
--Cornell University has [USN:L6N45S15B TEXT:"hired Sally Yates"], who served as deputy US attorney general from 2015 to 2017, for an internal investigation of how it handled a student's allegations that she was gang-raped, a case that has brought mounting scrutiny and triggered student protests at the Ivy League school.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens as US Gulf Coast prepares for landfall
items.author: Brad Brooks
items.creator: Brad Brooks
items.summary: Hurricane Isaias strengthened on Thursday as it barreled toward the US Gulf Coast, prompting mandatory evacuations in parts of Florida and emergency declarations in Alabama as forecasters warned of life-threatening storm surges, tornadoes and flooding.
items.body:
Hurricane Isaias strengthened on Thursday as it barreled toward the US Gulf Coast, prompting mandatory evacuations in parts of Florida and emergency declarations in Alabama as forecasters warned of life-threatening storm surges, tornadoes and flooding.
Isaias has already severely disrupted oil and gas production in the Gulf of Mexico, forcing energy companies to evacuate offshore platforms and shut down operations.
The first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season was packing maximum sustained winds of 85 mph (140 kph) early on Thursday, the US National Hurricane Center said. Isaias was forecast to strengthen to near Category 3 intensity, with sustained winds reaching 110 mph (175 kph) on Friday before reaching the northern Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday.
"We are expecting Isaias to be a dangerous hurricane when it makes landfall,” NHC director Michael Brennan said in a Thursday morning briefing. "Today is the day to prepare and get ready."
Isaias nearly tied the record for the latest first Atlantic hurricane with one that hit on October 8, 1905. The strong El Nino weather pattern this year has suppressed Atlantic hurricane development by increasing vertical wind shear, which disrupts the formation of strengthening tropical storms.
The hurricane was moving east-northeast at 10 mph (17 kph), about 355 miles (570 km) south of the mouth of the Mississippi River at 1 p.m. US Central time, the NHC said.
IMPACTS ON OIL, GAS The Marine Minerals Administration, which monitors offshore US oil and gas operators in the Gulf of Mexico, said on Thursday that personnel have been evacuated from 121 production platforms and five non-dynamically positioned rigs ahead of the storm.
About 63% of current oil production in the Gulf, or 1.3 million barrels of oil a day, has been shut in, the agency said, citing operator reports. Just over 1.1 billion cubic feet a day of natural gas production has also been shut in, or about 57% of total output from the region.
On Wednesday, 25% of oil production and 16% of natural gas output had been shut in.
About 9 million barrels of oil production could be lost across the Gulf through the duration of the storm, a marked increase from the 7.1 million barrels impacted by Tropical Storm Bertha in July, according to a model forecast from consulting firm Earth Science Associates.
The companies with the most exposure to the storm include BP, Chevron (CVX.N) , ENI, Murphy Oil (MUR.N) and Shell (SHEL.L) , among others, according to the Earth Science model.
WARNINGS, STORM SURGE Hurricane warnings stretched from coastal Mississippi through Alabama to the Florida panhandle, while tropical-storm and storm-surge warnings extended into southeastern Louisiana, the NHC said.
Forecasters warned that storm surges could reach 5 to 7 feet (1.5 to 2.1 meters) above sea level in the hardest-hit coastal areas, with rainfall of 3 to 7 inches (8 to 18 cm) and isolated totals of 15 inches (38 cm).
The hurricane was forecast to weaken somewhat as it approached land. Increasing vertical wind shear, which can disrupt a hurricane's circulation, was expected to limit its strength near landfall, though forecasters warned it would remain dangerous.
EVACUATIONS ORDERED In Florida, officials ordered mandatory evacuations beginning at noon local time on Thursday for coastal areas of Okaloosa County.
The county urged tourists to leave the area and announced plans to close three airports Thursday evening. Governor Ron DeSantis declared a state of emergency in 25 Florida counties earlier in the week.
Alabama Governor Kay Ivey declared a state of emergency covering 40 counties, while officials on Dauphin Island issued an evacuation notice for the western portion of the barrier island beginning Thursday evening.
Baldwin County, Alabama, encouraged residents of low-lying coastal areas to evacuate voluntarily and prepared emergency shelters.
In Mississippi, Jackson County and the city of Gautier declared local emergencies as coastal communities prepared for flooding and power outages.
items.raw_description: Hurricane Isaias strengthened on Thursday as it barreled toward the US Gulf Coast, prompting mandatory evacuations in parts of Florida and emergency declarations in Alabama as forecasters warned of life-threatening storm surges, tornadoes and flooding.

Oct 8 : Revolut would favor a primary listing in the United States if the digital bank decides to pursue an initial pubic offering in the future, CEO Nik Storonsky told Bloomberg TV on Thursday.
Storonsky, who founded Revolut, told Bloomberg TV that the firm wants to "dominate" the US market and plans to roll out credit cards and loans, once it receives a full banking charter.
Revolut received preliminary approval for a national banking licence in the United States in September, after getting licences in Britain and France earlier this year.
The bank has risen to become Europe's most valuable startup, having grown rapidly since it was launched just over a decade ago as a fintech promising cheaper forex fees. Valued at $115 billion privately, Revolut is now worth more than Britain's Barclays  and France's Societe Generale.
The company's top boss had previously told French newspaper Les Echos the bank was looking into a dual stock market listing in New York and London.
Any eventual listing is still likely to be at least a year away, with past media reports citing 2028, and subject to market conditions.

items.title: Precios de bonos Tesoro EEUU cambian de tendencia y suben tras subasta de deuda a 30 años
items.author: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.summary: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron el jueves, y la mayoría de los retornos descendió por segunda vez en la semana, después de que una sólida demanda en una subasta a 30 años sugiriera que los inversores siguen dispuestos a comprar deuda pública a largo plazo pese a una reciente ola de ventas.
items.body:
Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron el jueves, y la mayoría de los retornos descendió por segunda vez en la semana, después de que una sólida demanda en una subasta a 30 años sugiriera que los inversores siguen dispuestos a comprar deuda pública a largo plazo pese a una reciente ola de ventas.
* Más temprano en la sesión, los bonos se vieron presionados por el alza de los precios del petróleo. El crudo retrocedió ligeramente después de que el presidente Donald Trump afirmara que Estados Unidos no lanzaría un ataque contra Irán antes de las elecciones legislativas de mitad de mandato de noviembre.
* En las operaciones de la tarde, el rendimiento de referencia a 10 años cayó 5 puntos básicos, al 5,227%, tras haber alcanzado el miércoles su nivel más alto en 24 años.
* Los retornos a 30 años cedieron 5,9 puntos básicos, al 5,602%. La caída de los rendimientos implica un aumento en el precio de los bonos del Tesoro.
* En el tramo corto de la curva, la rentabilidad a dos años, que refleja las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, bajó 1,3 puntos básicos, al 4,751% .
* Los analistas señalaron que el éxito de la subasta a 30 años fue un factor clave para el repunte. El bono se colocó con un rendimiento del 5,618%, por debajo de la tasa esperada justo antes de la subasta, lo que indica que los inversores compraron el título sin exigir una mayor rentabilidad.
* La ratio de cobertura, una medida de la demanda, también fue elevada, situándose en 2,54 veces, frente a un promedio de 2,41 veces en las seis subastas previas. Las ofertas indirectas, que incluyen a inversores extranjeros, absorbieron el 72,3% de la emisión, superando el promedio del 69,1% registrada en las seis operaciones previas.
* No obstante, el petróleo sigue siendo un factor determinante para los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, ya que aviva la preocupación por la inflación.
* Los futuros del Brent cerraron en 104,28 dólares por barril, con un alza del 4,07%, mientras que los futuros del crudo estadounidense ganaron un 3,65%, a 91,49 dólares.
* Ambos contratos llegaron a escalar más de 5 dólares por barril durante la sesión, impulsados por la persistente inquietud sobre el suministro de petróleo en Oriente Medio tras los ataques a buques en el Golfo y el estrecho de Ormuz.

items.author: ロイター

Olivia Le Poidevin

[ジュネーブ ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Olivia Le Poidevin

[ジュネーブ ８日 ロイター] - 世界貿易機関（ＷＴＯ）は８日、世界のモノ（財）の貿易量の２０２６年の伸び率見通しを３．９％とし、３月時点の予想１．９％から引き上げた。中東情勢による混乱の影響はあるものの、半導体やデータセンターなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連製品への需要が伸びる見通し。２７年の伸び率予想は４．１％に上方修正した。一方、燃料や肥料の価格高騰を受けた家計の購買力低下や、ＡＩの投資ブームに減速リスクがあると指摘した。

地域別では、アジアは輸入が９．５％、輸出が９．９％、それぞれ増える見通し。アフリカも輸入が８．９％、輸出が５．６％増えると見込んだ。中東は輸出入ともに大幅減となる見通しだ。

２６年１─６月期のモノの貿易量が前年同期比３．５％増だったのに対し、ドル建ての貿易額は１５％増えた。エネルギー価格高騰や、ＡＩ関連製品への需要を反映しており、貿易額の増加分の４７％をＡＩ関連商品が占めた。

２６年の世界の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は２．６％増と予測。地域別ではアジアが４．３％増と最も高い伸びとなり、アフリカ、南米が続くと見込んだ。

２６年のサービス貿易の伸び率の見通しは、従来予想の４．８％から３．３％に引き下げた。航空燃料費の高騰が響くものの、２７年は６．４％に回復すると予想した。

items.title: 米、11月中間選挙前にイラン攻撃せず＝トランプ氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は８日、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないと表明した。戦争の終結に向け、両国は「建設的な」協議を行っているとした。 

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「イランと建設的な協議を行っている。われわれは１１月３日に米国で行われる中間選挙まで、いかなる時点においてもイランを攻撃することはない」と述べた。

今年２月に米国とイスラエルによるイラン攻撃で始まった戦争は、トランプ氏の国内支持率を押し下げる要因となっている。１１月の選挙で上下両院の多数派を維持しようとする共和党にとっても重い足かせとなっている。 

ロイター／イプソスが最近実施した世論調査によると、米国民の約６０％がトランプ氏のイラン対応を支持しないと回答した。共和党支持者でも４人に１人が不支持だった。有権者が最大の関心事に生活費を挙げる中、紛争はガソリン価格を大きく押し上げている。 

イランと米国はここ数週間、戦争の終結と、世界のエネルギー輸送の要衝であるホルムズ海峡の再開に向けた提案を交わしてきた。トランプ氏はイラン側の最新の提案を拒否した。

イランのエスラミ原子力庁長官は、米国がイランに対しウラン濃縮能力の「意味のある」削減を求めたことを受け、イランはウラン濃縮活動を放棄せず、保有するウランを引き渡すこともないと述べた。国営メディアが８日報じた。

items.title: Russia's Yandex says it is unclear whether data centre can be restored after drone strike
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Russian technology and AI company Yandex said on Thursday it could not yet determine whether equipment at a data centre hit by a Ukrainian drone attack could be restored.
items.body:
Russian technology and AI company Yandex said on Thursday it could not yet determine whether equipment at a data centre hit by a Ukrainian drone attack could be restored.
Yandex [USN:L1N45U04H TEXT:"said"] earlier that the attack on its Sasovo hub, one of its five large data centres, caused a fire and forced it to suspend operations at the site, which hosts tens of thousands of servers.
"The scale of the damage to the infrastructure is still being assessed," Yandex said in a statement. "For the moment, we cannot confirm whether it is possible to restore the data centre equipment in Sasovo."
The company earlier said some of its services were unavailable and specialist teams were at the site assessing the damage.
Two of Yandex's three supercomputers, used to develop its AI model, are housed at the Sasovo data centre. Yandex has not said whether they were damaged.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, speaking to reporters in Kyiv, did not refer specifically to the strike on Yandex, but said Ukraine was "mirroring" Russian attacks on data centres.
"We always respond in mirror-like fashion," [USN:L1N45U0TV TEXT:"Zelenskiy said"]. "You all know, they have been hitting and continue to hit our data centres. We are responding. I can't share all the details."

items.title: US bonds rally after 30-year auction finds solid demand
items.author: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.summary: US Treasuries rose on Thursday, with most yields across the curve falling for just the second time this week, after a 30-year bond auction met with solid demand, showing investors remain willing to buy long-dated government debt, despite the ongoing market selloff.
items.body:
US Treasuries rose on Thursday, with most yields across the curve falling for just the second time this week, after a 30-year bond auction met with solid demand, showing investors remain willing to buy long-dated government debt, despite the ongoing market selloff.
Earlier in the session, Treasuries were pressured by higher oil prices. Crude oil pulled back slightly after President Donald Trump said that the [USN:L1N45U0PH TEXT:"US will not launch an attack"] on Iran before midterm elections in November.
In afternoon trading, the benchmark 10-year yield was down 5 basis points to 5.227% after hitting a 24-year high on Wednesday. US 30-year yields also declined, down 5.9 bps at 5.602% . When Treasury prices fall, yields rise.
On the shorter end of the curve, US 2-year yields, which reflect interest rate expectations, dipped 1.3 bps to 4.751% .
Analysts said the strong 30-year auction was a big factor for the rally. The issue priced at a yield of [USN:AQN2MNC9C TEXT:"5.618%"], below the expected rate at the bid deadline, which meant investors bought the bond without demanding higher compensation.
The bid-to-cover ratio, a measure of demand, was also high at 2.54, better than the average of 2.41 times over the last six auctions. Indirect bids, which include foreign investors, took 72.3% of supply, up from an average of 69.1% over the last six auctions.
Jay Hatfield, chief executive officer at Infrastructure Capital Management, said he thinks 10-year Treasury yields have peaked.
"The peak was probably the 5.30% level, maybe even lower and we believe we have already seen peak pessimism about Fed rate increases," Hatfield said. He believes the Fed will only be able to raise interest rates just once in this cycle, as opposed to the three currently being factored in by the market.
"We think the Fed's being irrational by all this tough talk on inflation," Hatfield said.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday [USN:L6N45T15S TEXT:"additional rate hikes"] will likely be needed to lower inflation to the Fed's 2% target, but added there was "flexibility" about the pace of increases. His comments pushed 2-year yields higher, which rose faster than 10-year yields.
The yield curve flattened on Thursday, with the spread between 2-year and 10-year yields narrowing to 47.1 bps from 51.4 bps. Earlier in the session, the curve hit 54.2 bps, steepest since mid-August.
OIL AS MAJOR DRIVER Oil remains a major driver of Treasury yields, stoking inflation concerns.
Brent crude settled at $103.92 per barrel, up 3.7%, while US crude futures ended 3.4% higher at $91.17. Both contracts at one point were up $5 a barrel on [USN:L1N45U031 TEXT:"persistent worries"] about oil supply in the Middle East .
"The market remains content to trade the energy shock solely from the perspective of the inflationary implications, largely ignoring any potential demand destruction that could follow," wrote Ian Lyngen, head of US rates strategy at BMO, in a research note.

items.title: インフレリスクは上振れ方向で一致、成長には下押し要因＝ＥＣＢ議事要旨
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Balazs Koranyi

[フランクフルト ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Balazs Koranyi

[フランクフルト ８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が８日に公表した９月９─１０日のＥＣＢ理事会の議事要旨で、エネルギー価格の極めて大きな変動と広範な不確実性を踏まえ、インフレリスクは一段の上振れに傾いているとの認識で全員が一致した。

ＥＣＢは同理事会で、政策金利を０．２５％ポイント引き上げると決定した。

インフレ率は既に目標の２％のほぼ２倍に達し、エネルギー高の影響でさらに上昇する可能性があるため、市場はあと２─３回の利上げを見込んでいる。

理事会は、エネルギー高が他の財・サービス価格や賃金へ波及する「間接効果」や「第二次波及効果」を警戒した。ただし現時点では、賃金の大幅な加速や広範な物価上昇が明確に生じたとは言えないという評価も示された。

経済見通しについては、リスクは依然として下方に偏っているとはいえ、以前よりもバランスが取れているとした。

ただ、金融市場の急激な調整がなくても、世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの勢いが鈍化するだけで、世界需要と純輸出を通じた波及効果によりユーロ圏の成長見通しに重しとなるのに十分だとの主張もあった。

さらに、長期金利のさらなる上昇は成長に悪影響を及ぼす可能性があるとの指摘もなされた。

財政見通しについては、最近の政府支出の増加と長期国債利回りの上昇は、時間の経過とともに脆弱性を高める可能性があると示唆。健全な公的財政を維持することが重要だとし、エネルギーショックへの財政対応は一時的かつ的を絞ったものであるべきと指摘された。 

ユーロ圏の長期利回りは７月の理事会以降、上昇している。これについては、長期ゾーンにおける最近の動きは、主に実質ターム・プレミアムの上昇によって引き起こされたように見え、これは官民の債務発行の増加と財政見通しに関する不確実性によって説明できる可能性があるとした。

７月理事会以降の市場金利の上昇については、世界的な長期利回りの動向とその要因の双方を分析し、金融状況、公的財政、マクロ経済を含む利回りの緩やかな上昇の影響を理解し、さらなる動向を評価することが重要だとした。

items.title: トランプ氏、エヌビディア株取引　160万ドル購入・一部売却＝資産開示
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が８月に半導体大手エヌビディアの株式を最大１６０万ドル購入し、その後最大１００万ドル相当を売却していたことが分かった。８日に公表された資産開示報告書から明らかになった。

報告書によると、エヌビディア株の取引は、トランプ大統領が８月に行った数百件の取引の一つだった。

ホワイトハウスのイングル報道官はロイターに宛てた声明で、トランプ大統領のポートフォリオは第三者の金融機関によって独立して運用されていると説明。「全ての投資に関する決定は完全に独立した運用担当者によって行われている」とした上で、「利益相反は一切ない」と述べた。

トランプ政権は、エヌビディアの先端半導体の輸出規制緩和など、同社の事業に影響し得る政策を検討している。またトランプ大統領は同日、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）らに、科学分野における功績をたたえる全米科学賞を授与する見通しだ。

items.title: EEUU congela programa de visas a Microsoft y otras tecnológicas; investiga universidades
items.author: Akash Sriram, Steve Holland
items.creator: Akash Sriram, Steve Holland
items.summary: Estados Unidos suspendió el jueves a Microsoft , a las principales empresas de externalización de tecnologías de información y al fabricante de software Adobe de un programa de visas, e inició investigaciones a nueve universidades de prestigio.
items.body:
Estados Unidos suspendió el jueves a Microsoft (MSFT.O) , a las principales empresas de externalización de tecnologías de información y al fabricante de software Adobe (ADBE.O) de un programa de visas, e inició investigaciones a nueve universidades de prestigio.
El Gobierno amplió de esta manera una campaña de represión que, dice, tiene como objetivo combatir el fraude y proteger los puestos de trabajo estadounidenses.
Desde que asumió el cargo, el presidente Donald Trump ha llevado a cabo una extensa campaña para reducir el número de personas nacidas en el extranjero en Estados Unidos y restringir su acceso a la residencia y la ciudadanía.
Las dos medidas adoptadas el jueves suponen el golpe más contundente hasta la fecha contra los programas de inmigración de trabajadores cualificados, lo que podría cortar una vía habitual hacia la residencia permanente para los trabajadores extranjeros del sector tecnológico, y ponen en la mira a algunas de las universidades de investigación más prestigiosas del país.
"Lamentablemente, no ha habido ninguna empresa en Estados Unidos que haya abusado más del sistema que Microsoft", dijo el vicepresidente JD Vance.
Vance señaló que la empresa despidió a 6.000 trabajadores estadounidenses el año pasado, al tiempo que se benefició de 6.300 visados de trabajador temporal H-1B y de casi 3 000 tarjetas de residencia.
Los comentarios los hizo horas antes de un homenaje de Trump a varios multimillonarios del sector tecnológico por sus contribuciones a Estados Unidos, entre ellos el presidente ejecutivo de Microsoft, Satya Nadella.
Nadella tuvo en su día un visado H-1B, al igual que Elon Musk, quien también fue homenajeado, lo mismo que otros tres presidentes ejecutivos inmigrantes.
Microsoft es la empresa que más solicitudes PERM presenta, es decir, el proceso de certificación laboral permanente, según datos del Departamento de Trabajo.
En el marco del PERM, que se exige para la mayoría de las tarjetas de residencia basadas en el empleo, las empresas deben demostrar que la contratación de personal extranjero no perjudicará los salarios ni los puestos de trabajo de los trabajadores estadounidenses.
La empresa dijo en un comunicado que alrededor del 80% de las solicitudes de visado H-1B que presentó en el último ejercicio fiscal tenían como objetivo prorrogar o modificar la situación de los empleados actuales, y no contratar a nuevos trabajadores. En julio anunció que recortaría 4.800 puestos de trabajo, aproximadamente el 2,1% de su plantilla global.

items.title: Flávio promete reajustar aposentadoria acima da inflação
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador e candidato à Presidência, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), prometeu nesta quinta-feira que, se eleito, reajustará os valores da aposentadoria acima da inflação e negou planos para mudar a forma atual de correção dos benefícios da Previdência e do Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC), após o jornal Folha de S. Paulo publicar mais cedo que sua equipe estuda alterar esses reajustes, assim como a correção dos gastos obrigatórios com saúde e educação.
items.body:
O senador e candidato à Presidência, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), prometeu nesta quinta-feira que, se eleito, reajustará os valores da aposentadoria acima da inflação e negou planos para mudar a forma atual de correção dos benefícios da Previdência e do Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC), após o jornal Folha de S. Paulo publicar mais cedo que sua equipe estuda alterar esses reajustes, assim como a correção dos gastos obrigatórios com saúde e educação.
Perguntado por jornalistas se reajustaria a aposentadoria acima da inflação, ele respondeu "sim", ao término de uma entrevista coletiva em Brasília para anunciar o apoio do Podemos à sua candidatura no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, onde enfrentará no dia 25 de outubro o presidente e candidato à reeleição Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
"Não caia nessa fake news do PT dizendo que eu vou acabar com o reajuste à aposentadoria. Pelo contrário, minha avó é professora aposentada do Estado. Eu sei da dificuldade que ela tem de fazer compra no final do mês, tenho que ajudar ela de vez em quando, meus irmãos têm que ajudar a minha avó e meu avô de vez em quando, porque os dois são aposentados", disse Flávio.
O senador afirmou que o ajuste fiscal que seu eventual governo fará se concentrará em outras despesas que não os benefícios sociais.
Mais cedo, após a publicação da reportagem da Folha de S. Paulo, o economista [USN:L6N45U0SH TEXT:"Adolfo Sachsida"], um dos coordenadores da área econômica da campanha de Flávio, afirmou que, se o senador for eleito presidente, o próximo governo irá fortalecer programas sociais e reduzir impostos. Sachsida negou que o candidato planeje privatizar estatais como Petrobras, Banco do Brasil e Caixa Econômica Federal.
Após Flávio terminar o primeiro turno da eleição, disputado no último domingo, cerca de 2,2 milhões de votos à frente de Lula, o Ibovespa, índice de referência do mercado de ações brasileiro, teve um forte rali, ficando acima dos 200 mil pontos, e o dólar teve forte queda, chegando a operar abaixo de R$5. Boa parte dos agentes do mercado considera que, com Flávio no Planalto, crescem as chances de um maior controle das contas públicas -- ainda que o candidato não tenha apresentado propostas concretas de ajuste - o que abriria espaço para juros mais baixos e uma redução na trajetória de crescimento da dívida pública.

items.title: ベネズエラ前大統領夫妻、米で追起訴　政敵や米国人への拷問共謀罪で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Luc Cohen

[ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Luc Cohen

[ニューヨーク　８日　ロイター] - 米検察当局は８日、ベネズエラのマドゥロ前大統領と妻のシリア・フロレス氏について、同国での権力維持のために政敵や米国人を拷問したとされる容疑で追起訴した。

マンハッタン連邦地裁に提出された追起訴状によると、両氏はこれまでの麻薬密売罪に加え、拷問共謀罪の新たな容疑で起訴された。

検察側によると、ある事例では、マドゥロ氏は２０１３年に、クーデターを企てた疑いのあるベネズエラ軍将校の逮捕を命じたという。その後、ベネズエラ軍の防諜局員らは、同将校を尋問する際に、通電した電線で約２０回にわたり感電させたほか、手足を縛って数分間つるしたという。

また起訴状によると、２２年にはベネズエラ入国時に拘束された米国人が、マドゥロ氏の暗殺を企てたとして告発され、軍の防諜要員から殴打されたほか、腕や脚、性器に電気ショックを加えられるなどの拷問を受けた。

マドゥロ氏の弁護団は、コメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

マドゥロ氏夫妻は１月、首都カラカスの自宅で米軍に拘束され、麻薬密輸の罪でニューヨークに移送された。公判は２７年６月１日に始まる予定で、両氏は無罪を主張している。

items.title: Latam prevê anunciar até quatro novos destinos com jatos Embraer em novembro
items.author: Gabriel Araujo
items.creator: Gabriel Araujo
items.summary:
A Latam Brasil
espera anunciar no final de novembro uma segunda fase da expansão de sua malha com aviões Embraer E195-E2 , incluindo até quatro novos destinos, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o presidente-executivo da companhia, Jerome Cadier.
items.body:
A Latam Brasil (LTM.SN)
espera anunciar no final de novembro uma segunda fase da expansão de sua malha com aviões Embraer E195-E2 (EMBJ3.SA) , incluindo até quatro novos destinos, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o presidente-executivo da companhia, Jerome Cadier.
Em evento na sede da fabricante em São José dos Campos (SP) para receber a primeira das 24 aeronaves encomendadas pela Latam, o executivo destacou que uma terceira leva de rotas deve ser divulgada no início do ano que vem.
"Devemos anunciar a fase 2 no finalzinho de novembro, e a já devemos adicionar mais provavelmente três a quatro destinos. E em fevereiro do ano que vem já falar da fase 3, e aí sim completariam as 24 aeronaves", disse Cadier.
A Latam anunciou em agosto a primeira fase da implementação dos E195-E2 em sua operação doméstica, com 14 jatos destinados a 42 rotas, incluindo oito novas ligações e quatro novas bases: Ji-Paraná (RO), Rondonópolis (TO), Cabo Frio (RJ) e Macaé (RJ). Os voos com o modelo começarão em novembro.
Cadier lembrou que a expansão tem sido impulsionada por uma demanda robusta por viagens de negócios, chamando atenção para a "composição corporativa bastante grande" nos quatro novos destinos revelados em agosto.
A decisão pelas rotas levou em conta áreas com forte demanda do setor agrícola, como Ji-Paraná e Rondonópolis, e da indústria petrolífera, como Macaé.
"As outras que vêm pela frente também vão ter um mix entre turismo e corporativo, mas acho que é uma tônica do crescimento do mercado doméstico nos últimos anos ter sido um mercado resiliente do ponto de vista de viagens de negócios, e provavelmente vai continuar assim", afirmou o executivo.
Cadier disse ainda que as novas rotas anunciadas em agosto têm apresentado desempenho positivo de vendas desde o lançamento.
O executivo acrescentou que a Latam poderia eventualmente incluir rotas para outros países da América do Sul em suas operações com o E2.
"É uma possibilidade. Não nessa fase 1 ou fase 2, mas talvez na fase 3, essas rotas que chamamos de regionais dentro da América do Sul", disse.
A Latam possui um pedido firme de 24 aeronaves E195-E2 da Embraer, além de opções para adquirir outras 50 unidades.
O presidente da Embraer, Francisco Gomes Neto, afirmou que a entrada da companhia na base de operadores do modelo reforça a relevância global da aeronave.
"Não só no Brasil, para os brasileiros voarem mais de E2 por aqui, mas para o mundo todo passa uma mensagem de que esse avião é muito adequado para abrir novas rotas, oferecer maior frequência de voo. É muito importante para nós, a gente está muito contente com isso", disse.

WASHINGTON, Oct 8 : President Donald Trump bought as much as $1.6 million and sold as much as $1 million in Nvidia stock in August, according to his latest financial disclosure, which was released on Thursday as he prepared to award Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang the nation's highest honor for scientific achievement.
The new disclosure of the president's investment in one of the world's most valuable companies comes as his administration weighs policies that could shape Nvidia's fortunes, including rules governing exports of its advanced chips. 
White House spokesperson Davis Ingle said in a statement to Reuters that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000." 
Huang is set to receive the National Medal of Science from Trump on Thursday. The award honors Americans who have made "outstanding contributions to knowledge in the physical, biological, mathematical, engineering, or social and behavioral sciences, in service to the nation," according to the National Science Foundation's website.

Past recipients have been honored for advances ranging from cancer detection to protecting the food supply during droughts.
The Nvidia trades were one of hundreds the president made in August, according to the disclosure signed by the president on September 17 and made public on Thursday. 
"All investment decisions are made entirely by independent managers," Ingle said. "There are no conflicts of interest.”
Trump is also set to give the same award to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Google co-founder Sergey Brin on Thursday. 
Nvidia's spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
