New Delhi: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) on Thursday asked social media platforms to prioritise complaints from “authorised government agencies” about content with “potential implications for public order”. It also directed platforms to “label/contextualise manipulated, synthetically generated or misleading content”.

The advisory was first reported by MediaNama . ThePrint has seen a copy of the document.

Issued by MeitY’s Cyber Laws Division and signed by Joint Secretary Ajit Kumar, the advisory says “false, misleading, manipulated or out-of-context content” is being circulated “in relation to ongoing public events and developments”.

Show Full Article

The advisory does not name the events, but comes amid protests against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, led by Opposition parties, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and student organisations.

Platforms have been asked to give “particular attention” to “old/archived photographs and videos being presented as current events”, “digitally altered or synthetically generated audio-visual content”, “impersonation of public authorities/persons” and content “likely to incite violence or other unlawful activity”.

The advisory mirrors a Delhi Police post from 26 September, which said a video showing a protest at Jantar Mantar and shared by accounts including Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut was “archived material from a past event”.

Under paragraph 4, intermediaries have been asked to “identify, prevent and not promote” unlawful information, run awareness measures urging users to “verify the authenticity, source and date of information before sharing” and “ensure timely cooperation with law-enforcement”. The list moves from clause (iv) to clause (vi), with no clause (v).

MeitY has sought compliance “with immediate effect” while saying the advisory respects “lawful expression and legitimate public discourse”.

The labelling direction goes beyond the rules MeitY notified in February . The amended Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 limited such labelling to synthetically generated audio, visual or audio-visual content and did not cover text. Thursday’s advisory sets no such limit. It also does not define “authorised government agencies” or explain how “enhanced diligence” differs from the due diligence already required under the IT Rules.

The Centre has previously acted against the CJP online. Its X handle was withheld on 21 May and restored by the Delhi High Court on 7 July after Solicitor General Tushar Mehta said it had been blocked ahead of the 21 June NEET re-test.

Earlier advisories, issued after the Red Fort blast in November 2025 and on obscene content in December 2025, had reminded platforms of the legal consequences of non-compliance. Thursday’s advisory does not specify any such consequences.

Also Read: India steps up AI regulation push with consultation paper likely next month. Deepfakes, safety in focus

The SIR row
The protests over the CEC and SIR were launched after a report by The Indian Express on 23 September. The report said Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had formally objected at least 14 times over 10 months to decisions and orders of the Election Commission of India (ECI), saying they had been taken without their knowledge. The objections included changes to Form 6 for new voter registration and the centralisation of the electoral roll database.

The ECI responded that its SIR decisions were taken unanimously.

On 24 September, a day after the report, the CJP gave CEC Gyanesh Kumar 48 hours to resign. On 2 October, Delhi Police imposed prohibitory orders under BNSS Section 163 and shut at least 11 metro stations around Jantar Mantar after the AAP and student organisations gave a call for a protest. More than 500 people, including former Delhi chief minister Atishi, were detained. In Mumbai, Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders Uddhav Thackeray and Raj Thackeray led peaceful protests.

On 6 October, INDIA bloc MPs marched to the EC’s office. Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi led the protest and wrote on X, “Gyanesh, it’s done, bro. Time to resign.”

Gyanesh, it’s done, bro.

Time to resign. #IndiaAllianceMarch pic.twitter.com/9ZB6aJfakl

— Rahul Gandhi (@RahulGandhi) October 6, 2026

On Thursday, Opposition MPs reached Raj Ghat after being denied permission to protest at Jantar Mantar. They are scheduled to meet President Droupadi Murmu on Friday. The CJP has announced another protest in Delhi on 10 October.

The matter is also before the Supreme Court. On 5 October, the top court declined to suspend the CEC and issued notices to the Centre and the ECI. Senior advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for the petitioners, told the bench that interim orders were needed, “otherwise the country will burn”.

The ruling BJP, meanwhile, has said the names of 13 crore voters were not deleted but flagged in the draft roll as dead, absent, shifted or duplicate.

(Edited by Chingkheinganbi Mayengbam)

items.title: Genre-defying Canadian poet Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
items.author: Simon Johnson, Marie Mannes, Justyna Pawlak
items.creator: Simon Johnson, Marie Mannes, Justyna Pawlak
items.summary: Canadian poet and writer Anne Carson, whose work often blends verse, prose, dialogue and translation in a genre-defying mix, won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature on Thursday for what the Swedish Academy called her "bold and inventive oeuvre".
items.body:
Canadian poet and writer Anne Carson, whose work often blends verse, prose, dialogue and translation in a genre-defying mix, won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature on Thursday for what the Swedish Academy called her "bold and inventive oeuvre".
"Crazy, I think they're all crazy," Carson told Icelandic broadcaster RUV when asked how she was feeling after learning she had won while on the Arctic island. "I'll get a sticker on the front of my book."
Carson, 76, who was born in Toronto and has a home in Iceland, had been taken by surprise when called with the news, said Ingrid Carlberg, permanent secretary of the Academy, which awards the prize worth 12 million Swedish crowns ($1.2 million).
"All she had time to tell me was that she is for the moment in Iceland, where she's listening to the wind," Carlberg told a press conference in Stockholm after the announcement.
She is widely known for her translations of classical Greek literature, which heavily influences her work that ranges from opera libretti to literary criticism and verse novels such as "Autobiography of Red" from 1998.
"Genre is something for booksellers. It's something you do in order to appeal to an audience and make them buy books. And on what shelf do you put Anne Carson's books? It's on a shelf of her own," said Swedish novelist Steve Sem-Sandberg, who is a member of the award committee. "That's what I like about her."
'NEW FORMS OF CONTEMPORARY LITERATURE' In its citation, the Swedish Academy said it was recognising Carson "for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature".
"Almost all her literary production has centred upon the intersection between the philologist's obsession with words and the poet's desire for new meaning," the Academy said.
"She has herself identified the etymology of words as the starting point for all her work. Her translations from Classical Greek may be regarded as independent works in their own right."
Her style is exemplified in "Norma Jeane Baker of Troy" from 2019, a performance piece which mixes the stories of Helen of Troy in Euripides' play "Helen" with Marilyn Monroe.
LIFE WITHOUT PROUST Often heralded as her greatest work, "Autobiography of Red" demonstrates Carson's ability to "actualise the classical literary tradition", the Academy said. In the book, she re-examines age-old questions such as "What happens when you love someone who will ultimately destroy you?"
Tapping into more modern inspirations, Carson reflected on the character of Albertine, one of the narrator Marcel's love interests in Marcel Proust's "In Search of Lost Time", in her own book "The Albertine Workout".
Carson had spent seven years reading Proust's masterpiece and said in an interview with Canada's CBC Radio One in 2016 that she suffered withdrawal symptoms after finishing, leading her to write "The Albertine Workout" as a way to prolong the experience.
"You think life goes on after Proust, but it seems so grey," she said.
BOXING LESSONS TO FIGHT PARKINSON'S Carson started taking boxing lessons when she was already in her 70s because of a Parkinson's disease diagnosis. The sport is recommended as a therapy because it helps with paying attention to hand-eye coordination and the sequencing of actions.
She reflected on the disease's impact on her handwriting in an interview at the Louisiana Literary Festival in Denmark in 2024: "I scrub out whole paragraphs in shame ... the shame of bad handwriting."
Carson, who has taught classics at universities in Canada and the United States, has said that she considers herself a visual artist as much as a literary one.
"I think of making a poem as making an object. I have always thought of them more as drawings than as texts, but drawings that are also physically enterable through the fact of language," she said in the CBC interview.
Poetry, she says, may be more attuned to the fast modern-day life than long-form writing.
"I think it's probably more useful than prose right now because it's faster and everybody is in a hurry so basically it's good because it is brief," she told the Icelandic broadcaster on Thursday.
When asked by the Nobel Committee about her own sources of inspiration, however, she listed ancient Greek poet Homer, author of "The Odyssey" epic.
As to how the classical stories she has reinterpreted in her work might be relevant to modern audiences, she said: "I don't think I'm interested in relevance."
'AT HOME' IN ICELAND AND NYC Carson and her husband, artist Robert Currie, first came to Iceland after the 2008 banking collapse and gradually spent more time there. "We got to know people and we liked the people," Carson told Iceland Review in 2023.
She has held citizenship of Iceland since 2022.
Currie told the magazine Iceland was one of only two places that immediately felt like home to him, the other being New York City in the 1970s.
Literature was the fourth of this year's Nobels to be announced this week, following [USN:L1N45R0AK TEXT:"medicine"], [USN:L1N45S0E6 TEXT:"physics"] and [USN:L1N45T09K TEXT:"chemistry"]. The peace prize winner will be announced in Oslo on Friday.
Established in the will of Swedish dynamite inventor and businessman Alfred Nobel, the prizes have been awarded since 1901.
Carson, who had been among the favourites this year, takes a place beside luminaries such as Alexander Solzhenitsyn, Alice Munro and Ernest Hemingway as a recipient of the award. Last year's prize was won by Hungarian writer [USN:L2N3VQ0DK TEXT:"Laszlo Krasznahorkai"].
($1 = 10.0190 Swedish crowns)

Oct 8 : Alphabet's Google Cloud on Thursday introduced the Gemini agent, a single AI agent for work that can answer questions, handle tasks, create content and write code.
The move comes as tech companies race to sell AI that can work autonomously.
The announcement comes after OpenAI's September launch of always-on agents called dots that chase user goals across apps on their own. Earlier last month, Meta released Muse, a personal AI agent that can shop, book travel, send emails and make payments for users.
Alphabet shares were up marginally in early trading.

Here are more details:
• The Gemini agent plans the work, uses tools, connects to a company's business systems and returns finished work in documents, email and developer environments, Google said.
• The agent works directly inside Google Workspace apps including Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar, and can also be used through Microsoft 365 and Slack.
• It picks the best model for each task, currently running on Google's Gemini models and Anthropic's Claude models, with other models to be added later.
• Users can create "coworker agents" that act as team members, with their own email address and access only to the information they are given.
• Versions built for financial services and legal work are now in preview, and versions for government, healthcare and retail are coming soon.

items.title: Monedas cotizan mixtas en medio datos locales, peso México se hunde tras minutas Banxico
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: Las principales monedas de América Latina cotizaron dispares el jueves, tras datos de inflación locales, en una jornada en que el peso mexicano cayó con fuerza tras la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de Banco de México.
items.body:
Las principales monedas de América Latina cotizaron dispares el jueves, tras datos de inflación locales, en una jornada en que el peso mexicano cayó con fuerza tras la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de Banco de México.
* Las monedas de la región ya sentían cierta presión más temprano por una fuerte alza de los precios del petróleo, con el contrato Brent escalando más de 4 dólares y superando los 104 dólares el barril.
* Eso respaldó al dólar en un principio, pero el billete verde retrocedió después de cotizar cerca de máximos de 18 meses, ante un descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos europeos.
* El peso mexicano bajaba por la tarde un 1,26%, a 18,202 por dólar; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, 0,49%, a 64.968,4 puntos, recuperándose en parte de la fuerte caía de la sesión previa.
* Tres de los cinco miembros de la Junta de Gobierno del Banco de México señalaron que podrían considerarse futuros recortes de las tasas de interés si mejoran las perspectivas de inflación, revelaron las actas del encuentro de septiembre del banco central.
* Eso contrasta con las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal podría aumentar el costo del crédito en su reunión de diciembre, haciendo más atractivo el invertir en activos estadounidenses.
* Además, la [USN:L1N45U0FT TEXT:"inflación general"] de México se aceleró en septiembre, aunque menos de lo previsto, mientras que el índice subyacente continuó moderándose, afianzando las expectativas de que el banco central mantendría sin cambios la tasa clave de interés durante algún tiempo.
* El real brasileño revirtió leves alzas previas y retrocedió un 0,17%, a 5,0240 unidades por dólar, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) escaló un 1,03%, a 206.402 puntos, respaldada por el avance de los papeles de Petrobras ante la escalada de los precios del crudo.
* Los mercados brasileños aguardaban la primera encuesta electoral de Datafolha con miras al balotaje de finales de mes entre el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro y el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
* El peso chileno , cedió leves ganancias de primera hora y cerró la sesión con una caída del 0,1%, en 979,20/979,50 unidades por dólar, presionado por un importante retroceso en los precios del cobre, el mayor envío del país. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) subió un 0,22%, a 11.024,22 puntos.
* El cobre registró una fuerte caída el jueves cediendo las ganancias iniciales impulsadas por el regreso al mercado de China, el principal consumidor, ya que la subida vertiginosa de los precios del petróleo lastró las perspectivas de demanda de los metales industriales.
* Mientras, los precios al consumidor en Chile subieron un 0,4% en septiembre, informó el Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas (INE), lo que estuvo ligeramente por debajo de una encuesta de Reuters a economistas que apuntaba a un aumento del 0,5%. En 12 meses la inflación [USN:L1N4500CR TEXT:"se mantuvo"] en 4,1%, por encima del rango de tolerancia del Banco Central de entre 2 y 4%.
* El peso colombiano finalizó con ganancia de un 0,67% a 3.217,20 unidades por dólar, en su segunda sesión de apreciación.
* En tanto, el índice accionario de la bolsa, el COLCAP (.COLCAP) , perdió un 0,37% a 2.525,90 puntos, después de que el Gobierno reportó que la inflación mantuvo su tendencia alcista en septiembre, lo que podría impulsar nuevos aumentos de la tasa de interés del Banco Central, favoreciendo la entrada de capitales externos hacia los mercados o "carry trade".
* El peso argentino interbancario ganó un leve 0,07% a 1.517 por dólar , lejos de las bandas de intervención del banco central (BCRA), que mantuvo sus compras diarias para reforzar las reservas internacionales. La adquisición oficial del día sumó 43 millones de dólares.
* El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, ganó un 0,3% después de ceder gran parte de sus avences que lo llevaron a escalar más de un 1% en la sesión.
* "Argentina cotiza el riesgo de recesión mientras el Merval defiende su soporte", sintetizó Ion Jauregui, analista de ActivTrades.
* Los mercados peruanos permanecieron cerrados por un feriado local.

items.author: ロイター

items.body:
[ワシントン　８日　ロイター] - 米商務省が８日発表した８月の卸売在庫は前月比０．５％増となった。堅調な需要が販売を押し上げ、前月発表された速報値（０．７％増）を下回る伸びとなった。  

７月は１．４％増だった。

８月は前年同月比では６．４％増加した。

企業は、主に個人消費と人工知能（ＡＩ）向け投資による旺盛な内需を背景に５四半期連続で取り崩されてきた在庫を積み増している。その結果、輸入が急増しており、８月の資本財の輸入は過去最高を記録。第３・四半期の設備投資が引き続き堅調だった可能性を示唆した。

８月の耐久財在庫は前月比０．８％増加したものの、非耐久財在庫は横ばいとなり、石油在庫は３．９％減少した。

卸売売上高は１．８％増加。７月は１．０％増だった。

８月の販売ペースで在庫が全てはけるのに必要な期間は１．１８カ月と、７月の１．１９カ月から短縮した。前年同月は１．２８カ月だった。

[８日 ロイター] - 米コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックス（スタバ）は８日、メキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルの買収を模索しているとの報道についてコメントを控え、ブライアン・ニコル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の下での経営立て直しに「全力で集中している」と表明した。

英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）はこれに先立ち、関係者の話として、スタバがここ数カ月、チポトレ買収の可能性についてアドバイザーと協議を進めてきたと報じた。ニコル氏は２０２４年にスタバのトップに就任するまで、約６年間チポトレを率いていた。買収が実現すれば、米外食業界を代表する２ブランドの統合となり、ニコル氏がチポトレに再び関与することになる。

スタバの広報担当者は報道を受け、うわさや臆測にはコメントしないと述べた。ニコル氏の下で２年間にわたり進めている経営立て直しに引き続き注力しており、力強い勢いを維持し、長期的な成長の可能性に自信を持っているとした。

チポトレはロイターのコメント要請に応じなかった。

時価総額が約１０７０億ドルのスタバの株価は８日、下げ幅を縮小し、ほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。一方、チポトレ株は６％上昇し、時価総額は約４１０億ドルとなった。

ニコル氏はチポトレ在籍中、食品安全問題を巡る危機の余波を乗り切り、デジタル事業を拡大した手腕を評価された。こうした取り組みは、数年にわたる力強い売上高の伸びにつながった。

ＲＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツのアナリスト、ローガン・ライヒ氏は「チポトレにとっては、主にニコル氏が同ブランドに戻るという点から、好意的に受け止められると考える」と述べた。

その上で、外食企業が成長を促すために他のブランドを買収することに投資家は懐疑的だと指摘。スタバによるチポトレ買収の戦略的な合理性は不明確だと語った。

＜買収に多額の費用負担も＞

アナリストらは、スタバがなお経営立て直しに多額の投資を続けていることから、買収には大きな費用負担が伴う可能性が高いと指摘した。

イートロのグローバル市場ストラテジスト、ラレ・アコナー氏は「買収には多額の借り入れや新株発行が必要になる可能性がある。財務面で説得力のある根拠がなければ、投資家は本業への集中をそぐ高くつく買収と受け止めるかもしれない」と述べた。

アネックス・ウェルス・マネジメントのチーフ経済ストラテジスト、ブライアン・ジェイコブセン氏も「スタバは改革の途上にあり、投資家が期待しているであろう利益率の改善もまだ示していないことを考えると、買収のタイミングにはやや違和感がある。第一印象では、改革を加速するというより、奇策に走って道を誤るように見える」と述べた。

一方、チポトレは消費者が裁量的な支出を控える中、客足の鈍化に直面している。食品価格や人件費の上昇も外食業界全体の利益率を圧迫している。同社の株価はニコル氏の退任以降、ほぼ半値となった。

ただ、一部のアナリストは、買収が実現すればチポトレの海外展開が加速する可能性があると指摘する。ノースコースト・リサーチのアナリスト、ジム・サンダーソン氏は「この買収の可能性について評価しているのは、ニコルＣＥＯがスタバの欧州でのライセンス提携を活用し、チポトレをより積極的に展開する機会を得られることだ」と述べた。

items.title: 米、外国人技術者の永住権手続き凍結　マイクロソフトなど対象
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - 米トランプ政権は８日、マイクロソフトやアドビなどによる高度な技能を持つ外国人労働者の永住権申請手続きの一部を凍結した。また、交流訪問者ビザの利用を巡り、米国内の９大学に対する調査を開始した。外国人労働者や留学生向けビザ（査証）の取り締まりを一段と強化した格好だ。

バンス副大統領は「残念ながら、米国においてマイクロソフトほどこの制度を悪用してきた企業は他にない」と批判。その上で「あなた方は素晴らしい米企業だが、優れた米国人労働者を雇用しなければならないというのが、マイクロソフトに対するわれわれのメッセージだ」と述べた。

バンス副大統領によると、マイクロソフトは昨年、米国人従業員６０００人を解雇する一方、高度な技能を持つ外国人技術者向け就労ビザ「Ｈ─１Ｂ」６３００件と永住権約３０００件の承認を受けたという。

これに対し、マイクロソフトは声明で、前会計年度に申請したＨ─１Ｂビザの約８０％は新規採用ではなく、現従業員の資格延長または変更を目的としたものだったと説明した。

ソンダーリング労働長官は、凍結措置がマイクロソフトとアドビのほか、コグニザント、インフォシス、タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）、ウィプロ、ＨＣＬテクノロジーズ、キャップジェミニにも適用されると説明。永住権申請に必要な労働認定手続き（ＰＥＲＭ）について、「新規申請の受理も保留中の申請の処理も行われない」と述べた。

労働省のデータを集計するPermtrack.appによると、マイクロソフトは企業別のＰＥＲＭ申請件数で最多となっている。

バンス副大統領はまた、今回の凍結措置は「必要な限り継続される」と述べた上で、一部企業は効果のない求人広告を掲載し、その後、応募者の不足を理由に、賃金の低い外国人労働者を雇用しているとも非難した。

マイクロソフトは声明で、Ｈ─１Ｂビザ保有者の給与について、同等の業務に従事する他の従業員と同水準と説明した。

移民取り締まり強化を看板政策に掲げるトランプ大統領は昨年９月、Ｈ─１Ｂの取得に際し、雇用主に年１０万ドルの手数料を課す大統領令に署名した。

今回の措置は、現在のＨ─１Ｂビザ保有者に直接的な影響を与えないもようだが、雇用主がこれらの労働者の永住権取得を支援する一般的な経路を遮断する可能性がある。

米市民権・移民局（ＵＳＣＩＳ）のデータによると、２０２６会計年度に承認されたＨ─１Ｂビザ保有者を最も多く雇用しているのはアマゾン・ドット・コムで、ＴＣＳ、インフォシス、アップル、マイクロソフトが続く。

マホーニー・アセット・マネジメントのケン・マホーニー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は今回の政権の措置について、「現時点でハイテク大手への直接的な財務的影響は限定的である可能性があるが、イノベーションや競争力に対する長期的な影響ははるかに重大なものとなる恐れがある」との見方を示した。

バンス副大統領はまた、ハーバード大、イェール大、スタンフォード大、マサチューセッツ工科大（ＭＩＴ）、ブラウン大を含む９大学について、交流訪問者ビザを利用して外国人研究者や学生を受け入れ、米国人労働者の賃金引き下げを招いていると非難し、調査を実施すると発表した。

デスポジート労働省監察総監によると、対象大学にはすでに召喚状が送付されており、「外国からの影響力や不適切な金銭的関係、あるいはビザの悪用が、連邦政府の資金による研究を損なっていないかどうかを調査する」と述べた。

items.title: Wall Street cae por el alza del crudo y la baja de las empresas de chips
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: Wall Street cerró en baja el jueves, en una jornada de alza de los precios del petróleo por el recrudecimiento de la tensión en Oriente Medio, a lo que se sumó un recorte de la producción estadounidense que avivó el temor a la inflación y una subida de las tasas de interés.
items.body:
Wall Street cerró en baja el jueves, en una jornada de alza de los precios del petróleo por el recrudecimiento de la tensión en Oriente Medio, a lo que se sumó un recorte de la producción estadounidense que avivó el temor a la inflación y una subida de las tasas de interés.
Las acciones del sector de los semiconductores se desplomaron. Los tres principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses perdieron terreno, y el Nasdaq, de gran peso tecnológico, fue el que más cayó.
Los fabricantes de chips (.SOX) , que se han disparado más de un 80% en lo que va de año, fueron claramente los que peor se desempeñaron, con una caída del 3,0%.
A los inversionistas les preocupa que la subida de las tasas pueda convertirse en un obstáculo para la rápida expansión de la inteligencia artificial, que se ha apoyado en gran medida en la deuda para su financiación.
"El mercado se encuentra en un estado de nerviosismo debido a los altos precios del petróleo, mientras se prepara para la temporada de resultados, que básicamente comienza la semana que viene", dijo Peter Cardillo, economista jefe de mercado de Spartan Capital Securities. "Esa es la excusa para lo que, en mi opinión, es una toma de ganancias".
El petróleo se disparó por la preocupación por la oferta tras una serie de ataques a buques en el estrecho de Ormuz, a lo que se sumó un recorte de la producción estadounidense debido a la actividad de los huracanes.
La escasez mundial de petróleo durante la guerra de Irán ha provocado que el crudo estadounidense se haya disparado más de un 60% en el año, lo que ha avivado las presiones inflacionarias.
Durante la sesión del jueves, los rendimientos de referencia de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron ligeramente, situándose cerca de máximos de varios años, mientras que los de la deuda a dos años, que suelen reflejar las expectativas sobre las tasas de la Fed, tuvieron un alza más marcada.
El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 34,69 puntos, o un 0,07%, a 51.145,18 unidades, mientras que el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 47,95 puntos, o un 0,61%, a 7.753,82. El Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) retrocedió 378,50 puntos, o un 1,37%, a 27.160,19.
Entre los 11 sectores principales del S&P 500, los valores energéticos (.SPNY) lideraron las subidas porcentuales, mientras que el sector tecnológico (.SPLRCT) , lastrado por los chips, sufrió la mayor caída.

items.title: Trump administration freezes green cards for Microsoft, IT firms, probes universities
items.author: Akash Sriram, Steve Holland
items.creator: Akash Sriram, Steve Holland
items.summary: The US suspended Microsoft , major IT outsourcers and software maker Adobe from a key green-card program on Thursday while opening probes into nine top universities, widening a crackdown it says targets fraud and protects American jobs.
items.body:
The US suspended Microsoft (MSFT.O) , major IT outsourcers and software maker Adobe (ADBE.O) from a key green-card program on Thursday while opening probes into nine top universities, widening a crackdown it says targets fraud and protects American jobs.
Since taking office, US President Donald Trump has pursued a broad effort to reduce the number of foreign-born people in the US and curtail their pathway to residence and citizenship. Thursday's twin actions mark the broadest strike yet against skilled-worker immigration programs — potentially cutting off a common path to permanent residency for foreign tech workers — while putting some of the country's top research universities on notice.
"There has been no company in the United States, unfortunately, that has abused the system more than Microsoft," Vice President JD Vance said. He said the company laid off 6,000 American workers last year while benefiting from 6,300 H-1B temporary worker visas and nearly 3,000 green cards.
His comments came hours before Trump honored tech billionaires for their contributions to America, including Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella. Nadella once held an H-1B visa, as did Elon Musk, who was also honored, while three of the other CEOs honored are immigrants.
Nadella thanked Trump for the medal, saying in a post on X he would continue to advance technology and drive American prosperity.
Microsoft is the largest filer of PERM applications, or the [USN:L4N45U1DA TEXT:"permanent labor certification"] process, according to data from the US labor department. Under PERM, which most employment-based green cards require, employers must show a foreign hire will not hurt US workers' wages or jobs.
The company said in a statement that about 80% of the H-1B applications it filed in the last fiscal year were to extend or change the status of current employees, not to hire new workers. In July, the company said it would [USN:L4N4380XC TEXT:"cut 4,800 jobs"], or about 2.1% of its global workforce.
CRACKDOWN WIDENS Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said the suspension would also cover Cognizant (CTSH.O) , Infosys (INFY.NS) , Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) , Wipro (WIPR.NS) , HCL Technologies (HCLT.NS) and Capgemini (CAPP.PA) . "We will not accept any new or process any pending permanent labor certification applications involving these companies," Sonderling said.
He said these companies had since 2009 sought almost three million foreign workers, and had received over 230,000 H-1B visa approvals and over 100,000 permanent labor certifications.
Amazon.com was the largest employer of approved H-1B beneficiaries in fiscal 2026, followed by Tata Consultancy Services, Infosys, Apple and Microsoft, according to US immigration data.
Vance said the suspensions would last "as long as it needs to," and that the administration wanted the companies to change how they hire. He said some companies post ineffective job ads, then point to the lack of applicants to justify hiring lower-paid foreign workers.
Microsoft said in its statement that it pays its H-1B employees the same as any other employees doing comparable work.
Adobe, Cognizant, Infosys, HCL Technologies, Wipro and Capgemini did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Tata Consultancy Services declined to comment.
Nasscom, India's IT industry body, said Indian tech companies in the US had significantly reduced their reliance on H-1B visas, and relatively few of their workers sought green cards through the PERM process.
In September last year, the Labor Department launched an enforcement drive called "Project Firewall" as a White House proclamation imposed a one-time $100,000 fee on new H-1B petitions for workers hired from abroad.
UNIVERSITIES UNDER SCRUTINY Vance also said nine universities, including Harvard, Yale and Stanford, would be investigated for what the administration called the misuse of exchange-visitor visas to undercut American wages.
The nine schools also include Brown and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Labor Inspector General Anthony D'Esposito said subpoenas had already been served.
D'Esposito said investigators would examine whether foreign influence, improper financial relationships or visa abuse were compromising federally funded research.
“It could have an enormous economic impact on the whole US economy,” said Sarah Spreitzer, a vice president at the American Council on Education, which represents college and university presidents. International students historically spent $40 billion a year while in the US, she said.
The probe deepens the administration's [USN:L1N45M14M TEXT:"long-running fight"] with Harvard over foreign students. Last year, the Department of Homeland Security subpoenaed the university over alleged misconduct by international students and its compliance with immigration law. Harvard called that subpoena "unfounded retribution" but said it would comply as far as the law requires.
Rapidly changing visa policies caused a sharp drop in international applications to Columbia University and contributed to the university pausing admissions to one of its journalism programs, Reuters reported last week.

FAST

MADRID, Oct 8 : Spain's minority leftist government plans tighter oversight of future data centres ahead of an early parliamentary election set for November 29, Digital Transformation Minister Oscar Lopez said on Thursday.
Spain is trying to balance data-centre investment from companies such as Amazon Web Services and Microsoft, mainly focussed in the northeastern region of Aragon, against concerns over the industry's consumption of energy and water and has drafted tougher water and electricity rules.
Lopez said a decree regulating the fast-growing sector would not require parliamentary approval.
"The government's intention is to move forward with that decree," Lopez told a conference on artificial intelligence, adding that ministries were still reviewing submissions from a public consultation and working on a common position.
Amazon's AWS and Microsoft have said their plans in Aragon remain unaltered but both urged Spain to protect long-term investment by promoting legal certainty and predictability.

MANILA, Oct 8 : Asian countries are racing to raise their oil stockpiling capacity, complete a regional power grid and speed up renewables in response to supply risks laid bare by the Iran war.
Southeast Asia has been worst hit by the energy impact as 80 per cent of the oil transported through the Strait of Hormuz from the Gulf flowed to the region before the Iran war began.
"The most advanced efforts are support for the development of oil stockpiling systems in each country and regional joint stockpiling on (a) voluntary basis," nine Southeast Asian nations said in a joint statement issued along with Japan and Australia. 
Japan agreed on action plans with its Asian partners to boost crude oil reserves across the region following a meeting of the Japan-led Asia Zero Emission Community (AZEC), a Japanese state minister on trade said on Thursday.

After a separate session with Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, Japan's State Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Takagi Kei said they had expressed a willingness to cooperate to strengthen Asia's oil stockpiling capacity.
Philippines, which imports nearly all of its oil and fuel, will create a national reserve by the end of 2027, its energy secretary, Sharon Garin said on Thursday, adding that it could subsequently be converted into a regional stockpile.
The Southeast Asian archipelago is the chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) this year.
Garin said countries will decide if they want to host a regional oil stockpile, and also the terms of sale that should be determined by the country itself. 
"In the Philippines, what we want is if there's any country that wants to store the crude or their petroleum products here. In case of any emergency the country gets priority on this on the stocks," she said.
The ASEAN member countries also pledged to increase the share of clean energy in power generation, targeting 30 per cent renewables in total primary energy supply and 45 per cent in installed power capacity.
The region is among the biggest laggards in green energy.
Renewables make up 14.1 per cent of primary energy, well short of a 2025 target of 25 per cent, while green power has made up 33.7 per cent of total capacity since 2020 against a 2025 target of 35 per cent, the ninth ASEAN energy outlook showed this week.
The countries also reached an enhanced preliminary agreement on developing a long-delayed regional power grid, which Garin called a landmark accomplishment. The concept of a regional electricity network was first announced in December 1997.  
"The first study was to connect with 2045, and that's too far because that's 20 years. So they're reviewing again to make it a faster implementation," Garin said.

(Writing and additional reporting by Sudarshan Varadhan and Karen Lema; Editing by Alexander Smith)

items.body:
[ベルリン　８日　ロイター] - ドイツの経済誌ビルトシャフツボッヘは８日、イランの情報機関がドイツ国内の米軍施設、特にラムシュタイン空軍基地とシュパングダーレム空軍基地を標的にしている可能性があると報じた。

同誌は複数の西側情報当局者の話として、イスラエルが３週間前に米国とドイツの関係当局に対し潜在的な脅威について警告したと報じた。イランとの戦闘に関連する米軍の作戦や兵站（ロジスティクス）を支援する基地が懸念の中心になっているという。

この件について、在独イラン大使館とイスラエル大使館からコメントは得られていない。独国防省はコメントを控えている。

米欧州軍（ＥＵＣＯＭ）報道官は「インテリジェンス（情報収集・分析）活動に関する事項について議論するのは適切ではない。特定の脅威情報や部隊防護措置についてコメントしない」とした上で、「米欧州軍は警戒を維持し、欧州地域全体の安全保障環境を継続的に検証している」と述べた。

関係筋はロイターに対し、ドイツ当局はここ数週間、イランの活動活発化を監視していると明らかにしている。

米国は今月初め、イランに関連する脅威を受け、 英南部フェアフォード空軍基地からＢ１戦略爆撃機１２機全てを撤収。米軍は同基地のＢ１爆撃機をイランに対する攻撃に投入していた。

items.title: Starbucks declines comment on Chipotle takeover report, says laser focused on turnaround
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Starbucks on Thursday declined to comment on a report that it had explored a takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill , saying it was "laser focused" on its turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.
items.body:
Starbucks (SBUX.O) on Thursday declined to comment on a report that it had explored a takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG.N) , saying it was "laser focused" on its turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.
The Financial Times reported earlier that Starbucks had worked with advisers in recent months on a potential takeover of Chipotle, citing people familiar with the matter. Niccol ran Chipotle for about six years before taking the top job at Starbucks in 2024.
Responding to the report, a Starbucks spokesperson said the company does not comment on rumors and speculation, adding that Starbucks remained focused on its two-year turnaround under Niccol and had strong momentum and confidence in its long-term growth potential.
Chipotle did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Starbucks, valued at about $107 billion, pared losses to close nearly flat on Thursday, while Chipotle shares jumped 6%, giving the burrito chain a market value of about $41 billion.
At Chipotle, Niccol was credited with steering the company through the aftermath of its food-safety crises and expanding its digital business, helping drive years of strong sales growth.
"For Chipotle, we think this would be viewed positively, primarily driven by Brian Niccol returning to the brand," RBC Capital Markets analyst Logan Reich said.
Still, Reich said investors have been sceptical of restaurant companies buying additional brands to drive growth, adding that the strategic rationale for Starbucks acquiring Chipotle was unclear.
POTENTIAL TAKEOVER COULD PROVE COSTLY A takeover could also prove costly for Starbucks as it invests heavily in its turnaround, analysts said.
"A deal could require heavy borrowing or issuing shares," said Lale Akoner, global market strategist at eToro. "Without a compelling financial case, investors may view the deal as an expensive distraction."
Over the past two years, Niccol has prioritized customer satisfaction through investments in staffing and store improvements aimed at reducing wait times and restoring the coffeehouse atmosphere that helped make the chain a global brand.
The company has committed at least $500 million to labor investments as part of its overhaul, putting pressure on profitability. Starbucks has posted four consecutive quarters of comparable sales growth under Niccol, though he said [USN:L6N43V1FM TEXT:"in July"] that "we have more work to do."
"The timing of this would be a little weird, given that Starbucks is in the middle of its transformation and hasn't yet shown the margin improvement investors are probably hoping for," said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management.
Starbucks' adjusted operating margin was 14.4% in the fiscal third quarter, down from 16.7% two years earlier, according to LSEG data.
The company also said on Thursday that it looked forward to reporting fourth-quarter results and providing its outlook for the next fiscal year later this month.
DEAL COULD BOOST CHIPOTLE'S INTERNATIONAL EXPANSION A deal could, however, help accelerate Chipotle's international expansion, analysts said.
"What I like about this potential is the opportunity CEO Brian Niccol would have to leverage Starbucks' licensed partnerships in Europe to expand Chipotle more aggressively," Northcoast Research analyst Jim Sanderson said.
International expansion has been a focus for Chipotle CEO Scott Boatwright, who succeeded Niccol. The company opened its first restaurants in Mexico and Saudi Arabia this year, adding to roughly 100 locations outside the United States.
Chipotle also announced a joint venture last year with South Korean food company SPC Group to expand in Asia.
Starbucks has roughly 40,000 stores worldwide. In the United States, Chipotle had 3,938 restaurants as of last year, while Starbucks has about 18,000 stores in North America, according to the companies' annual reports.

items.title: 米国務長官、ウクライナ戦争は危険な膠着状態　見解に同意とロ報道官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jonathan Landay

[リスボン ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jonathan Landay

[リスボン ８日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は８日、ロシアとウクライナの戦争が危険な膠着状態に陥っており、米国は紛争終結に向けた取り組みを継続する考えを表明した。

ポルトガル訪問中のルビオ長官は記者団に対し、ウクライナでの戦争が「恒久的かつ持続可能で、公正な形で交渉を通じて解決されることを強く望んでいる。われわれは今後もその実現に向けて尽力していく」と述べた。

これを受け、ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は同日、ルビオ長官が述べた戦争が膠着状態に陥っているとの見解にロシアは同意すると言及。ロシアの通信社によると、ペスコフ氏はトルクメニスタンで開催されている旧ソ連諸国首脳会議の傍らで記者団に対し、「ルビオ氏の見解に同意する」とした上で、和平に向けた道筋を見いだすのは外交官の役割だと述べた。

ロシアとウクライナによる相互のドローン攻撃は、幅広い経済分野に広がりつつあり、エネルギー施設や製油所、石油・穀物を輸送する船舶、電子商取引（ＥＣ）倉庫、データセンターなど、幅広い標的が攻撃対象となっている。

ルビオ長官は事態の悪化について、「このエスカレーションは北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国の近隣地域における破壊工作に発展する可能性がある」ほか、「二国間戦争国が、より広範で危険な地域紛争へと急速に拡大する可能性もある」と警告。その上で、「この戦争は交渉による解決で終結する必要がある。早ければ早いほど良い。米国はそのための支援を行う用意がある」と強調した。

トランプ米政権はここ数週間、紛争終結に向けた和平協議の再開を模索しており、ウクライナの交渉担当者が９日と１０日に協議のため訪米する見通し。

items.summary: [フランクフルト　８日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるフィリップ・レーン専務理事は...
items.body:
ユーロ圏の財政政策、今後数年は成長の重しに＝ＥＣＢレーン専務理事
10/8 23:10 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ECB）本部の看板。2018年4月、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[フランクフルト　８日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるフィリップ・レーン専務理事は８日、ユーロ圏各国では今後数年間は財政政策が成長の重しになる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。 

レーン氏はフランスの銀行大手ソシエテ・ジェネラル主催の会合で、今年のユーロ圏経済は予想以上に好調だったものの、財政政策による下支え効果は弱まっていると指摘。ＥＣＢは２０２７年と２８年に財政引き締めが行われると予想していると述べた。

インフレ見通しについては、来年は食品価格に上昇圧力がかかるとの見方を示す一方、インフレ率は目標の２％に回帰するとのＥＣＢの見解を信頼すべきだと述べた。

また、ユーロ圏経済は人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資によって後押しされているものの、その効果は米国に比べはるかに小さいと指摘。ＡＩ投資について「欧州経済を押し上げてはいるが、米国や、ある程度は中国で見られるような、成長を圧倒的にけん引する最大の要因にはなっていない」との見方を示した。

items.title: Maduro y Cilia Flores son acusados en EEUU por presuntos actos de tortura en Venezuela
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El expresidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro y su esposa, Cilia Flores, fueron acusados el jueves de un nuevo delito en Estados Unidos, derivado de los cargos de que torturaron a opositores y ciudadanos estadounidense para mantener al país bajo su control.
items.body:
El expresidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro y su esposa, Cilia Flores, fueron acusados el jueves de un nuevo delito en Estados Unidos, derivado de los cargos de que torturaron a opositores y ciudadanos estadounidense para mantener al país bajo su control.
Maduro y Flores fueron acusados de conspiración para cometer tortura, lo que se suma a los cargos de tráfico de drogas a los que ya se enfrentaban, según una querella sustitutiva presentada ante el tribunal federal de Manhattan.
De ser declarados culpables, Maduro y Flores se enfrentarían a una pena mínima obligatoria de 50 años de prisión.
Flores, de 69 años, y Maduro, de 63, fueron detenidos por el ejército estadounidense el 3 de enero en Caracas y trasladados a Nueva York para responder a los cargos de narcotráfico.
La redada sorpresa puso fin a los 13 años de mandato de Maduro en Venezuela, que desde entonces ha intensificado la cooperación con Estados Unidos bajo el liderazgo de la exvicepresidenta de Maduro, Delcy Rodríguez.
Maduro y Flores se declararon inocentes de los cargos de tráfico de drogas y permanecen recluidos en el Centro de Detención Metropolitano de Brooklyn desde su captura. Su juicio está previsto para el 1 de junio de 2027.
Los fiscales afirmaron que Maduro ordenó en 2013 el arresto de un oficial militar venezolano al que sospechaba de planear un golpe de Estado.
Según los fiscales, miembros de la dirección de contrainteligencia militar de Venezuela interrogaron al oficial mientras le aplicaban descargas eléctricas con un cable con corriente unas 20 veces y lo colgaban de las manos y los pies durante varios minutos seguidos.
En 2022, un ciudadano estadounidense detenido al entrar en Venezuela fue acusado de conspirar para asesinar a Maduro y fue torturado por oficiales de contrainteligencia militar mediante palizas y descargas eléctricas en los brazos, las piernas y los genitales, según la acusación.
Desde su captura y arresto, el Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos "ha estado trabajando para descubrir el alcance de sus presuntos crímenes contra el pueblo de Venezuela y de Estados Unidos", dijo el fiscal general Todd Blanche en una publicación en redes sociales.
Los abogados de Maduro no respondieron de inmediato a la solicitud de comentarios.
Durante la audiencia judicial del jueves sobre la solicitud de Flores para ser puesta en libertad, su abogado, Mark Donnelly, dijo que no había tenido tiempo de repasar los nuevos cargos con su clienta. No se le pidió a Flores que se declarara culpable o inocente.
NIEGAN A FLORES LIBERTAD BAJO FIANZA Los abogados de Flores argumentaron que su clienta necesita un procedimiento cardíaco y desea recuperarse en un entorno más cómodo. Propusieron trasladarla a una residencia en el área de la ciudad de Nueva York con seguridad privada las 24 horas y afirmaron que no representa un peligro para la comunidad.
Al denegar la solicitud de libertad bajo fianza, Hellerstein consideró que las pruebas contra Flores parecían contundentes. El juez también señaló que Flores, quien vestía una camiseta oscura de prisión y auriculares para escuchar la traducción simultánea al español del proceso, parecía gozar de buena salud.
"Para lo que valga, su aspecto hoy no es peor, y quizás sea un poco mejor, que cuando me reuní con ella por primera vez en su comparecencia ante el juez", dijo Hellerstein, refiriéndose a su primera comparecencia ante el tribunal el 5 de enero.
"Todavía tenía vendajes de la invasión militar", señaló por su parte Donnelly.
Los fiscales de la Fiscalía Federal de Manhattan se opusieron a la liberación de Flores. Argumentaron que ha recibido atención médica adecuada en el centro de detención y que, de ser liberada, representa un riesgo "extremo" de fuga y un peligro para el público, incluyendo la posible intimidación de testigos.
La negativa por parte de Hellerstein no afectará al juicio de Flores ni a su posible condena.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　８日　ロイター] - 米労働省が８日発表した１０月３日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週...
items.body:
米新規失業保険申請19.7万件、4週連続57年ぶり低水準付近
10/8 22:41 配信

米マサチューセッツ州メドフォードにあるレストランの求人看板。2023年1撮影。REUTERS/Brian Snyder

[ワシントン　８日　ロイター] - 米労働省が８日発表した１０月３日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比２０００件減の１９万７０００件となった。９月の雇用の伸びが大幅に鈍化したにもかかわらず、労働市場の安定が続いていることを示唆した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

申請件数は４週間連続で５７年ぶり低水準付近にとどまっており、エコノミストらが指摘する「低採用・低解雇」の労働市場の状況と一致している。ただ、企業は好調な利益成長と株式市場のパフォーマンスを背景に人員を確保する姿勢を見せる一方、新規採用には依然として慎重で、職を失った人が新たな仕事を見つけることが困難となっている。エコノミストらはこうした傾向について、関税措置を巡る不確実性に加え、ディーゼル（軽油）価格を過去最高水準に押し上げ、他のコモディティー（商品）価格を上昇させている米・イスラエルとイランの戦争による不確実性が原因だと指摘している。

ネイビー・フェデラル・クレジット・ユニオンのチーフエコノミスト、ヘザー・ロング氏は「依然として『低採用・低解雇』の雇用市場だ。仕事があってそれを維持したい人にとっては素晴らしいが、求職者にとっては厳しい状況だ」と述べた。

申請件数は９月第２週以降、２０万件を下回る水準で推移。季節調整前の申請件数が１０００件を超えて増加したのはカリフォルニア州とイリノイ州のみだった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は２５００件減の１９万８０００件と、２０２２年１０月序盤以来の低水準となった。

９月２６日までの週の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は１７１万６０００件と、前週から１万７０００件増加した。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週間と、約４年半ぶりの高水準付近となった。

一部のエコノミストは、継続受給件数が依然低水準で推移していることが労働市場の緩やかな弱体化を覆い隠していると指摘。最近大学を卒業した人を含む一部の失業者が、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がないことが背景にあると述べた。

パンテオン・マクロエコノミクスのチーフ米国エコノミスト、サミュエル・トゥームズ氏は「低調な採用の中で、労働市場への新規参入者や再参入者の失業が引き続き増加することで、今後数四半期にわたって失業率に緩やかな上昇圧力がかかるだろう」と述べた。

Trump to honour Musk, Google’s Brin, Nvidia’s Huang with top US science medal

The event, ‘Science: A New Golden Age Summit’, will bring together some of the most influential and well-known figures from the worlds of technology, science and innovation.

Almina Khatoon

New Delhi: US President Donald Trump will award the National Medal of Science to Elon Musk and other prominent technology executives at a science summit on Thursday.

Titled “Science: A New Golden Age Summit,” the event will bring together some of the most influential and well-known figures from the worlds of technology, science and innovation.

Along with Musk, who leads SpaceX and Tesla, Google co-founder Sergey Brin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and Advanced Micro Devices CEO Lisa Su will also receive the National Medal of Science, according to the White House.

Show Full Article

Dell founder and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella will receive the National Medal of Technology and Innovation.

“The Trump administration is grateful for the contributions of these incredible leaders in science and technology. These recipients are helping ensure America keeps leading the world in innovation,” White House spokesperson Liz Huston told Fox News Digital .

Donald Trump and his donors
President Trump will also speak at a White House event focused on scientific discovery on Thursday, according to a social media post by his technology adviser, Michael Kratsios.

The ceremony will be the first time Trump has awarded either the National Medal of Science or the National Medal of Technology and Innovation during his two terms as president.

According to CNBC , Sergey Brin attended Trump’s inauguration and donated hundreds of thousands of dollars to the Republican National Committee in 2025. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang contributed to a fund for Trump’s planned White House ballroom, while Nvidia also donated $1 million toward Trump’s inauguration.

Dell has also been a longtime Trump donor. Michael Dell and his wife, Susan, pledged $6.25 billion to help fund Trump Accounts, a program aimed at helping American children build savings. AMD has also contributed to Trump-related funds.

Trump’s latest financial disclosure shows that he bought or sold shares in SpaceX, Tesla, Nvidia, Microsoft, AMD and Google’s parent company, Alphabet, as recently as July.

Also read: Computer scientist Margaret Hamilton, the brain behind Apollo 11 flight software, dies at 90

‘Well deserved’
As soon as the news broke, social media reactions poured in. While some users poked fun at Trump for presenting the award and being chosen to speak at a science-focused event, others praised Elon Musk, saying he deserved the recognition and credit for his contributions to technology and innovation.

“It’s a well-deserved honor. For those questioning his credentials, besides his successful @Tesla  and  @SpaceX  achievements, Elon Musk has a B.A. in Physics and a B.S. in Economics from the Wharton School (both degrees from the University Of Pennsylvania)”, reads a comment . 

“Trump replaces science with stupidity”, another comment reads.

items.title: Five charts sounding the alarm for stretched US markets: McGeever
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: US stocks and bonds currently appear highly stretched on several key measures, suggesting investors should tread with extreme caution. The big question is whether we may be at, or near, an inflection point.
items.body:
US stocks and bonds currently appear highly stretched on several key measures, suggesting investors should tread with extreme caution. The big question is whether we may be at, or near, an inflection point.
Wall Street's record-breaking highs mask historic levels of concentration and narrow breadth. Treasury yields are now so high that, depending on your perspective, they either represent a generational buying opportunity or are about to send the equity rally screeching into reverse. Meanwhile, the spiking “term premium” could slam both stocks and bonds.
But does that indicate mean reversion is just around the corner? It’s tough to say.
Historically high AI-related profits and healthy economic growth could maintain Wall Street's bull run for months if not years, and there's no shortage of reasons why yields cannot rise further, and not all of them are negative.
Below are five charts that bring this debate into focus:
Stock market concentration
Tech and AI stocks now comprise over 40% of the S&P 500's (.SPX) market cap. That's higher than the peak of the dotcom bubble in early 2000. Add in AI-related companies, and tech's footprint tops 50%, also a record. This level of concentration is fine when tech is surging, but concerns are mounting about the AI revolution, including safety issues and doubts over the technology's long-term economic viability. A turn in AI sentiment could spark a serious correction. On the other hand, if the hundreds of billions of dollars in AI investment start to pay off, the rally could get supercharged.
Equal weight under-performance
The current ratio of the equal-weighted S&P 500 index to the market cap-weighted index is collapsing, based on Invesco's RSP EW exchange-traded fund and the SPY ETF. In plain English, the main US index in which stocks have equal weighting is under-performing the more widely followed index by the widest margin in 24 years. That’s almost entirely due to the strong performance of tech and AI names, suggesting corporate America overall is not quite as strong as the record-breaking S&P 500 headlines suggest.
Equity risk premium
Investors usually demand a higher rate of return when buying “riskier” stocks versus traditionally “safe” bonds. This difference between the earnings yield on stocks and the 10-year Treasury yield is referred to as the “equity risk premium”. It is currently the lowest in 24 years and is actually negative – a very rare occurrence this century. This should be a signal for investors to start rethinking the size of their equity allocation, though, as of now, we certainly aren’t seeing many signs of that.
Real yields
The yield on 30-year Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) is nearing 3.40%, the highest since 2002. That represents the near-guaranteed inflation-adjusted – or “real” – annual rate of return investors can now lock in for the next 30 years. Again, one might expect that to pull capital away from equities and help prop up the ailing bond market, especially as rising real yields are usually indicative of stronger economic growth. Spiking yields should also negatively impact corporate borrowers at some point – the question is when that might be.
Term premium
Last but not least, the “term premium” – the market’s wild card. This is the estimated level of extra compensation investors demand in return for buying long-dated Treasuries over short-term debt. What’s pushing up the term premium remains an open question – it could be growing doubts around Fed credibility, US debt debasement fears, or something else entirely. But no matter the cause, the main concern with the term premium is always whether it’s rising or not. If it is, it's potentially a signal of more fundamental problems that could have serious economic and market consequences. And right now it's rising sharply.
(The opinions expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters)

items.title: Un avión resulta dañado en el aeropuerto de Riad por ataques hutíes, dicen fuentes
items.author: Timour Azhari, Federico Maccioni
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Federico Maccioni
items.summary: Los hutíes de Yemen, alineados con Irán, intensificaron su letal campaña de ataques contra Arabia Saudita, con el objetivo de bloquear el espacio aéreo y las instalaciones petroleras del reino mediante lanzamientos de misiles que han causado la muerte de tres personas esta semana y han dejado un avión gravemente dañado.
items.body:
Los hutíes de Yemen, alineados con Irán, intensificaron su letal campaña de ataques contra Arabia Saudita, con el objetivo de bloquear el espacio aéreo y las instalaciones petroleras del reino mediante lanzamientos de misiles que han causado la muerte de tres personas esta semana y han dejado un avión gravemente dañado.
El grupo dijo que había atacado el aeropuerto de Riad y advirtió a los trabajadores de que se mantuvieran alejados de las centrales energéticas, que serían objeto de ataques.
La metralla procedente de una interceptación o del impacto de otro proyectil había dejado gravemente dañado el avión comercial perteneciente a la aerolínea estatal saudita Saudia Airlines tras incendiarse mientras estaba estacionado en una terminal del aeropuerto el jueves, dijeron tres personas informadas sobre el asunto.
Las fuentes dijeron que, según se cree, no había pasajeros a bordo del avión en ese momento, pero no pudieron descartar que haya habido heridos como consecuencia del incidente. En un vídeo verificado por Reuters se veía una espesa columna negra de humo y llamas elevándose desde el aeropuerto de Riad.
La oficina de prensa del Gobierno de Arabia Saudita, su autoridad de aviación civil y Saudia Airlines no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios enviadas por correo electrónico.
Lufthansa y Air India anunciaron que suspendían los vuelos a Riad tras los ataques de los hutíes.
Por otra parte, las autoridades sauditas dijeron que los restos de un misil interceptado habían impactado en una guardería y un complejo médico de Riad.
Los hutíes afirman que están atacando al reino por su apoyo a las fuerzas gubernamentales en la reavivada guerra civil de Yemen. Arabia Saudita ha dicho que respalda una ofensiva del Gobierno yemení reconocido por la ONU para recuperar territorio de manos de los hutíes.
El conflicto, que ahora se ha convertido en una extensión de la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán, ha añadido un nuevo caos a una región ya en llamas y amenaza con arrastrar a otros Estados a una agotadora lucha en las montañas, mientras Siria se plantea ahora desplegar tropas para ayudar a Arabia Saudita.

items.title: Campanha de Flávio nega privatização de estatais e promete fortalecer programas sociais e reduzir impostos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O coordenador da área econômica da campanha à Presidência de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Adolfo Sachsida, negou nesta quinta-feira que, se eleito, o senador privatizará estatais como Banco do Brasil, Caixa Econômica Federal e Petrobras, e prometeu que um eventual governo Flávio irá "fortalecer" programas sociais como o Bolsa Família e o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC) ao mesmo tempo que reduzirá impostos.
items.body:
O coordenador da área econômica da campanha à Presidência de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Adolfo Sachsida, negou nesta quinta-feira que, se eleito, o senador privatizará estatais como Banco do Brasil, Caixa Econômica Federal e Petrobras, e prometeu que um eventual governo Flávio irá "fortalecer" programas sociais como o Bolsa Família e o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC) ao mesmo tempo que reduzirá impostos.
Em vídeo publicado em sua conta no X, Sachsida disse que o ajuste fiscal prometido pelo candidato "será focado nos excessos do governo" e citou redução no número de ministérios e salários de funcionários públicos que, em alguns casos, segundo ele, chegam a R$200 mil.
"Nós vamos preservar todos os programas sociais, e não é só preservar, não, nós vamos fortalecer os programas sociais. Então, se você que está vendo esse vídeo recebe o Bolsa Família, o BPC, pode ter certeza que nós vamos respeitar, e muito, você e sua família e vamos fortalecer esses programas todos", disse.
"Se você que está vendo esse vídeo é um empresário, saiba que nós vamos reduzir impostos, vamos reduzir burocracia, vamos facilitar a sua vida", prometeu.
Sachsida, que foi ministro de Minas e Energia no governo Jair Bolsonaro e secretário de Política Econômica do ministro da Economia de Bolsonaro, Paulo Guedes, negou ainda que Flávio pretenda privatizar estatais.
"Se você que está ouvindo esse vídeo é do Banco do Brasil, da Caixa Econômica e da Petrobras saiba de uma coisa: não existirão privatizações de empresas. Nenhuma dessas empresas será tocada", disse.
Mais cedo, o jornal Folha de S.Paulo publicou reportagem em que afirma que a equipe de Flávio estuda, caso ele seja eleito, mudar a correção dos benefícios da Previdência e do BPC, assim como dos gastos obrigatórios em saúde e educação, com objetivo de obter um corte de R$250 bilhões.
Em seu vídeo, Sachsida não menciona a matéria do jornal, mas pede aos seguidores que não acreditem em "fake news".
"Nós vamos colocar as contas públicas em ordem respeitando a população brasileira. Então não acredite em fake news".

items.title: Thousands of Spaniards march to mark death of octogenarian at heart of housing protests
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Thousands of Spaniards marched through central Madrid on Thursday to mark the death of the 87-year-old woman whose eviction from her home ignited protests across the country and led to a snap election next month.
items.body:
Thousands of Spaniards marched through central Madrid on Thursday to mark the death of the 87-year-old woman whose eviction from her home ignited protests across the country and led to a snap election next month.
Maricarmen Abascal, who died on Wednesday, had been hospitalised for severe anxiety and exhaustion since her [USN:L8N45F0PQ TEXT:" eviction"] on September 23. No cause of death has been announced.
Protests over home shortages and surging rents following her eviction prompted Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call a snap [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"general election"] for November 29 after parliament rejected his government's proposals to address a mounting housing crisis.
As the sun set in Madrid, thousands followed a line of Tenants Union members, dressed in orange vests and walking arm-in-arm, as they carried a wreath of flowers from a protest camp in central Puerta del Sol square to Abascal's former home near Retiro Park.
"They're not deaths; they're murders," the protesters chanted.
Several people who received eviction orders have died by suicide in Spain in recent months.
Political leaders on Thursday traded blame and invoked Abascal's case in attacks on opponents.
Left-leaning parties criticised conservatives who [USN:L1N45O0BD TEXT:"rejected"] legislation in parliament aimed at curbing soaring rental prices. Right-wingers said the leftist central government had been unable to tackle the crisis after eight years in power.
Alberto Nuñez Feijoo, leader of the conservative opposition People's Party (PP), accused Sanchez and the Socialists of trying to exploit the housing crisis for political gain before the election.
"We will not allow this attempt to manipulate the emotions of the Spanish people; all of this has happened during their eight years in government. It won’t fly," Feijoo said.
In the Madrid regional assembly, opposition leader Manuela Bergerot of the leftist Mas Madrid party said Maricarmen — as she has become known across Spain — had died because of "miserable people who put gain above a person's life."
She said the last thing Madrid regional leader Isabel Diaz Ayuso had done while Maricarmen was alive was "laugh at her" — a reference to Ayuso's quip on September 28: "At what age do I get to stop paying my landlords? Let me know."
Ayuso blamed Sanchez, saying Maricarmen had been evicted under his government.
PROTESTERS BLAME 'GREEDY' LANDLORDS News of the octogenarian's death enraged protesters camped on squares in Spain's main cities who chanted that she had been "murdered" because of the greed of her landlords.
After an investment fund purchased the building where she had lived for more than 70 years, Abascal lost a lengthy legal battle against rent increases far beyond her pension income, leading to her eviction. While in hospital, she reached a deal to regain her home but she died before she could return.
"When everything is private, we will be deprived of everything," said a placard on Puerta del Sol square, where mourners lit candles and left flowers honouring Maricarmen.
Outside Abascal's building, mourners left flowers, candles, handwritten notes and children's drawings.
"Maricarmen was the straw that broke the camel's back... (she was) a symbol of resistance and unity," said Alex Marinero, a 21-year-old protester.
Tributes to Abascal in the Madrid region's legislature also caused arguments as lawmakers accused each other of cynically exploiting the case.
The PP, which has absolute majorities in the Madrid regional and local assemblies, refused to hold a minute of silence honouring her.
Instead, hard-left deputies staged one outside City Hall and gave Abascal a 60-second standing ovation during a tense debate in the regional assembly, while PP lawmakers remained seated with folded arms.
A survey carried out in June and published by state pollster CIS on Thursday found 76.3% of Spaniards supported intervention in the market to guarantee access to housing, while 79% believe the right to housing should take precedence over treating homes as a market commodity.
Ombudsman Angel Gabilondo said addressing the housing crisis would require greater commitment from all levels of government.
He said his office was preparing a housing report and reiterated proposals including expanding public housing, restricting tourist rentals, increasing rent assistance and strengthening protections against evictions for vulnerable households.

items.title: Argenx discontinues Vyvgart study in Sjögren's disease, shares tumble
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Argenx said on Thursday it had discontinued a late-stage study of its efgartigimod drug in adults with Sjögren's disease, an autoimmune condition that damages the glands producing tears and saliva, putting its shares on track for their biggest one-day fall in almost three years.
items.body:
Argenx (ARGX.BR) said on Thursday it had discontinued a late-stage study of its efgartigimod drug in adults with Sjögren's disease, an autoimmune condition that damages the glands producing tears and saliva, putting its shares on track for their biggest one-day fall in almost three years.
The drug, commercialized under Vyvgart, has become one of Europe's most successful biotech launches through its use in treatment of two other autoimmune diseases, and Argenx sees rheumatology as a potential new growth platform for it. Sjögren's is primarily diagnosed and treated by rheumatologists.
An independent data monitoring committee recommended stopping the study after an interim analysis concluded the study was unlikely to meet its primary endpoint
Sjögren's has a high unmet need and no approved treatment, so analysts had seen the trials as a clear opportunity for Vyvgart
The shares were down 16% by 1109 GMT, wiping off €8.5 billion ($9.5 billion) from Argenx's market value
The stock is by far the biggest faller on Europe's downbeat healthcare index (.SXDP) , which fell 1.8%
($1 = 0.8942 euros)

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end lower as crude prices jump, chip stocks weigh
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: US stocks dipped on Thursday as crude prices surged on a spike in Middle East tensions and a cut in US output that stoked inflation and rate-hike fears, while semiconductor stocks slumped.
items.body:
US stocks dipped on Thursday as crude prices surged on a spike in Middle East tensions and a cut in US output that stoked inflation and rate-hike fears, while semiconductor stocks slumped.
Of the major US stock indexes, the Nasdaq closed with the steepest percentage loss, two days after the tech-heavy index reached a record closing high. The S&P 500's loss was more modest, while the blue-chip Dow eked out a nominal gain.
Chipmakers (.SOX) , which have soared over 80% so far this year, were clear underperformers on the day, falling 3.4% in the wake of a report from the Financial Times that OpenAI's annualized revenues were $20 billion less than the company previously signaled.
"The market's going sideways in anticipation of third-quarter earnings season, which begins next week, and then there's the ongoing conflict in Iran that's pushing oil prices higher," said Terry Sandven, chief equity strategist at US Bank Wealth Management in Minneapolis, Minnesota. "What's equally telling is that year-to-date, the path of least resistance for equities has been up."
[USN:L1N45U031 TEXT:"Oil prices"] jumped on supply concerns after a spate of attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, combined with a cut in US output due to hurricane activity.
Front-month WTI and Brent settled up 3.6% and 4.1%, respectively.
Tight global crude supplies during the Iran war have sent US crude soaring more than 60% so far this year, stoking inflation pressures. In response to those pressures, the US Federal Reserve hiked interest rates in September for the first time since July 2023.
Financial markets currently expect the central bank to leave rates unchanged this month, while the probability of a December hike is 69.2%, according to CME's FedWatch tool.
That mirrors the expected rate hike path of the [USN:L6N45U0QU TEXT:"European Central Bank"], and was affirmed by Fed Governor [USN:L6N45T15S TEXT:"Christopher Waller"], who said additional rate hikes will probably be necessary, but the timing of those hikes is "flexible."
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 51.77 points, or 0.10%, to 51,231.64, the S&P 500 (.SPX) lost 36.41 points, or 0.47%, to 7,765.36 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 345.35 points, or 1.25%, to 27,193.34.
Among the 11 major sectors in the S&P 500, energy stocks (.SPNY) led the percentage gainers, while technology (.SPLRCT) , weighed by chips, suffered the steepest loss.
Memory-chip giant Samsung Electronics' (005930.KS) record quarterly profit forecast failed to lift sentiment, with its shares closing lower in South Korea. Rival Micron Technology (MU.O) dropped 4.8%.
On Wednesday, the Wall Street Journal reported that [USN:FWN45T25Y TEXT:"Broadcom"] (AVGO.O) is lining up $50 billion in financing for OpenAI, with Oracle (ORCL.N) also seeking an unspecified sum, spurring fears that massive debt issuance by technology companies could intensify the competition for capital.
Broadcom and Oracle fell 4.4% and 5.5%, respectively.
[USN:L6N45U0N9 TEXT:"PepsiCo"] (PEP.O) shares gained 3.7% after the beverage company said it would pursue additional spending cuts while lowering its annual core profit forecast.
[USN:L6N45U0YO TEXT:"Starbucks"] (SBUX.O) dipped 0.4% following reports that the coffee chain was exploring a purchase of Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG.N) , whose shares jumped 6.2%.
Palantir (PLTR.O) climbed 2.4% after Goldman Sachs upgraded its rating on the data analytics software provider to "buy" from "neutral."
Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.28-to-1 ratio on the NYSE. There were 110 new highs and 416 new lows on the NYSE.
On the Nasdaq, 2,050 stocks rose and 2,734 fell as declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 1.33-to-1 ratio.
The S&P 500 posted 4 new 52-week highs and 12 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 33 new highs and 319 new lows.
Volume on US exchanges was 18.81 billion shares, compared with the 17.74 billion average for the full session over the last 20 trading days.

items.title: インド株式市場・引け＝続落、インフレ懸念で主要指数32ヵ月ぶり安値
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Bharath Rajeswaran　Vivek Kumar M

[８日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は続落して引け...
items.body:
インド株式市場・引け＝続落、インフレ懸念で主要指数32ヵ月ぶり安値
10/8 19:44 配信

Bharath Rajeswaran　Vivek Kumar M

[８日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は続落して引けた。ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数が３２カ月ぶり安値に沈んだ。原油価格の高騰、世界的な国債利回り上昇、ルピー安を背景にインフレ懸念が強まった。前日は中央銀行によるタカ派的利上げに圧迫されていた。

ＮＳＥ指数は１．６４％安の２万２２３１．８、ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は１．４４％安の７万１５９３．２４で終了。ＮＳＥ指数は１８カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。

外国人投資家の売りが加速、過去９日間では４６９９億ルピー（４８億６０００万ドル）を売り越した。年初来の資金流出は過去最大の３０４億ドルに達した。

ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は年初来で約１５％下落している。一方でＭＳＣＩ新興国株指数は人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への資金流入を追い風に２３％上昇している。

ＮＳＥ指数とＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は先週に一時持ち直したものの、再び売られ過ぎの水準に戻った。相対力指数（ＲＳＩ）は３０を下回り、売り圧力の強さを示している。

主要１６業種は全て下落。小型株指数は２．３％、中型株指数は２．５％それぞれ下げた。

指数構成比率上位３銘柄のうち、ＨＤＦＣ銀行は１．５％安、ＩＣＩＣＩ銀行は０．６％安、リライアンス・インダストリーズは２．５％安だった。

エクイノミクス・リサーチの創業者で調査責任者のＧ・チョッカリンガム氏は「市場は現在、相互に関連する複数の要因から圧力を受けている。インフレ懸念による世界的な国債利回りの上昇、ルピー安、外国人投資家の売り越しの継続といった要因は、根本的に全て原油価格の高止まりに関連している」と指摘した。

items.title: US, Russia discuss Nord Stream gas flows to Europe amid Ukraine war
items.summary: US and Russian officials discuss bringing a US investor into Nord Stream pipelines, raising the prospect of renewed Russian gas flows to Europe after the Ukraine war.
items.body:
Home / World News / US, Russia discuss Nord Stream gas flows to Europe amid Ukraine war

US, Russia discuss Nord Stream gas flows to Europe amid Ukraine war US and Russian officials discuss bringing a US investor into Nord Stream pipelines, raising the prospect of renewed Russian gas flows to Europe after the Ukraine war.

Talks between Moscow and Washington are taking place against a backdrop of deep European mistrust of Russia's motives

Reuters 5 min read Last Updated : Oct 08 2026 | 10:55 PM IST

Top Russian and US officials, including US Special Envoy Jared Kushner, have held talks about bringing a US investor into the Nord Stream pipelines that delivered gas to Germany before Russia invaded Ukraine, five people with knowledge of the situation said.
  The discussions included Kirill Dmitriev, a close adviser to Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Kushner, the son-in-law of US President Donald Trump, the people said.
  Kushner, who has been trying to broker a truce between Russia and Ukraine, views doing business as central to restoring peace. Such a deal would enable US investors to profit from energy flows to Europe once the war ends.
 

  Dmitriev and Kushner have met in Moscow and New York in recent weeks. While it was unclear to what degree they discussed Nord Stream on those occasions, the topic remains on the agenda, two of the people told Reuters.
  "Any deals will have to be negotiated by Russia with DFC (US International Development Finance Corporation) and Treasury and must benefit United States taxpayers and companies," a White House official said, when asked about the pipeline discussions.
Also Read

Ukraine grapples with shortage of troops at front after over 4 years of war

23 Indians rescued after oil tanker attacked off Russia's Black Sea coast

A spy's guide to fighting AI-driven propaganda and disinformation

Exporters to get an extra year on methane rules: EU's Ursula von der Leyen

Kautilya Conclave: Need multi-alignment to navigate world, says Jaishankar

  There had been "no Nord Stream discussions recently", the official told Reuters.
  Dmitriev, who has campaigned for a resumption of Russian gas sales to Germany, met last month with US Energy and Treasury Department representatives to discuss potential US-Russia energy initiatives. A representative for Dmitriev declined to comment.

  It remains unclear how interested Washington is in pursuing the restarting of Russian gas flows to Germany, which is Europe's biggest energy consumer.
  A US official said that given the obstacles, a deal is unlikely in the medium term. The Nord Stream gas pipelines are sanctioned by the US and the EU, making any restart illegal.
  Trump could waive or soften US sanctions, but if Democrats win control of Congress in next month's midterm elections, this would become harder.
  Germany and other European countries, which are spending billions of euros rebuilding their military to defend themselves from Russia, would strongly resist reopening Nord Stream.

  A spokeswoman for Germany's economy and energy ministry said Nord Stream and Russian gas were sanctioned in Europe and that Germany had found alternatives. She said any reopening of the pipelines required government approval and this was not desired.
  Before Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Germany bought more than half of its gas from Russia through the two Nord Stream pipelines. They were mothballed after Moscow throttled supply to Europe and were blown up in a series of underwater explosions in September 2022.
  NORD STREAM OWNERSHIP HURDLES   Talks between Moscow and Washington are taking place against a backdrop of deep European mistrust of Russia's motives.

  Earlier this year, the heads of five European spy agencies told Reuters that Russia did not want to end the war quickly and was using US talks to push for business deals instead.
  Relations between Russia and Germany, which is among the biggest providers of military support to Ukraine, have hit a low ebb, as officials in Berlin have accused Russia of mounting a systematic campaign of hybrid attacks.
  Some German lawmakers say that business deals would bolster Moscow as it pursues war with Ukraine.
  "This threatens to be a dirty deal that will cost Europe dearly," said Michael Kellner, a lawmaker who was in charge of German energy policy in the aftermath of the Ukraine invasion.

  "Americans and Russians will share the profits," he said.
  While Germany's coalition government is opposed to restarting the pipeline, Alternative for Germany (AfD), the country's most popular political party, wants to do so.
  Dmitriev will meet the AfD leadership early next year to discuss selling Russian gas again.
  But selling ownership of the company that controls the Nord Stream gas pipelines to a US investor or restarting Russian gas faces hurdles.
  The company is 51% owned by Russian state energy giant Gazprom, with a further 31% split between two German entities and the rest in the hands of a French and a Dutch firm.

  The two German shareholders are seeking to keep their shares to maintain German influence, should Gazprom sell its stake, said another person.
  Days after the Moscow meetings, Kushner said in Kyiv he had spoken to European counterparts about how the war pushed up energy prices, advocating "prosperity agreements" to encourage peace and give "leaders ... something to look forward to".
  While a gas deal would please the Kremlin, it would split German public opinion, which is divided over buying Russian energy, and Europe, where Poland and the Baltic states are particularly vulnerable to Russia and reject energy ties.
  Poland's political leadership is watching the discussions to reopen the pipeline but remains firmly opposed, said one person with knowledge of the government's thinking.

  Kushner and Dmitriev have also been discussing the sale of a collection of businesses, from oil refineries to petrol stations in Europe and elsewhere which are owned by Russian energy company Lukoil, said two other people familiar with the matter.
  Under that plan, a consortium of the DFC federal investment agency and investors from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates would buy the assets, while US authorities would lift sanctions, those people said.
  "On Lukoil, Steve (Witkoff) and Jared (Kushner) worked with DFC to negotiate a substantial upfront payment and profits interest for the United States," said a White House official.
  Lukoil and Gazprom did not respond to requests for comment.

items.title: スイス中銀、金融政策の調整不要　インフレ率は目標範囲内＝副総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Emma Farge

[マルティニー（スイス） ８日 ロイター] - スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）のマルタン副総裁は８日...
items.body:
スイス中銀、金融政策の調整不要　インフレ率は目標範囲内＝副総裁
10/8 19:18 配信

スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）のマルタン副総裁、3月19日撮影 REUTERS/Denis Balibouse

Emma Farge

[マルティニー（スイス） ８日 ロイター] - スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）のマルタン副総裁は８日、国内のインフレ圧力は高まっているものの、金融政策を調整する必要はないとの見解を示した。

マルタン氏はスイス南西部マルティニーで開かれた会合で、ここ数カ月のインフレ率上昇は主に、中東紛争に伴う原油価格の上昇によるものだと説明した。

９月のインフレ率は１．０％に加速し、２年余りぶりの高水準となった。これを受け、市場では中銀が１２月に政策金利を現在の０％から引き上げるとの観測が強まった。

ただ、マルタン氏は、スイスのインフレ率は他の多くの国と比べて低く安定しているとして、政策方針を変える必要はないと述べた。「インフレ率は物価安定の目安とする０─２％の範囲に十分収まっている。このため現時点では金融政策を変更する必要はないと考えている」と語った。

「もちろん、これらの予測には依然として大きな不確実性がある。特に、イランでの戦争がまだ終結しておらず、それに伴う地政学的な緊張があるためだ」とも述べた。

また、インフレの影響が経済の他の分野に波及する兆候も見られないとした。「問題は、例えば企業が賃金上昇や原油高による将来の物価上昇を見越して、価格や賃金をどの程度引き上げるかだ」と指摘した。

「現時点でこうした２次的な影響は見られず、極めて心強い。賃金と物価がスパイラル的に上昇し始めると、インフレがさらなるインフレを招くようになり、問題が生じる」と述べた。

今後も２次的な影響の兆候が見られなければ、インフレ率は現在の水準近辺にとどまるとの見通しを示した。

スイス経済は現在「非常に好調」だとも述べた。スイスフランはここ数カ月で下落したものの、インフレ調整後では２０２０年以降、安定していると続けた。

items.title: 米農業債務が過去最大、政府統計は実態を過小評価の可能性
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
P.J. Huffstutter

[シカゴ ８日 ロイター] - 米国では農家の運転資金の借り入れが過去最大となってい...
items.body:
米農業債務が過去最大、政府統計は実態を過小評価の可能性
10/8 19:02 配信

写真は米カンザス州キングマンの小麦畑。5月13日撮影。REUTERS/Emily Schmall

P.J. Huffstutter

[シカゴ ８日 ロイター] - 米国では農家の運転資金の借り入れが過去最大となっているが、伝統的な金融機関以外による融資や取引先による信用供与が増え、連邦政府が農業債務の全容や動向を把握しきれない部分が生じている。米農務省の当局者がロイターに明らかにした。

農家は農産物価格の低迷と生産資材費の高止まりで、何年も採算の厳しい状況が続いている。最近では、中国など主要な輸出先と米国との貿易摩擦で輸出市場が混乱し、苦境に立たされている。イラン戦争も肥料や燃料のコストを押し上げている。

農家の破産申請が増える中、一部の銀行は融資基準を厳格化しており、農家は別の資金調達先を探している。農務省の最新推計によると、インフレ調整後の米農業債務は２０００年の約３０００億ドルから今年は６０５０億ドル超へと２倍以上に増え、過去最大となった。

ただ、ロイターの調査によると、この数字は農家の債務を過小評価している可能性がある。農家は資材供給業者や農業協同組合、農機メーカー、金融テクノロジー企業など、従来型の金融機関以外からの借り入れを増やしている。政府がこうした債務を網羅的に把握するのは難しい。

当局者によると、農務省はこうした債務をより正確に把握するとともに、農業部門の資金繰りの悪化が経済全体に影響している可能性を探るため、調査研究に着手する。

農務省の２５年の統計では、「個人・その他」の区分の債務は４５０億ドルだったが、カンザス州立大学のジェニー・イフト教授（農業金融）によると、実際にはその２─３倍に上る可能性がある。

＜経済全体への波及＞

農業経済調査会社メリディアン・アグリビジネス・アドバイザーズのパートナー、ウェズリー・デービス氏によると、前シーズンは米商業農家の約半数が、運転資金を取引先や伝統的な金融機関以外からの融資に頼っていた。前年に比べ約１０％増えたという。

農務省経済調査局のジェフリー・ホプキンス次長代行は「経済の他の分野に影響が波及する恐れのある領域がないか」を調べていると明らかにした。ホプキンス氏はデータ不足により健全な負債と問題のある負債の判別が困難だった０７─１０年のサブプライム住宅ローン危機に言及した。
